website_content.title: KTET Result 2026 (February Session) Scorecard
website_content.summary: Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan has declared the KTET Result 2026 for the February session on September 19, 2026. Candidates of Categories 1, 2, 3, and 4 can now download their scorecards from the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KTET Result 2026 (February Session)

The **Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan** has officially released the results for the Kerala Teacher Eligibility Test (KTET) for the February 2026 session. Candidates who appeared for the exams held on August 8 and 9, 2026, can now access their qualifying status and marks.

### 📌 Result Overview
* **Conducting Body:** Kerala Pareeksha Bhavan
* **Exam Name:** Kerala Teacher Eligibility Test (KTET)
* **Session:** February 2026
* **Result Date:** September 19, 2026
* **Mode of Result:** Online
* **Login Requirements:** Register Number and Date of Birth

### 🎓 Categories Included
* **Category 1:** Lower Primary (LP)
* **Category 2:** Upper Primary (UP)
* **Category 3:** High School
* **Category 4:** Specialist

### 🛠️ Steps to Check KTET Result 2026
1. Visit the official website: **ktet.kerala.gov.in**
2. Navigate to the **Results** tab on the homepage.
3. Click on the link titled **"K-TET EXAMINATION RESULTS FEBRUARY 2026"**.
4. Select your specific **Category** from the dropdown menu.
5. Enter your **Register Number** and **Date of Birth** (dd/mm/yyyy).
6. Click **Submit** to view your result.
7. Download and print the scorecard for future reference.

### 📄 Details on Scorecard
* Candidate's Name
* Register Number
* Category (1, 2, 3, or 4)
* Date of Birth
* Qualifying Status
* Total Marks Obtained

website_content.title: BITSAT 2026 Branch-Wise Cutoff Scores Released
website_content.summary: BITS Pilani has announced the branch-wise BITSAT cutoff scores for admission to its Pilani, K. K. Birla Goa, and Hyderabad campuses for the 2026 session.
website_content.markdown_content:
## BITSAT 2026 Cutoff Overview
BITS Pilani has released the official cutoff marks required for admission into various B.E. and M.Sc. programs. The cutoffs vary across the three campuses, with the Pilani campus generally maintaining the highest requirements.

### Key Highlights
* **Highest Cutoff:** B.E. Computer Science (Pilani Campus) closed at **308 marks**.
* **Campuses Covered:** Pilani, K. K. Birla Goa, and Hyderabad.
* **Programs:** B.E. (Engineering) and M.Sc. (Science) disciplines.

### Branch-Wise Cutoff Table

| Discipline / Branch | Pilani Campus | Goa Campus | Hyderabad Campus |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| B.E. Computer Science (CSE) | 308 | 274 | 272 |
| B.E. Mathematics & Computing | 299 | 270 | 268 |
| B.E. Electronics & Communication | 289 | 261 | 261 |
| B.E. Electrical & Electronics | 266 | 253 | 251 |
| B.E. Electronics & Instrumentation | 261 | 250 | 249 |
| B.E. Mechanical Engineering | 239 | 233 | 228 |
| B.E. Chemical Engineering | 226 | 223 | 223 |
| B.E. Civil Engineering | 222 | - | 220 |
| M.Sc. Economics | 256 | 246 | 244 |
| M.Sc. Mathematics | 241 | 233 | 230 |
| M.Sc. Physics | 235 | 231 | 229 |
| M.Sc. Chemistry | 227 | 223 | 223 |
| M.Sc. Biological Sciences | 218 | 217 | 217 |

### How to Verify Your Eligibility
1. Visit the official BITS admission portal.
2. Navigate to the **BITSAT Cutoff** or **Iteration Results** section.
3. Compare your score with the table above to determine eligibility for your preferred branch and campus.

**Note:** Candidates who do not meet the cutoff for their first choice should explore related branches or wait for subsequent counselling iterations.

Kamdhenu University (KU) has officially declared the results for the **Junior Clerk (Class-3) Preliminary Examination (Stage-1)** held on August 23, 2026.

* **Advertisement No.:** 1/2026
* **Exam Date:** 23/08/2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** 11/09/2026
* **Exam Type:** MCQ-OMR based test

## Result Content
The official result is a detailed scorecard including the following information:
* Application Reference Number & Seat Number
* Marks Obtained (out of 150)
* Total Obtained Marks for Part-1
* Category, Gender, and PwBD/Ex-Servicemen status

## Next Stage: Main Examination
Candidates shortlisted from the Preliminary stage will proceed to the Main Examination:
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Recruitment Test (MCQ-CBRT)
* **Total Marks:** 200
* **Duration:** 120 Minutes
* **Schedule:** Detailed instructions and syllabus will be published separately by the university.

website_content.title: HITES Recruitment 2026: Chief Manager & Operations Manager Vacancies
website_content.summary: HLL Infra Tech Services Ltd (HITES) invites online applications for 21 positions of Chief Manager, Senior Operations Manager, and Operations Manager. The deadline for submission is October 10, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## HITES Recruitment 2026 Overview
HLL Infra Tech Services Ltd (HITES), a subsidiary of HLL Lifecare Limited under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, is hiring for various management positions on a **Fixed Term Contract (FTC)** basis for an initial period of 3 years.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 10 October 2026 (up to 18:00 hours)
* **Cut-off Date (Age/Experience):** 01 September 2026

## Vacancy Breakdown
| Position | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- |
| Chief Manager (Civil) | 3 |
| Senior Operations Manager (MEP) | 5 |
| Operations Manager (Civil) | 5 |
| Operations Manager (BME) | 2 |
| Operations Manager (Quantity Surveyor) | 2 |
| Sr. Operations Manager (Structural) | 1 |
| Sr. Operations Manager (HVAC) | 1 |
| Sr. Operations Manager (Electrical) | 1 |
| Sr. Operations Manager (Plumbing) | 1 |
| **Total** | **21** |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Full-time Degree (B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech) or Diploma from a recognized university/institute in the relevant discipline (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Biomedical Engineering).
* **Experience:** Varies by role, ranging from **3 to 10 years** of post-qualification experience in project planning, design, or execution.
* **Age Limit:** 
    * Chief Manager: 47 Years
    * Sr. Operations Manager: 40–45 Years
    * Operations Manager: 40–45 Years
    * (Age relaxations apply for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per rules).

## Salary & Compensation
Pay scales are based on IDA (Pre-revised):
* **Chief Manager:** ₹29,100 – ₹54,500
* **Senior Operations Manager:** ₹24,900 – ₹50,500
* **Operations Manager:** ₹20,600 – ₹46,500
* Additional benefits include DA, Annual Increment, EPF, and Gratuity.

## Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on initial scrutiny of applications.
2. **Evaluation:** Shortlisted candidates will be called for an **Interview / Skill Assessment Test**.
3. **Verification:** Final appointment is subject to credential verification and medical fitness.

website_content.title: AP District Cooperative Bank Call Letter 2026 - Staff Assistant & Assistant Manager
website_content.summary: APCOB and six DCCBs have released the call letters for Staff Assistant (Clerk) and Assistant Manager (Scale-I) positions. Candidates can now download their admit cards via the dedicated IBPS login portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Andhra Pradesh State Cooperative Bank (APCOB), in collaboration with six District Cooperative Central Banks (DCCBs), has announced the release of call letters for the 2026 recruitment cycle. The examination process is being managed by **IBPS, Mumbai**.

## Key Job Details
* **Posts:** Staff Assistant (Clerk) and Assistant Manager (Scale-I)
* **Total Vacancies:** 338 posts
* **Application Mode:** Online
* **Districts Covered:** Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, Prakasam, Nellore, Kadapa, and Chittoor
* **Exam Conducting Body:** IBPS, Mumbai

## Important Dates
* **Online Application Start Date:** 24 July 2026
* **Online Application Closing Date:** 15 August 2026
* **Call Letter Release Date:** 18 September 2026
* **Call Letter Download Deadline:** 25 September 2026

## How to Download Call Letter
1. Visit the official IBPS candidate login portal.
2. Select the relevant post (**Assistant Manager** or **Staff Assistant**) and the specific **DCCB** you applied to.
3. Enter your **Registration Number/Roll Number** and **Password/Date of Birth**.
4. Enter the security captcha and click **Login**.
5. Download and take a clear printout of the call letter.

## Essential Documents for Exam Day
* Printed copy of the **Call Letter/Admit Card**.
* Original valid **Photo ID Proof** (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or Passport).
* Recent **passport-size photographs**.
* Any specific category or PwD certificates if mentioned on the call letter.

website_content.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has announced the Round 2 counselling schedule for Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) admissions for 2026. Candidates can now access the official notice for seat allotment and option entry details.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** is conducting the state-level NEET MDS 2026 counselling for admissions to Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) programs in both government and private dental colleges across Karnataka.

## Key Details
* **Counselling Authority:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Course:** Master of Dental Surgery (MDS)
* **Current Stage:** Round 2 (Round 1 reporting concluded on September 18, 2026)
* **Seats Covered:** 50% government quota seats, 100% private dental college seats, NRI, and other state-notified quotas.

## Important Dates (Round 1 Reference)
* **Seat Matrix Release:** September 5, 2026
* **Option Entry Window:** September 5 to September 7, 2026
* **Provisional Result:** September 9, 2026
* **Final Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Reporting Deadline (Choice-1):** September 18, 2026

## How to Check Round 2 Updates
1. Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
2. Navigate to the **PG Dental / NEET MDS 2026** counselling section.
3. Log in using your **registration number/CET number** and password or QR code.
4. Review the Round 2 seat matrix and option entry dates.
5. Submit your college and specialisation preferences before the deadline.

## Critical Instructions
* **Eligibility:** Qualifying NEET MDS 2026 is mandatory, but admission is subject to rank, category, and document verification.
* **Preference List:** Candidates are advised to retain preferred options even if seats appear unavailable to account for consequential vacancies.
* **Parallel Counselling:** Those registered with MCC for All India Quota must track both KEA and MCC schedules separately.
* **Verification:** Always refer to the official KEA notification for final dates and fees.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
* **Organization:** Office of the District Programme Officer, Shahjahanpur, UP

* **Total Vacancies:** 460 (Distributed across 15 project areas)

website_content.title: Kurukshetra University (KUK) Exam Results May 2026
website_content.summary: Kurukshetra University has declared the results for various courses for the May 2026 examination session on September 18, 2026. Candidates can now download their detailed mark sheets via the official result portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Kurukshetra University (KUK) May 2026 Results

Kurukshetra University has officially announced the examination results for the **MAY 2026 session**. The results were published on September 18, 2026, and are available for download on the official university portal.

### Results Declared on 18 September 2026
Results have been released for the following courses and semesters:
* **Master of Computer Science (Software)** - II Semester
* **Adv. Dip. in Voc. (Textile & Fashion Designing)** - IV Semester
* **M.Sc. (Chemistry)** - IV Semester
* **M.Sc. (Chemistry)** - II Semester

### How to Check Your Result
Candidates can access their results using the following steps:
1. Visit the official **KUK Result Portal**.
2. Locate your specific **Course and Semester** from the provided list.
3. Click the **'Detail'** link to search for your individual result using your roll number.
4. Alternatively, click the **'CSV'** link to download the full result sheet for your course.

### Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Verification:** Carefully check your Roll Number, Name, Subject Codes, and Pass/Fail status.
* **Discrepancies:** If any error is found, submit a correction request via the KUK Discrepancy Performa.
* **Re-evaluation:** Students wishing to apply for re-evaluation must submit their application online within **15 days** of the result declaration.
* **Documentation:** It is recommended to save a PDF copy of the provisional result until the physical Detailed Marks Card (DMC) is issued.

website_content.title: All India Bar Examination XXII (AIBE 22) 2026 Application
website_content.summary: The Bar Council of India (BCI) invites law graduates to register for the AIBE 22 qualifying exam to obtain the Certificate of Practice (CoP). The application window closes on 27 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **All India Bar Examination XXII (AIBE 22)** is a mandatory qualifying test conducted by the **Bar Council of India (BCI)**. Successful candidates are granted the **Certificate of Practice (CoP)**, enabling them to practice law before courts, tribunals, and other judicial authorities across India.

## Important Dates
* **Official Notification:** 18 July 2026
* **Registration Start Date:** 19 August 2026
* **Last Date to Apply Online:** 27 October 2026
* **Last Date for Fee Payment:** 28 October 2026
* **Application Correction Deadline:** 30 October 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** 14 November 2026
* **Exam Date:** 29 November 2026

## Eligibility Criteria
* Candidates must be a **Law Graduate**.
* Candidates from AIBE XX or XXI who did not qualify may apply using their existing login credentials without fresh registration.

## Application Process
1. Visit the official portal at `allindiabarexamination.com`.
2. New users should click on **Registration**; existing users can use the **Login** portal.
3. Enter personal, educational, and enrolment details accurately.
4. Upload necessary documents and complete the online payment by 28 October 2026.
5. Submit the form and retain a printed copy for future reference.

website_content.title: KSLU Assistant Professor and Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) invites applications for 31 temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor and Guest Faculty positions. The deadline for application submission via hard copy or email is September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KSLU Recruitment 2026 Overview
Karnataka State Law University is seeking qualified candidates for temporary academic positions for the 2026–27 academic year.

### Vacancy Details
| Post | Subject | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor | Law | 21 |
| Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor | Management | 3 |
| Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor | Political Science | 1 |
| Temporary Full-Time Assistant Professor | Sociology | 1 |
| Guest Faculty | Law | 5 |
| **Total** | | **31** |

### Eligibility Criteria
* **Temporary Assistant Professor:** Master's degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks and NET, SLET, SET, or Ph.D. qualification as per UGC Regulations 2018.
* **Guest Faculty (Law):** Master of Laws (LLM) with at least 55% marks. Preference given to candidates with NET, SLET, SET, or Ph.D.

### Remuneration
* **Assistant Professor:** ₹50,000 monthly consolidated pay.
* **Guest Faculty (UGC Qualified):** ₹525 per hour.
* **Guest Faculty (Non-UGC):** ₹450 per hour.
* **Retired Professors/Advocates (15+ yrs exp):** ₹525 per hour.
* **Local Conveyance (Guest Faculty):** ₹150 per day.

### Selection Process
Selection will be based on an **interview**. Shortlisted candidates will be notified of the date. Original documents must be produced during verification.

### How to Apply
1. Download the notification and prescribed proforma from the official website.
2. Fill in the application form and affix a recent passport-size photograph.
3. Attach attested copies of mark sheets, degree certificates, and experience certificates.
4. Submit the application via **hard copy** to the Registrar, KSLU, Navanagar, Hubballi – 580025, or via the **official email address**.

**Important Dates:**
* Notification Date: 17 September 2026
* Last Date to Apply: 25 September 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Baba Saheb Ambedkar Education University (BSAEU) has announced the admission process for the **Bachelor of Education (B.Ed)** course for the **2026-28 session**. Admission will be granted based on the merit of marks obtained in previous qualifying examinations; no separate entrance test will be conducted.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** September 7, 2026
* **Application End Date:** September 21, 2026
* **Merit List Publication:** September 25, 2026
* **Counselling and Seat Allocation:** September 29, 2026
* **Commencement of Classes:** November 3, 2026
* **Final Admission Deadline:** November 21, 2026

## Application Process
1. **Visit Official Portal:** Navigate to the BSAEU B.Ed online application link.
2. **Review Instructions:** Read eligibility, document requirements, and payment guidelines.
3. **Academic Details:** Enter qualifying examination marks and university information.
4. **Personal Information:** Fill in personal details ensuring they match official documents.
5. **Upload Documents:** Upload a photograph (max 110 KB) and signature (max 50 KB) in JPEG/JPG format.
6. **Submission:** Complete the CAPTCHA and submit the form.
7. **Payment:** Use the 'Pay Now' link to complete the application fee payment.
8. **Confirmation:** Save the Application ID, Password, and print the application receipt.

## Key Highlights
* **No Entrance Exam:** Selection is strictly merit-based (qualifying marks).
* **Documentation:** Ensure scanned images are within the prescribed size limits.
* **Verification:** Candidates are advised to verify college affiliation before paying any college-level fees.

website_content.markdown_content:
## CUET PG Geography 2027 Overview
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has prescribed the official syllabus for candidates appearing for the **Geography paper (Code: HUQP08)** under the Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduate programmes.

**Key Exam Details:**
* **Conducting Body:** National Testing Agency (NTA)
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT)
* **Subject:** Geography
* **Paper Code:** HUQP08

## Syllabus Structure
The syllabus is strategically divided into **eight core units**:
* Human Geography
* General Cartography
* Environmental Geography
* Geography of India
* Economic Geography
* Disaster Management
* Geography of Tourism
* Sustainability & Development

## Marking Scheme & Instructions
To ensure a high score, candidates must be mindful of the following marking pattern:
* **Correct Answer:** +4 Marks
* **Incorrect Answer:** -1 Mark (Negative Marking)
* **Unattempted Questions:** 0 Marks

**Preparation Tips:**
* Strictly follow the syllabus published on the official NTA website.
* Solve previous years' question papers to understand the difficulty level and pattern.

website_content.title: Indian Coast Guard Foreman of Stores Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The Directorate of Recruitment, Indian Coast Guard, invites offline applications for the post of Foreman of Stores (Group B). Eligible candidates must submit their applications by ordinary post by November 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## ⚓ Indian Coast Guard Foreman of Stores Recruitment 2026

The Indian Coast Guard is recruiting for the position of **Foreman of Stores**. This is a General Central Service, Group B (Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial) position.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 03 November 2026

### 📊 Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 04
* **Category Breakup:** UR (2), ST (1), EWS (1)
* **Posting Locations:** Karwar, Minicoy, Pipavav, and Bhubaneswar (Subject to change)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
Candidates must meet one of the following combinations:
* **Option 1:** Master’s degree in Economics, Commerce, Statistics, Business Studies, or Public Administration **AND** 1 year of experience in store handling/accounting.
* **Option 2:** Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in the above-mentioned fields **AND** 2 years of experience in store handling/accounting.

**Age Limit:** 18 to 30 years (as of 03 Nov 2026). Age relaxation applies for ST (5 years) and Govt servants as per rules.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Application Scrutiny**
2. **Document Verification**
3. **Written Examination** (80 Marks - Objective Type)
4. **Merit List Preparation**

**Exam Pattern:** Mathematics (15), Mental Ability (15), General Awareness (15), English (15), and Professional Knowledge (20).

### ✉️ How to Apply
This is an **OFFLINE** application process. Applications sent via courier or by hand will be rejected.
1. Download the prescribed application form.
2. Attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, educational certificates, experience certificates, and photos.
3. Include a **self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 50 postal stamp**.
4. Send to: *The Director General, For PD (Recruitment), Coast Guard Headquarters, Directorate of Recruitment, C-1, Phase II, Industrial Area, Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201309*.

The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) is conducting the counselling process for admission to **MBBS, BDS, and BSc Nursing** programmes for the 2026 academic session. This includes the 15% All India Quota (AIQ), Deemed Universities, and Central Institutions.

* **Registration & Fee Payment:** September 22 to 27, 2026

## ESIC Ranchi Recruitment 2026 Overview

ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Ranchi, has released advertisement **06 of 2026** for various faculty and resident positions on a contractual basis. This is a prime opportunity for medical professionals to serve in a prestigious government institution.

* **Professor:** 10 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 19 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 16 Posts
* **Senior Resident:** 40 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 85

### 🏥 Departments Covered
Vacancies are available across multiple departments including **Anaesthesiology, Anatomy, Biochemistry, Community Medicine, Dermatology, ENT, Eye, Medicine, OBG, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, Radiology, and Surgery**, among others.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** Must possess MBBS and PG qualifications (MD/MS/DNB) as per **National Medical Commission (NMC) guidelines dated 30 June 2025**.
* **Registration:** Valid registration with the NMC or State Medical Council is mandatory.
* **Age Limit:** 
    * Professors/Assoc/Asst Professors: Up to **69 years**.
    * Senior Residents (Non-clinical): Up to **50 years**.
    * Senior Residents (Clinical): Up to **45 years**.

### 💰 Salary Structure
| Post | Pay Level | Basic Remuneration |

| Professor | Level 13 | **₹1,23,100** |
| Associate Professor | Level 12 | **₹78,800** |
| Assistant Professor | Level 11 | **₹67,700** |

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 21 September 2026
* **Tentative Interview Date:** 30 September 2026

### 📝 Application Process
1. Download the prescribed application form from the official website.
2. Attach self-attested copies of all educational and experience certificates.
3. Pay the application fee of **₹500** via Demand Draft (Nil for SC/ST/Female/PH/Ex-SM).

**Note:** Separate applications are required for each post applied for.

website_content.title: Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026: Jailor, Warder & Instructor Vacancies
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Prisons and Reforms Services Department is recruiting 869 personnel across General and Kalyana Karnataka cadres. Apply by October 15, 2026, via the KEA portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has invited online applications for various base-cadre posts within the **Karnataka Prisons and Reforms Services Department**. This recruitment is split into two cadres: General (Rest of State) and Kalyana Karnataka (Hyderabad-Karnataka Region).

## Vacancy Details
**Total Posts: 869**

### 1. General / Rest-of-State Cadre (576 Posts)
* **Warder (Vikshakaru):** 560 posts
* **Second Grade Teacher / Instructor Grade-II:** 16 posts

### 2. Kalyana Karnataka Cadre (293 Posts)
* **Jailor:** 5 posts
* **Warder (Vikshakaru):** 275 posts
* **Warder cum Nursing:** 5 posts
* **Second Grade Teacher / Instructor Grade-II:** 8 posts

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualifications
* **Jailor:** Bachelor's Degree (Preference for Sociology, Psychology, Criminology, or Correctional Administration).
* **Warder:** SSLC (10th) pass or equivalent.
* **Instructor Grade-II:** SSLC pass + Diploma/Certificate in relevant trade (Mechanical/Electrical/Tailoring, etc.).
* **Warder cum Nursing:** SSLC pass + First Aid Certificate.

### Age Limit (as of 15.10.2026)
* **General Merit:** Maximum 31 years
* **SC/ST/Cat-1/2A/2B/3A/3B:** Maximum 33 years
* **Minimum Age:** 20 years

## Selection Process
1. **Competitive Written Exam:** OMR-based test (100 marks) focusing on GK, Science, History, Constitution, and Mental Ability. (Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer).
2. **Physical Standard Test (PST) & Endurance Test:** Shortlisted candidates (1:5 ratio) must pass height, chest/weight requirements and endurance events (Race, Jump, Shot Put).
3. **Medical Examination:** Vision, hearing, and physical fitness check by a Medical Board.
4. **Document Verification.**

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 18.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 19.09.2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 15.10.2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 16.10.2026
* **Written Examination Date:** 21.11.2026

## Application Fee
* **General/Other Categories:** ₹750
* **SC/ST/Cat-1/Ex-Servicemen:** ₹500

website_content.title: SWAYAM July 2026 Semester (SWAYAM-17) Exam Date 2026
website_content.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the examination schedule for the SWAYAM July 2026 semester. Exams are scheduled to take place from December 8 to December 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SWAYAM-17 Examination Overview
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially announced the dates for the **SWAYAM July 2026 Semester** examinations. Candidates are advised to note the dates and prepare accordingly.

## 📅 Key Examination Dates
* **Exam Window:** December 8, 2026, to December 12, 2026
* **Buffer Dates:** December 13 and 14, 2026
* **Notice Date:** September 17, 2026

## 🕒 Exam Shift Timings
Exams will be conducted in two shifts, each lasting **3 hours**:
* **Morning Shift:** 9:30 AM – 12:30 PM
* **Evening Shift:** 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM

## ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Mode of Exam:** Depending on the course, exams may be held via **CBT (Computer Based Test)**, **Pen-and-Paper**, or a **Hybrid mode**.
* **Admit Cards:** Candidates must download and carry a printed copy of their admit card, which will contain the specific date, shift, and center.
* **No Retest Policy:** NTA will **not provide a retest** for candidates who miss their allotted date or shift.

## 🛠️ How to Check the Schedule
1. Visit the official NTA or SWAYAM portal.
2. Navigate to the **Public Notice** section.
3. Click on the notice dated September 17, 2026, regarding the July 2026 Semester (SWAYAM-17).

website_content.summary: Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation Limited (GMRC) is hiring for 48 Civil Engineering positions ranging from Junior Engineer to Chief General Manager. The last date for online application is October 3, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GMRC Civil Recruitment 2026 Overview

Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation Limited (GMRC) has announced vacancies for various **Civil Engineering** positions on a Contract, Deputation, and Post-Superannuation basis. This is a prime opportunity for experienced infrastructure professionals to contribute to Gujarat's urban transit network.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 48
* **Posts:** Chief GM, GM, AGM, JGM, Sr. DGM, DGM, Manager, Assistant Manager, Engineer (Sr/Jr), Draftsman, and Surveyor.
* **Application Mode:** Online
* **Job Location:** Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, or other GMRC projects in Gujarat.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 19 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 03 October 2026
* **Interview Date:** To be communicated via email

### 🎓 Eligibility & Experience
* **For Officers (CGM to Asst Manager):** B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering. Experience required in metro, railway, bridges, tunnels, or multi-storeyed buildings (ranges from 5 to 23 years depending on the post).
* **For Engineers (Sr/Jr Grade):** B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering with 2-3 years of post-qualification experience.
* **For Draftsman & Surveyor:** 3-year Diploma in Civil Engineering with at least 3 years of relevant experience in AutoCAD/Surveying for large infrastructure projects.

### 💰 Salary & Pay Scale
* **Chief General Manager/GM:** Rs. 1,20,000 – 2,80,000
* **Manager:** Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000
* **Engineer (Junior Grade):** Rs. 30,000 – 1,20,000
* **Draftsman/Surveyor:** Rs. 33,000 – 1,00,000
*(Note: Post-superannuation consolidated pay is available for senior roles).* 

### 🛠️ Selection Process
1. **Application Screening:** Shortlisting based on criteria.
2. **Document Verification:** Verification of original certificates.
3. **Personal Interview:** Assessment of skills, expertise, and aptitude.
4. **Medical Examination:** Final fitness check.

### 📝 How to Apply
* Visit the official GMRC careers portal.
* Register with basic details and obtain a login passcode via email.
* Fill in employment history and upload required documents (CV, Degree, Experience Certificates, and CTC breakup for private sector candidates).
* Submit the application before the deadline.

website_content.markdown_content:
## SZCC Recruitment 2026 Overview

The South Zone Cultural Centre (SZCC), an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Culture, Government of India**, is recruiting for various administrative, technical, and artistic positions.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Group A:** Deputy Director (Admin & Accounts), Deputy Director (Programme), Assistant Director (Programme), Assistant Director (Admin & Accounts), Stenographer Grade-I.
* **Group B:** Programme Executive, Assistant, Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical), Documentation Officer, Junior Hindi Translator.
* **Group C:** Assistant Programme Executive, Exhibition Assistant, Junior Assistant, Stenographer Grade-II.

### 💰 Pay Scale Highlights
* **Deputy Directors:** Rs. 15,600–39,100 (GP Rs. 6,600)
* **Assistant Directors:** Rs. 15,600–39,100 (GP Rs. 5,400)
* **Group B Posts:** Rs. 9,300–34,800 (GP Rs. 4,200 - 4,600)
* **Group C Posts:** Rs. 5,200–20,200 (GP Rs. 2,400)

### 🗓️ Important Information
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 65 years (varies by post and recruitment mode).
* **Application Mode:** Offline (via Post).
* **Application Fee:** Rs. 100 (General/OBC). **Exempted for SC/ST and Female candidates**.
* **Deadline:** Within 45 days from the publication date in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official website to download the notification and prescribed application form.
2. Ensure you meet the post-wise eligibility and experience criteria.
3. Prepare a Demand Draft for Rs. 100 in favor of **Director, South Zone Cultural Centre, Thanjavur**.
4. Send the completed application and documents to the Director at the Thanjavur office address.
5. Clearly mention the post name on the envelope.

website_content.markdown_content:
## CUET PG 2027 Overview
The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** will conduct the Common University Entrance Test for Postgraduate (CUET PG) 2027 to facilitate admissions into various PG programs. 

* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT)
* **Exam Dates:** March 1 to 5, 8, 12 to 20, 24 and 25, 2027
* **Buffer Dates:** March 30 and 31, 2027
* **Shifts:** Three shifts per exam day

## Important Dates
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Registration Begins** | December 2026 |
| **Registration Deadline** | January 2027 |
| **Correction Window** | January 2027 |
| **Admit Card Release** | February 2027 |
| **Exam Dates** | March 1-25, 2027 |
| **Results & Counselling** | April 2027 |

## Registration Process
Candidates can apply online following these steps:
* Visit the official NTA CUET PG portal.
* Complete registration with academic and personal details.
* Select preferred programs and exam cities.
* Pay the required application fee online.
* Upload necessary documents, photographs, and signatures.
* Submit the form and print the confirmation page.

## Key Instructions
* **Admit Card:** Exact exam date, shift, and reporting time will be mentioned only on the admit card.
* **Buffer Dates:** March 30-31 are reserve dates for rescheduling and should not be treated as default exam dates.
* **Updates:** Regularly check the official portal for the detailed information bulletin.

website_content.title: NEET-SS Special Stray Vacancy Round 2026: Cut-off Lowered to 30 Percentile
website_content.summary: The Centre has proposed reducing the NEET-SS qualifying percentile to 30% to fill 1,857 vacant super-speciality seats. Candidates should monitor the MCC portal for the formal notification and schedule.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET-SS Special Stray Vacancy Round 2026

The Government of India has informed the Supreme Court regarding a proposed reduction in the qualifying percentile for the **National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test-Super Speciality (NEET-SS)** to ensure the utilization of vacant medical seats.

### Key Highlights
* **Revised Cut-off:** Qualifying percentile reduced from 50th to **30th percentile**.
* **Total Vacancies:** 1,857 super-speciality medical seats.
* **Impact:** Approximately 6,000 additional candidates are expected to become eligible.
* **Purpose:** To fill seats remaining vacant after the second round of counselling via a **Special Stray Vacancy Round**.

### Eligibility Criteria
* Candidates must have appeared for the NEET-SS exam.
* Must meet the revised **30th percentile** threshold.
* Only candidates who have **not yet joined** a seat in previous NEET-SS rounds are eligible.
* **Note for TN Candidates:** Tamil Nadu in-service candidates should follow separate state-level updates for 40 specific seats.

### How to Check Eligibility (Once Active)
1. Visit the official MCC counselling website.
2. Navigate to the notice for the **"Special Stray Vacancy Round"**.
3. Log in using your NEET-SS roll number and registration credentials.
4. Verify your percentile against the new 30% cut-off.

### Important Disclaimer
This update is based on a **proposal submitted by the Centre to the Supreme Court**. Candidates are strongly advised to wait for the formal MCC notification regarding final dates, fees, and application processes.

website_content.summary: The OJEE Committee has announced the tentative counselling and admission schedule for BAMS and BHMS courses for the 2026-27 session. Eligible NEET (UG) 2026 candidates can begin registration starting 17 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## OJEE BAMS/BHMS Counselling 2026-27

The **Odisha Joint Entrance Examination (OJEE) Committee** has released the official schedule for admissions into Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery (**BAMS**) and Bachelor of Homoeopathic Medicine and Surgery (**BHMS**) for the academic session 2026-27.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Eligibility:** Candidates must have qualified **NEET (UG) 2026** with a valid rank.
* **Courses Offered:** BAMS and BHMS.
* **Registration Fee:** ₹1,000 (Non-refundable).
* **Part-Admission Fee:** ₹8,500.

### 📅 Important Dates (Round 1)
* **Registration & Choice Filling Starts:** 17 September 2026, 5:00 PM
* **Mock Seat Allotment:** 21 September 2026, 5:00 PM
* **Choice Locking Deadline:** 23 September 2026, 11:59 PM
* **Seat Allotment Result:** 25 September 2026, 5:00 PM
* **Reporting for Verification:** 28 - 29 September 2026

### 📝 Admission Process
1. **Registration:** Create a profile using the NEET (UG) 2026 application number on the official portal.
2. **Payment:** Pay the registration fee of ₹1,000 online.
3. **Choice Filling:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.
4. **Locking:** Ensure choices are locked before the deadline to avoid automatic system locking.
5. **Allotment:** Download the provisional allotment letter upon seat allocation.
6. **Reporting:** Complete fee payment (₹8,500) and report to the OJEE Cell, Gandamunda, Bhubaneswar for document verification.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Fresh Choices:** Choices filled in Round 1 are void for Round 2; candidates must fill fresh choices for subsequent rounds.
* **Disqualification:** Failure to pay fees or report for verification will lead to disqualification from the admission process.
* **Withdrawal:** No withdrawal is permitted after the Round 3 allotment.

website_content.title: MCC NEET UG 2026 Round 1 & 2 Resignation and Seat Withdrawal Notice
website_content.summary: The MCC has opened the resignation and seat withdrawal facility for candidates who joined Round 1 seats in NEET UG 2026. Eligible candidates must complete the process by September 15, 2026, to avoid forfeiture of their security deposit.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) and Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) have announced the window for **resignation and seat withdrawal** for candidates who joined a seat during Round 1 of the NEET UG 2026 Counselling.

## Eligibility
This facility is applicable to candidates who joined a Round 1 seat and:
* **Float Candidates:** Did not upgrade in Round 2.
* **Freeze Candidates:** Chose to retain their Round 1 seat.

## Critical Deadlines
* **Resignation Deadline:** Till 6:00 PM on **15 September 2026** (to ensure security deposit is not forfeited).
* **Withdrawal Window:** 17 September 2026.

## Process & Instructions
* **Float Candidates:** Must log into the official MCC candidate portal to generate the **Seat Withdrawal Slip** independently.
* **Freeze Candidates:** Cannot resign online; the process must be initiated through the **Nodal Officer** of the allotted institute.
* **Validation:** Any resignation without a portal-generated Withdrawal Slip will be treated as **'Null and Void'**.
* **Caution:** Informal communications (like emails to colleges) are not valid proof of resignation unless accompanied by the official portal document.

website_content.title: TGPSC HMWSSB Manager (Engineering) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC) is recruiting 130 Managers (Engineering) for the Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board. Applications close on October 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TGPSC HMWSSB Manager Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of **Manager (Engineering)** positions at the Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 18 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 23 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 17 October 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Tentative Exam Date:** December 2026

### 📋 Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 130
* **Cadre:** Multi Zone II
* **Branch-wise Distribution:**
    * Civil Engineering: 80%
    * Electrical or Mechanical Engineering: 15%
    * CSE, IT, or ECE: 5%

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must possess a graduate degree in the prescribed engineering discipline as of 18 September 2026.
* **Age Limit (as of 01-07-2026):** 18 to 44 years.
    * *Relaxation:* SC/ST/BC/EWS (5 years), PwD (10 years), TS Govt Employees (up to 5 years).

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 54,220 to Rs. 1,33,630

### ✍️ Selection Process & Exam Pattern
Selection will be based on an objective examination conducted via **CBRT or OMR**.

| Paper | Subject | Questions | Marks | Duration |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Paper I | General Studies & General Abilities | 150 | 150 | 150 Mins |
| Paper II | Concerned Engineering Subject | 150 | 300 | 150 Mins |
| **Total** | | **300** | **450** | **300 Mins** |

### 💸 Application Fees
* **OC & BC:** Rs. 1,000 (Processing) + Rs. 120 (Exam fee, if applicable)
* **SC/ST/PwD:** Rs. 500 (Processing) + Rs. 120 (Exam fee, if applicable)
* *Note: Unemployed applicants are exempt from the exam fee.*

* **Post:** Assistant Professor (College Cadre) - Public Administration

website_content.title: Gauhati High Court Judicial Assistant Provisional Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: The Gauhati High Court has released the provisional answer key for the Judicial Assistant recruitment at the Kohima Bench. Candidates can submit objections online between September 22 and September 24, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Gauhati High Court (High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh) has published the provisional answer key for the OMR-based written examination for **Judicial Assistant** posts at the Kohima Bench.

## Key Examination Details
* **Post Name:** Judicial Assistant
* **Number of Posts:** 6
* **Exam Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Answer Key Released:** 17 September 2026
* **Notification No:** HC.XXXVII-01/2026/317/R.Cell

## Important Dates for Objections
* **Objection Window Opens:** 22 September 2026
* **Objection Window Closes:** 24 September 2026 (till 5:00 PM)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 28 September 2026 (within bank transaction hours)

## Process to Raise Objections
Candidates wishing to challenge the provisional answer key must follow these steps:
1. **Login:** Access your candidate account via the official portal.
2. **Selection:** Select the specific question(s) you wish to challenge.
3. **Payment:** Pay a **non-refundable fee of ₹50** per question.
4. **Evidence:** Upload valid documentary proof to support the objection.
5. **Submission:** Ensure submission is completed by 24 September, 5:00 PM.

## Crucial Instructions
* Only candidates who appeared for the exam on 12 Sept 2026 are eligible.
* Objections are accepted **Online Only**; email or postal submissions will be rejected.
* Payment must be completed by 28 September 2026 to finalize the objection.

* **Release Date:** 16th September 2026

* **Corrected Answer Key Date:** 16th September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download the Revised Answer Key
1. Visit the official NPSC portal: **npsc.nagaland.gov.in**
2. Go to the **Notice Board** or notifications section.
3. Look for the link titled **"Corrected Answer Key - CESE 2026"** or reference number **NPSC/CESE-12/AK/2021**.
4. Download the PDF and verify your responses against the updated keys for the 8 corrected subjects.

website_content.title: Southern Railway Scouts and Guides Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Southern Railway (RRC Chennai) invites applications for 17 vacancies under the Scouts and Guides Quota for Level 1 and Level 2 posts. Eligible candidates must apply online by October 18, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚂 Southern Railway Recruitment 2026 (Scouts & Guides Quota)

The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Chennai, has released an employment notice (**RRC-01/S&G/2026-27**) for recruitment under the Scouts and Guides Quota. This is a specialized recruitment drive for active members of the scouting movement.

### 📋 Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 17
* **Level 2 Posts:** 3 Vacancies (Southern Railway & Integral Coach Factory)
* **Level 1 Posts:** 14 Vacancies (Distributed across Chennai, Tiruchchirappalli, Madurai, Palakkad, Thiruvananthapuram, and Salem divisions)

### 🎓 Educational Eligibility
**For Level 2:**
* Class 12th (minimum 50% marks) **OR**
* Matriculation + Course Completed Act Apprenticeship **OR**
* Matriculation + ITI (NCVT approved).

**For Level 1:**
* Class 10th pass **OR** ITI / NAC / Combined 10th + ITI/NAC.

### 🏕️ Mandatory Scouts & Guides Requirements
Candidates **must** satisfy the following to be eligible:
* Must be a **President’s Scout, Guide, Rover, Ranger**, or Himalayan Wood Badge holder.
* Active membership in a Scouts organization for the last **5 years**.
* Possession of a **Certificate of Activeness**.
* Participation in at least **two National Level** events and **two State Level** events.

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 19 September 2026 (9:00 AM)
* **Application Closing Date:** 18 October 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Age Limit Reference Date:** 01 January 2027

### ✍️ Selection Process
The recruitment is based on a total of **100 marks**:
1. **Written/Hybrid Examination (60 Marks):** 40 Objective questions (1 mark each) and 1 Essay (20 marks). *Note: 1/3 negative marking for objective questions.*
2. **Certificate Assessment (40 Marks):** Marks awarded for participation in National, State, and District rallies/courses.

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹500 (₹400 refundable upon appearing in exam)
* **SC/ST/Female/PwBD/EWS:** ₹250 (Fully refundable upon appearing in exam)

website_content.markdown_content:
## RSSB BCI & SCI Answer Key 2026

The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB), Jaipur, has officially released the **Provisional Answer Key, Master Question Papers, and Candidate Response Sheets** for the Basic Computer Instructor (BCI) and Senior Computer Instructor (SCI) recruitment (Advt No. 07/2026).

### 📅 Key Dates for Candidates
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 18 September 2026
* **Online Objection Window:** 19 September 2026 (00:01 AM) to 21 September 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Offline Objection Submission:** 22 September 2026 (10:00 AM) to 24 September 2026 (06:00 PM)

### 🛠 How to Download Answer Key & Response Sheet
1. Visit the official RSSB portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Answer Key'** or **'News & Events'** section.
3. Click on the link for **'Basic & Senior Computer Instructor Direct Recruitment 2026'**.
4. Select the appropriate post (BCI or SCI) and Paper (I or II).
5. Log in using your **SSO ID** to access your personal response sheet.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Objections
* **Online Mode:** Use the SSO login portal to submit justifications with supporting proof.
* **Offline Mode:** Submit objections in the prescribed format at the RSSB office in Jaipur.
* **Reference:** Always use the **Master Question Paper** for framing objections to avoid errors in question/option numbering.
* **Finality:** The final answer key and results will be prepared only after the expert panel reviews all valid objections.

website_content.summary: MPESB invites online applications for 655 vacancies of Subedar (Ministerial) Stenographer and Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) posts. The application window closes on 8 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MP Police Ministerial Recruitment 2026

The **Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB)** is recruiting for ministerial positions within the Madhya Pradesh Police Department. This is a prime opportunity for candidates with computer and stenography skills.

### 📌 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Subedar (Ministerial) Stenographer:** 135 Posts
* **Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial):** 520 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 655

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**1. Educational Qualification:**
* **All Posts:** Passed Higher Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board.
* **Technical Requirements:** Valid CPCT certificate with Hindi typing and an approved computer qualification (Degree/Diploma/Certificate).
* **Subedar (Steno) Specific:** Hindi shorthand speed of 100 words per minute.

**2. Age Limit (as of 08-10-2026):**
* **General/Other State Candidates:** Max 33 years
* **MP Female/SC/ST/OBC:** Max 38 years
* **Special Categories (Inter-caste/Vikram Award):** Up to 43 years

### 💰 Salary Scale
* **Subedar (Steno):** Rs. 36,200 to Rs. 1,14,800
* **ASI (Ministerial):** Rs. 19,500 to Rs. 62,000
*(Note: New recruits receive a percentage-based pay scale for the first 3 years as per MP Govt rules).*

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 24 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 8 October 2026
* **Correction Window Ends:** 13 October 2026
* **Written Exam Date:** From 3 November 2026

### ⚙️ Selection Process
1. **Online Written Exam:** 100 MCQs (GK, Logical, Mental Aptitude, Science, Arithmetic).
2. **Document Verification**
3. **Practical Test:** Hindi Stenography (Subedar) or Hindi Typing (ASI).
4. **Physical & Medical Examination**

### 💸 Application Fee
* **Unreserved:** Rs. 500
* **SC/ST/OBC/EWS (MP Domicile):** Rs. 250
* **Portal Charges:** Rs. 20 - Rs. 60 (depending on mode)

website_content.summary: WBMCC has released the schedule for Round 2 counselling for State and Private Management Quota MDS seats. Eligible NEET MDS 2026 qualified candidates can register online from September 18 to 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The West Bengal Medical Counseling Committee (WBMCC), under the Directorate of Medical Education, Govt of West Bengal, is conducting the **Round 2 Counselling** for MDS seats. This process covers both State Quota and Private Management Quota seats for the 2026 session.

## Important Dates
* **Online Registration & Fee Payment:** September 18, 2026, to September 20, 2026
* **Document Verification:** September 21 & 22, 2026
* **Online Seat Surrender:** September 23, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 23, 2026, to September 24, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 26, 2026
* **Reporting & Admission:** September 28 to September 30, 2026

## Eligibility Criteria

website_content.title: MP Police ASI & Subedar (Stenographer) Recruitment 2026 Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: Detailed guide on the written and practical examination syllabus for the MP Police ASI and Subedar (Steno) recruitment 2026 conducted by the MP Police Recruitment Board.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Prepare for the **MP Police ASI & Subedar (Stenographer) 2026** exams with a clear understanding of the selection process and syllabus. The recruitment is handled by the Madhya Pradesh Police Recruitment Board.

## Selection Process
Candidates must qualify in each of the following stages to proceed:
* **Written Exam:** Objective test (Paper 1 & 2).
* **Practical Test:** Skill-based test in Hindi Shorthand and Typing.
* **Document Verification:** Final verification of educational and category credentials.

## Exam Pattern

### 1. Written Examination
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Minimum Qualifying Marks:** 30%
* **Language:** Hindi & English
* **Negative Marking:** None

### 2. Practical Examination (100 Marks)
* **Subedar (Steno):** Hindi shorthand dictation (100 wpm) and transcription typing.
* **ASI (Steno):** Hindi typing of long passages (approx. 600 words each).

## Detailed Syllabus

### Paper 1: General Ability
* **General Knowledge:** Current Affairs, Indian History & Culture, Geography, Economy, Govt Schemes, and Environment.
* **Reasoning:** Verbal & Non-verbal, Series, Analogies, and Coding-Decoding.
* **Science & Mathematics:** Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, and Data Interpretation.

### Paper 2: Language & Awareness
* **Hindi Language:** Grammar, Vocabulary, Reading Comprehension, Antonyms & Synonyms.
* **English Language:** Grammar, Vocabulary, Reading Comprehension, Sentence Formation.
* **General Knowledge:** Reiteration of key GK topics including Current Affairs and History.

## Preparation Tips
* Solve **previous year papers** to understand weightage.
* Practice **Hindi shorthand/typing daily** to improve speed and accuracy.
* Use a timer while solving Math and Reasoning questions.

website_content.title: WB NEET UG Counselling 2026 Revised Schedule
website_content.summary: WBMCC has announced the revised counselling schedule for MBBS and BDS admissions for the 2026 session. This process covers State, Private Management, and NRI quota seats across West Bengal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC)** is facilitating admissions for MBBS and BDS courses in both government and private medical/dental colleges. The process is based on the **NEET UG 2026** qualifying examination.

## Key Highlights
* **Courses:** MBBS and BDS
* **Quota Covered:** 85% State Quota, Private Management Quota, and NRI Quota
* **Mode of Counselling:** Online
* **Rounds:** Three main rounds followed by an Online Stray Vacancy Round

## Important Dates
* **Round 1 Registration:** Began August 13, 2026 (Closed Aug 23)
* **Round 1 Allotment Result:** August 31, 2026
* **Round 2 Allotment Result:** September 15, 2026
* **Physical Reporting (Round 2):** September 16 to September 18, 2026

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. Visit the official WBMCC portal.
2. Register using **NEET UG roll number**, application number, and date of birth.
3. Complete the online counselling fee payment.
4. Upload required documents and complete verification.
5. Fill and **lock your college/course choices** before the deadline.
6. Check seat allotment results and report physically to the allotted institute if selected.

## Important Instructions
* Ensure you click **'Lock Choices'** to avoid disqualification or automatic system processing.
* Keep original documents and demand drafts ready for physical reporting.
* Failure to report within the stipulated window may result in forfeiture of the seat.
* Regularly monitor the official notice board for Round 3 and Stray Vacancy updates.

website_content.title: KVIC Recruitment 2026: Young Professional, Advisor & Senior Consultant Vacancies
website_content.summary: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) invites applications for 50 contractual positions across various specializations. The deadline for online submission is September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KVIC Recruitment 2026 Overview

The **Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)**, under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, is hiring for various contractual positions at its Central Office in **Mumbai**.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Young Professional:** 20 Posts
* **Advisor:** 15 Posts
* **Senior Consultant:** 15 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 50

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Young Professional**
* **Education:** Full-time Postgraduate degree in relevant fields (Accounts, HR, Textile, Law, Marketing, Civil Engg, Science, or Mass Comm).
* **Age Limit:** Below 27 years (as of 01-10-2026).

**2. Advisor**
* **Requirement:** Exclusively for retired/voluntarily retired Govt/PSU personnel.
* **Experience:** Minimum 15 years of relevant experience.
* **Age Limit:** 40 to 65 years.

**3. Senior Consultant**
* **Education:** Postgraduate or Management degree.
* **Experience:** At least 5 years of experience in the relevant field.
* **Age Limit:** Below 39 years.

### 💰 Remuneration
* **Young Professional:** ₹25,000 - ₹30,000 + Conveyance (₹2,500 - ₹3,000).
* **Senior Consultant:** ₹30,000 - ₹40,000 + Conveyance (₹2,500 - ₹3,000).
* **Advisor:** As per DoPT guidelines (Basic pension deducted from last basic pay).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** Active
* **Last Date to Apply:** 30 September 2026 (11:59 PM)

### 🛠 Selection Process
1. Screening of online applications
2. Shortlisting based on qualification/experience
3. Document Verification
4. Personal Interview

### 📝 Application Mode
* **Mode:** Online only via the official recruitment portal.
* **Required Documents:** Photo, Signature, DOB Proof, PG Degree, Experience Certificates, and a 200-word experience summary.

website_content.title: UPSSSC PET Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026
website_content.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the detailed syllabus and exam pattern for the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2026. Qualifying PET is mandatory for appearing in upcoming UP Group B and C recruitment exams.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UPSSSC PET Overview 2026

The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) conducts the **Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET)** as a mandatory eligibility/screening exam for recruitment to various Group B and Group C posts across Uttar Pradesh.

* **Exam Name:** UPSSSC PET 2026
* **Conducting Body:** Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission
* **Exam Mode:** Offline (OMR Based)
* **Question Type:** Objective Type MCQs
* **Total Questions:** 100
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Duration:** 2 Hours (120 Minutes)
* **Negative Marking:** ¼ (0.25) mark per wrong answer

---

## Subject-Wise Marks Distribution

* **Indian History:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Indian National Movement:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Geography:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Indian Economy:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Indian Constitution & Public Administration:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **General Science:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Elementary Arithmetic:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **General Hindi:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **General English:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Logic & Reasoning:** 5 Questions | 5 Marks
* **Current Affairs:** 10 Questions | 10 Marks
* **General Awareness:** 10 Questions | 10 Marks
* **Analysis of Hindi Unread Passages (2 Passages):** 10 Questions | 10 Marks
* **Graph Interpretation (2 Graphs):** 10 Questions | 10 Marks
* **Table Interpretation & Analysis (2 Tables):** 10 Questions | 10 Marks

---

## UPSSSC PET Selection Process 2026

1. **Stage 1 - PET (Preliminary Eligibility Test):** Common screening test to obtain a valid PET score.
2. **Stage 2 - Post-Specific Mains Exam:** Candidates with valid PET scores apply for specific recruitments (e.g., Lekhpal, Junior Assistant, Excise Constable).
3. **Document Verification / Skill Test / Physical Test:** As per specific post requirement.

website_content.markdown_content:
## AIIMS Jammu Senior Resident/Demonstrator Recruitment 2026 (Cycle-2)

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Vijaypur, Jammu has released the **Cycle-2 Rolling Advertisement** for the recruitment of Senior Residents (Medical) and Senior Demonstrators (Non-Medical).

### 📌 Key Recruitment Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 86 (Tentative, including backlog posts)
* **Total Departments:** 35 Specialties
* **Application Mode:** Online
* **Cut-off Date for Eligibility:** 30.09.2026

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Application Start Date:** 19.09.2026 (Saturday)
* **Online Application Closing Date:** 30.09.2026 (Wednesday)
* **Interview Reporting Time:** 9:30 AM
* **Interview Date:** To be notified separately

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Medical (SR):** Postgraduate medical degree (**MD/MS/DNB**) in the relevant subject. Certain super-specialty posts require **DM/MCh/DNB** or an eligible MD/DNB in an allied broad specialty.
* **Non-Medical (Sr. Demonstrator):** Specifically for Anatomy and Pharmacology departments; requires **M.Sc./M.Biotech plus a Ph.D.** in the concerned or allied subject.

### 🏥 Vacancy Distribution (Highlights)
Vacancies are spread across 35 departments. Key vacancies include:
* **Trauma & Emergency Medicine:** 9 posts
* **General Surgery:** 8 posts
* **Anaesthesiology:** 7 posts
* **General Medicine:** 6 posts
* **Hospital Administration:** 6 posts
* **Paediatric Surgery:** 3 posts
* **Radiology (Radio-Diagnosis):** 3 posts

### 📝 Important Instructions
* **Cross-Department Eligibility:** Candidates from 'Column A' departments (e.g., General Surgery) may be considered for 'Column B' departments (e.g., Neurosurgery, Plastic Surgery) if no suitable candidates are found.
* **Certification:** OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must be issued **on or after 01.04.2026**.
* **NOC:** In-service candidates must provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) on the date of the interview.
* **Venue:** Board Room, 6th Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS Vijaypur, Jammu.

website_content.title: AIIMS INI CET January 2027 Registration & Exam Dates
website_content.summary: AIIMS New Delhi invites applications for the Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test (INI CET) January 2027 session for MD, MS, MDS, and other PG programmes. The registration window opens on September 16, 2026, and closes on October 13, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
AIIMS New Delhi is conducting the **INI CET January 2027** session. This is a common postgraduate medical entrance exam for admission to premier institutes across India, including **AIIMS institutions, JIPMER Puducherry, PGIMER Chandigarh, NIMHANS Bengaluru, and SCTIMST Thiruvananthapuram**.

## Courses Offered
* MD
* MS
* MDS
* DM (6-year)
* MCh (6-year)
* Other notified postgraduate programmes

## Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** September 16, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** October 13, 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Image Correction Window:** October 17-19, 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** October 26, 2026
* **Exam Date:** November 1, 2026

## How to Apply
1. **One Time Registration (OTR):** Complete the OTR on the official portal (DigiLocker verification recommended).
2. **Application Form:** Log in to fill in personal, educational, and internship details.
3. **Document Upload:** Upload photograph, signature, and thumb impression as per prescribed formats.
4. **Payment:** Pay the category-wise fee via online modes (Credit/Debit card/Net Banking).
5. **Submission:** Review all details and download the confirmation page.

## Key Instructions
* **No Extensive Correction:** Be careful during submission; only a limited window is available from Oct 17-19.
* **Fee Policy:** Application fees are non-refundable. 
* **PwBD Exemption:** PwBD candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Indian Navy Agniveer MR Result 2026

The Indian Navy has announced the results for the **Agniveer Matric Recruit (MR)** Stage I Computer Based Test held on May 14th and 15th, 2026. Candidates can now access their qualifying status and merit list via the official portal.

| :--- | :--- |

| OBC | 50-60% |

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official recruitment portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Agniveer MR Result 2026'** link.
3. Log in using your **Registered Email ID** and **Password**.

* **Exam Date Release Date:** 18 September 2026

## How to Download Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official KEA portal.
2. Look for the **PGCET category (M.Sc AHS / MPT)** admit card link.

website_content.title: GBPUAT Recruitment 2026: Associate and Assistant Professor Vacancies
website_content.summary: GBPUAT invites offline applications for 45 backlog vacancies of Associate and Assistant Professors across various academic disciplines. The application deadline is 21 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GBPUAT Recruitment 2026 Overview

Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology (GBPUAT) has announced recruitment for **Associate Professor** and **Assistant Professor** positions to fill backlog vacancies (SC, ST, and OBC).

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 45
* **Associate Professor:** 28 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 17 Posts
* **Colleges Involved:** Agriculture, Community Science, Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Basic Sciences and Humanities, Technology, and Fisheries.

### 💰 Salary & Pay Scale
* **Associate Professor:** Academic Level 13A (Entry Pay: **Rs. 1,31,400**)
* **Assistant Professor:** Academic Level 10 (Entry Pay: **Rs. 57,700**)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

#### Associate Professor
* **General/Tech/Fisheries:** Ph.D. in relevant discipline, Master's with 55%, 8 years teaching/research experience, and at least 7 publications.
* **Veterinary Sciences:** Registered with Veterinary Council, Ph.D. and Master's (55%), 8 years experience, and 7 publications.

#### Assistant Professor
* **General:** Master's degree (55%) + NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. exemption).
* **Veterinary:** B.V.Sc. & A.H., Registered with Council, Master's (55%) + NET/SLET/SET.
* **Technology:** BE/BTech and ME/MTech/MS with first class in at least one degree.

### 💸 Application Fee
* **OBC:** Rs. 1,500
* **SC/ST:** Rs. 750
* **Payment Mode:** Demand Draft (DD) in favor of *Comptroller, G.B. Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar*.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Download the official application form from the university website.
2. Fill in details and affix a self-attested passport-size photograph.
3. Attach self-attested copies of all certificates, experience letters, and the Demand Draft.
4. Send the completed application via **Speed Post or Registered Post**.
5. **Deadline:** 21 October 2026 (by 5:00 PM).

### ⚠️ Important Note
These are **backlog vacancies** reserved for SC, ST, and OBC candidates. Uttarakhand domicile is required for state-specific reservation benefits.

website_content.summary: IFCI Limited invites online applications for 14 contractual positions of Associate Director and Senior Associate across various domains. The deadline for submission is September 27, 2026.

## IFCI Recruitment 2026 Overview
IFCI Limited, a Government of India Undertaking, is seeking experienced professionals for high-level contractual appointments for an initial period of three years.

## Vacancy Details
* **Associate Director:** 2 Posts
* **Associate Director (Estates, Services and Administration):** 1 Post

Candidates must possess degrees from recognized institutions (UGC, AICTE, ICAI, etc.) such as:
* **Finance/Management:** CA, CMA, CFA, MBA, PGDM, or B.Com.
* **Technical:** B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or Chemical Engineering.
* **HR:** Postgraduate degree/diploma in HRM, Personnel Management, or Industrial Relations.

### 2. Experience Requirements
* **Associate Director:** Minimum 15 years of experience in PSBs, financial sector, or consulting.
* **Senior Associate:** Minimum 6 years of post-qualification experience in the respective domain.

### 3. Age Limit (as of 31 July 2026)
* **Associate Director:** Up to 62 years
* **Associate Director (Estates):** Up to 55 years
* **Senior Associate (All):** Up to 38 years

## Selection Process
* **Shortlisting:** Based on the submitted online Resume/Biodata.
* **Interview:** Personal or online interview for shortlisted candidates.
* **Verification:** Document verification process.

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 02 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 27 September 2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 31 July 2026

website_content.title: MPPSC State Forest Service (SFSE) Main Exam Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: The MPPSC has officially released the admit cards for the State Forest Service (SFSE) Main Exam 2026. The main examination is scheduled to be conducted on 27 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## MPPSC SFSE Main Exam 2026 Overview
The Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has announced the hall tickets for the **Rajya Van Seva Mukhya Pariksha 2026**. Candidates who qualified for the preliminary stage can now access their admit cards via the official portal.

## Key Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Main Exam Date:** 27 September 2026
* **Preliminary Exam Date:** 26 April 2026

## How to Download Your Admit Card
1. Visit the official portal: **mppsc.mponline.gov.in**
2. Enter your **Application Number** and **Date of Birth**.
3. Enter the displayed captcha text.
4. Submit the details to view your hall ticket.
5. Download and take a clear printout for the exam day.

## Essential Documents to Carry
* **Printed Admit Card:** A clear hard copy of the MPPSC SFSE Main Exam Admit Card 2026.
* **Photo ID Proof:** Original government-issued ID (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, or Voter ID).

## Important Instructions
* **Verification:** Check your name, photograph, and exam centre details immediately upon downloading.
* **Reporting:** Arrive at the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on the card.
* **Discrepancies:** Report any errors on the admit card to MPPSC immediately.
* **Entry:** No candidate will be allowed entry without a valid admit card and original photo ID.

website_content.title: UP Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 207 Posts in Gorakhpur
website_content.summary: Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur has invited online applications from eligible female candidates for 207 Anganwadi Sahayika posts. Eligible candidates can submit their forms online by 5 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Overview

The **Child Development Services and Nutrition Department, Uttar Pradesh** has issued a recruitment notification for **207 Anganwadi Sahayika** contractual posts under the Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur. This recruitment is exclusively for eligible **female candidates** residing in the specified Gram Sabha or urban ward.

### Key Recruitment Highlights

* **Recruiting Body:** Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur
* **Department:** Child Development Services and Nutrition Department, UP
* **Post Name:** Anganwadi Sahayika
* **Total Vacancies:** 207
* **Appointment Type:** Honorarium-based contractual appointment
* **Eligible Gender:** Female candidates only
* **Selection Method:** Merit-based (No written exam, No interview)

---

## Vacancy Details (Category-Wise Breakdown)

* **Unreserved (UR):** 97
* **OBC:** 52
* **SC/ST:** 58
* **Total Posts:** 207

*Major sectors include Gorakhpur City (116 posts), Bansgaon (12 posts), Gagaha (10 posts), Badhalganj (8 posts), and Khajni (8 posts).* 

---

## Eligibility Criteria

### 1. Educational Qualification
* Candidates must have passed **Intermediate (12th Class)** or an equivalent examination from a recognized board or institution.

### 2. Age Limit (As on 01 July 2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 18 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 35 Years
* Date of birth recorded in the **High School Certificate** will be considered valid proof.

### 3. Local Residence Requirement
* **Rural Vacancies:** The applicant must be a resident of the same **Gram Sabha**.
* **Urban Vacancies:** The applicant must be a resident of the same **Ward**.

### 4. Annual Family Income Ceiling
* **Rural Areas:** Maximum **Rs. 46,080** per year
* **Urban Areas:** Maximum **Rs. 56,460** per year
* Income certificate must be issued by a competent officer not below the rank of **Tehsildar**.

---

## Selection Process

* **Merit-Based Selection:** Prepared according to prescribed UP Government rules based on academic standards.
* **No Examination & No Interview:** Candidates will be selected directly on merit and document verification.
* **Document Verification:** Final selection depends on the verification of original certificates and proof of local residence/income.

---

## Required Scanned Documents

1. Recent Passport Size Photograph & Signature
2. High School (10th) Certificate (for DOB proof)
3. Intermediate (12th) Certificate & Marksheet
4. Higher Educational Certificates (if applicable)
5. Digitally Signed Residence Certificate (Online)
6. Digitally Signed Caste Certificate (if applicable)
7. Income Certificate (issued by Tehsildar)
8. Special Reservation Proof (Widow Certificate / Divorced Court Order, if applicable)

---

## How to Apply

1. Visit the official online recruitment portal.
2. Locate the **Gorakhpur Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026** section.
3. Verify your Gram Sabha / Ward vacancy details and eligibility.
4. Complete the online registration and carefully fill in personal, academic, residence, and income details.
5. Upload clean scanned self-attested copies of required certificates.
6. Submit the online application on or before **5 October 2026 (12:00 Midnight)**.
7. Print/Save a copy of the final submitted application form for reference. *(No hard copy needs to be sent by post)*

---

## Important Dates

* **Notification Date:** 14 September 2026
* **Last Date to Apply Online:** 05 October 2026 (up to 12:00 Midnight)

website_content.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Board of School Education (JKBOSE) has officially released the date sheet for Class 10, 11, and 12 Annual Regular Examinations 2026 (Winter Zone). Exams for Kashmir Division, Jammu Winter Zone, and UT of Ladakh will commence from October 19, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## JKBOSE Board Exam Date Sheet 2026 Overview

The Jammu and Kashmir Board of School Education (JKBOSE) has released the official timetable for the **Class 10, 11, and 12 Annual Regular Examinations 2026 (October-November Session)**. This schedule applies to all students studying in the Kashmir Division, winter-zone areas of the Jammu Division, and the Union Territory of Ladakh. All written examinations will start at **11:00 AM**.

## Important Examination Dates

* **Class 10 Exam Period:** October 19, 2026 – November 18, 2026
* **Class 10 First Exam:** Mathematics (October 19, 2026)
* **Class 10 Last Exam:** Computer Science (November 18, 2026)
* **Class 12 Exam Period:** October 21, 2026 – November 21, 2026
* **Class 12 First Exam:** General English (October 21, 2026)
* **Class 12 Last Exam:** Computer Science / Information Practices (November 21, 2026)

## Key Exam Day Instructions

* **Reporting Time:** All examinations commence at **11:00 AM**. Students must reach their respective exam centres well before the scheduled time.
* **Admit Card & Stationery:** Carry the official admit card and authorized stationery to the examination hall once issued.
* **Practical Exams:** Dates for practical exams will be released separately by the board.
* **Updates & Revisions:** Any changes due to unavoidable circumstances will be published on the official JKBOSE portal.

## How to Download JKBOSE Date Sheet 2026 PDF

* Visit the official portal of JKBOSE.
* Navigate to the **Student Corner** or **Notifications** section on the homepage.
* Click on the relevant link for **Class 10**, **Class 11**, or **Class 12** Winter Zone Date Sheet 2026.
* View and download the timetable PDF file for future reference.

## KSET July 2026 Hall Ticket Overview
The admit cards for the **Kerala State Eligibility Test (KSET) July 2026** cycle are now active. All candidates are required to carry a hard copy of their hall ticket to the exam venue to gain entry.

### 📅 Key Dates & Information
* **Exam Date:** 20 September 2026 (Sunday)
* **Last Date to Download Admit Card:** 20 September 2026
* **Conducting Body:** LBS Centre for Science & Technology, Govt. of Kerala
* **Exam Locations:** 14 Districts across Kerala

### ⏰ Exam Schedule & Shift Timings
| Paper | Subjects | Timing |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Paper I** | General Knowledge (Part A) & Teaching Aptitude (Part B) | 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon |
| **Paper II** | Subject-Specific | 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM |

### 🛠️ How to Download Your Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official LBS Centre for Science & Technology portal.
2. Navigate to the KSET July 2026 hall ticket link.
3. Enter your **Registration ID** or **Registered Mobile Number**.
4. Enter the **Site Access Key** (received via SMS).
5. Verify your details and print a **colour copy** of the admit card.

### 📋 Mandatory Checklist for Exam Day
**Items to Carry:**
* Colour printout of the KSET Hall Ticket
* Original valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, etc.)
* Passport-size photograph (matching registration)
* Transparent blue or black ballpoint pen

**Prohibited Items:**
* Electronic gadgets, communication devices, Bluetooth devices, and earphones.
* Study materials or stationery beyond what is permitted.

website_content.title: AIMA MAT CBT Admit Card September 2026
website_content.summary: The All India Management Association (AIMA) has released the admit cards for the MAT CBT September 2026 session. Registered candidates can now download their hall tickets via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIMA MAT CBT Admit Card 2026

**The All India Management Association (AIMA)** has officially released the Admit Cards for the **Management Aptitude Test (MAT)** September 2026 session for candidates opting for the Computer Based Test (CBT) mode.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **CBT Admit Card Release:** September 17, 2026
* **CBT Exam Date:** September 20, 2026
* **PBT Admit Card Release:** September 10, 2026
* **PBT Exam Date:** September 13, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download Your Admit Card
1. Visit the official MAT website.
2. Navigate to the **Candidate Login** section on the homepage.
3. Enter your **Registration Number** and **Password** to sign in.
4. Locate and click the **'MAT CBT Admit Card'** download link on your dashboard.
5. Review the details and download the PDF.
6. **Print two clear copies** on A4-size paper for the exam day.

### ⚠️ Essential Instructions
* **Mandatory Document:** Entry to the exam hall is strictly prohibited without a valid printed admit card.
* **Center Allotment:** Candidates cannot request a change in the test center once the admit card is issued.
* **Delivery:** Admit cards are NOT sent via post or email; they must be downloaded from the portal.
* **Reporting:** Reach the center well before the reporting time mentioned on your hall ticket.
* **Support:** For any discrepancies, email AIMA immediately at [email protected].

website_content.title: Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) Teaching Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia invites applications for 46 faculty positions, including Professors and Assistant Professors, across various departments. The online application window closes on October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) Teaching Recruitment 2026

Jamia Millia Islamia has released an official notification for the recruitment of teaching faculty members in various Engineering and Science departments in New Delhi.

**Key Vacancy Details:**
* **Professor:** 10 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 12 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 22 Posts
* **Principal (University Polytechnic):** 01 Post
* **Head of Section (Civil Engineering):** 01 Post
* **Total Vacancies:** 46

**Eligibility Criteria:**
* **Professor/Associate Professor:** Ph.D. in the relevant field with a minimum of 8-10 years of teaching/research/industry experience and required research publications.
* **Assistant Professor (Engineering):** B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech in the relevant branch with first class in at least one degree.
* **Assistant Professor (Science/Humanities):** Master's degree (55%) with NET/SLET/SET qualification (Ph.D. holders may be exempt).
* **Principal/HoS:** Ph.D. with 12 to 20 years of extensive experience depending on the role.

**Important Dates:**
* **Online Application Start:** 16 September 2026
* **Online Application Deadline:** 6 October 2026
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline:** 16 October 2026

**Application Fee:**
* **UR/OBC:** ₹1,500
* **SC/ST:** ₹750
* **PwD:** Exempted

**Selection Process:**
* **Shortlisting:** Based on academic scores and qualifications.
* **Final Selection:** Based exclusively on the performance in the **Interview**.

**Crucial Instructions:**
* **Dual Submission:** Both online application and a physical hard copy of the application are **mandatory**.
* **Separate Applications:** A separate application and fee must be submitted for each post applied for.
