website_content.title: WB NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Counselling Schedule
website_content.summary: WBMCC has announced the tentative Round 2 counselling schedule for State Quota and Private Management Quota seats for NEET MDS 2026. Online registration commences on September 18, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Directorate of Medical Education, Government of West Bengal, has released the tentative schedule for **NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Counselling** for both State Quota and Private Management Quota seats.

## Key Counselling Dates
* **Online Registration & Fee Payment:** September 18, 2026, to September 20, 2026 (4 PM for reg / 12 midnight for fees).
* **Candidate Verification:** September 21 and September 22, 2026 (11 AM to 4 PM).
* **Online Seat Surrender:** September 23, 2026 (10 AM to 4 PM).
* **Seat Matrix Publication:** September 23, 2026 (After 4 PM).
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 23, 2026 (6 PM) to September 24, 2026 (12 Noon).
* **Allotment Result Publication:** September 26, 2026 (After 12 Noon).
* **Reporting & Admission:** September 28 to September 30, 2026 (11 AM to 4 PM).

## Important Instructions
* **In-Service Candidates:** Must complete verification at **Swasthya Bhawan**.
* **Document Requirement:** Reporting must be done with original documents, the requisite college fee, and a bond.
* **Upgraded Candidates:** Those upgraded in Round 2 must provide a server-generated relieving letter from their previous institute.
* **Timeline:** All deadlines are based on server time; candidates are advised not to wait until the last moment.

website_content.title: AP EAMCET (EAPCET) Phase 3 Seat Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: APSCHE has released the AP EAMCET Third and Final Phase seat allotment results on September 17, 2026. Candidates must complete self-reporting and college reporting by September 19, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AP EAMCET Phase 3 Seat Allotment 2026

The **Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)**, via the Department of Technical Education, has announced the release of the Third and Final Phase seat allotment results. This round determines the final college and branch allocations for eligible candidates.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Result Release Date:** September 17, 2026
* **Self-Reporting & College Reporting:** September 17 to September 19, 2026
* **Bi.P.C. Stream Web Options Extension:** Up to September 20, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check and Download Allotment Order
1. Navigate to the official counselling portal.
2. Select the link **'AP EAPCET/EAMCET Phase 3 / Final Phase Seat Allotment Result'**.
3. Enter your **Hall Ticket Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Submit the details to view your allotted college and branch.
5. Download and print at least two copies of the **provisional seat allotment order** for reporting.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Reporting:** Candidates must complete both online self-reporting and physical reporting at the allotted college between **September 17 and 19**.
* **Document Verification:** Carry all original certificates and photocopies for on-the-spot verification at the college.
* **Seat Cancellation:** Failure to complete reporting formalities within the deadline will result in the cancellation of the allotted seat.
* **Bi.P.C. Stream:** Note that the Bi.P.C. stream follows a separate timeline with options extended to September 20.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The High Court of Tripura, Agartala, has issued Notification No. F.4(22)-HC/2026/21715-16 regarding the **Written Screening Test** for recruitment to the posts of **Junior Administrative Assistant (JAA)**. This follows Advertisement No. HC-02/2026.

* **Candidates Declared Eligible:** 4,712
* **Candidates Declared Ineligible:** 133

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Call Letter Download Starts:** 01 October 2026
* **Written Screening Test Date:** 11 October 2026 (Sunday)
* **Reporting Time:** 10:00 A.M. onwards

## Exam Details
* **Exam City:** Agartala
* **Venue:** Will be mentioned on the individual call letter.

## Steps to Download Call Letter
1. Visit the official portal: **thc.nic.in**
2. Navigate to the **'Recruitment [Online Application]'** tab.
3. Log in using the credentials created during the original application process.
4. Download and print the call letter (available from **October 1, 2026**).

## Important Instructions
* Ensure you have your original login credentials ready.
* Only candidates on the **Eligible List** will be issued a call letter.
* Carefully verify your name and registration number in the annexed list.

## Gorakhpur Anganwadi Karyakatri Recruitment 2026

The Office of the District Programme Officer, Gorakhpur, has released the official notification for the recruitment of **Anganwadi Karyakatri (Anganwadi Workers)** on a contractual/honorarium basis.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 326 Posts
* **Post Name:** Anganwadi Karyakatri
* **Job Location:** Gorakhpur District (Urban & Rural CDP areas)
* **Selection Method:** Merit-based (No Written Exam, No Interview)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Only female candidates are eligible.
* **Educational Qualification:** Minimum **Intermediate (12th Standard)** or equivalent. Higher qualifications (up to Post Graduation) will be considered for merit ranking.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of July 1, 2026).
* **Residency:** Mandatory residency in the same Gram Sabha (rural) or Ward (urban) where the vacancy exists.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** September 15, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** October 5, 2026 (12:00 Midnight)
* **Age Reckoning Date:** July 1, 2026

### ⚙️ Selection Process
The selection is **fully online and merit-based**. Candidates will be ranked based on their highest educational qualification. No written examination or interview will be conducted.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official portal **upanganwadibharti.in**.
2. Select the relevant Child Development Project (CDP) area.
3. Fill in the application form with accurate details.
4. Upload self-attested digital copies of required documents.
5. Submit the form before the deadline.

website_content.summary: CMWSSB is inviting applications for 108 Graduate and Technician Diploma Apprentice positions for Tamil Nadu residents. Apply online via the NATS portal by October 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CMWSSB Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB) has announced recruitment for Apprentices to provide practical training to engineering graduates and diploma holders.

### Vacancy Distribution
* **Graduate Apprentices:** 76 Posts
* **Technician Diploma Apprentices:** 32 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 108

### Eligibility Criteria
* **Domicile:** Candidates must belong to **Tamil Nadu**.
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * **Graduate Apprentice:** Full-time B.E. or B.Tech in a relevant engineering discipline.
    * **Technician Apprentice:** Full-time Diploma in a relevant engineering discipline.
* **Eligible Passing Years:** 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and May 2026.
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Candidates must be registered on the **NATS portal** with accurate qualification percentages.

### Stipend & Training
* **Graduate Apprentice:** Rs. 12,300 per month
* **Technician Diploma Apprentice:** Rs. 10,900 per month
* **Duration:** One year (as per Apprenticeship Amendment Act, 1973).

### Selection Process
1. **Merit-based Shortlisting:** Based on the percentage of marks obtained in the degree/diploma.
2. **Verification:** Certificate verification at CMWSSB, Chennai.
*Note: No written examination or interview will be conducted.*

### Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 17 October 2026
* **Shortlist Release:** 4th week of October 2026
* **Certificate Verification:** 1st week of November 2026 (Tentative)

### How to Apply
Candidates must apply through the NATS 2.0 portal using the establishment user ID: **STNCHS000035**.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Examination Overview
Kerala University has officially published the time table for the **Sixth Semester B.A Honours Degree Programme in English Language and Literature Examination, September 2026**. This notification (No. ES X/2026) was issued by the Controller of Examinations on 17.09.2026.

## Applicable Candidates
* **2022 Admission** Supplementary candidates

### 💳 Application Fee
* **General & Others:** Rs. 500

website_content.title: Odisha NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Reporting for MBBS & BDS
website_content.summary: The OJEE Committee has commenced the Round 2 reporting process for candidates allotted MBBS and BDS seats under the state quota. Reporting is scheduled for September 17 and 18, 2026, at the OJEE Cell, Bhubaneswar.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Odisha NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Reporting Overview

The **Odisha Joint Entrance Examination (OJEE) Committee** has announced the reporting schedule for candidates who have been provisionally allotted seats in MBBS and BDS courses during Round 2 of the state quota counselling.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Provisional Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Allotment Letter Download:** September 11, 2026 (after 7:30 PM)
* **Reporting Dates:** September 17 and 18, 2026

### 🛠️ Step-by-Step Reporting Process
1. **Download Allotment Letter:** Get your provisional seat allotment letter from the official OJEE portal.
2. **Document Preparation:** Gather all original documents and prepare **three self-attested photocopy sets** of each.
3. **Fee Payment:** Pay the applicable admission fee as per OJEE instructions.
4. **Bond Signing:** Sign the required admission bond (Read terms carefully regarding rural posting/discontinuation).
5. **Physical Reporting:** Visit the **OJEE Cell, Gandamunda, Bhubaneswar**, on your scheduled date.
6. **Verification:** Complete the document verification process and finalize admission formalities.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Strict Timeline:** Report only on the specified dates; late entries may not be accommodated.
* **Document Requirement:** Both originals and self-attested copies are mandatory.
* **Seat Upgrade:** Candidates upgraded from Round 1 to Round 2 automatically forfeit their previous seat.
* **Stay Updated:** Regularly check the official website for any revised schedules.

website_content.summary: Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital (SGMH), Delhi, is inviting applications for 52 Senior Resident positions across various specialties via a walk-in interview on September 24, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SGMH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026

**Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital (SGMH)**, under the Government of NCT of Delhi, is recruiting **52 Senior Residents** for various medical departments on an ad-hoc basis.

### 📌 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Medicine:** 8
* **Radiology:** 8
* **Paediatrics:** 7
* **Surgery:** 6
* **Orthopaedics:** 5
* **Anaesthesia:** 5
* **Ophthalmology:** 4
* **Pathology:** 3
* **Other Specialties:** Psychiatry, OBGYN, Forensic Medicine, Dermatology, Microbiology.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** MBBS degree from a recognized university + Postgraduate Degree, Diploma, or DNB in the concerned specialty.
* **Registration:** Valid registration with the **Delhi Medical Council (DMC)** is mandatory. (Proof of application accepted).
* **Experience Clause:** Candidates must not have completed 3 years of Senior Residency elsewhere. However, for shortage specialties (Radiology, Anaesthesia, Forensic Medicine), Non-PG candidates with 2 years of experience may be considered.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **45 years** (as of 24 Sept 2026). Relaxations apply for OBC (3 yrs), SC/ST (5 yrs), and PwD (5 yrs).

### 💰 Salary & Appointment
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 (Level 11 under 7th CPC).
* **Appointment Type:** Ad-hoc.
* **Initial Period:** 89 days or until a regular candidate joins.

### 🗓️ Walk-in Interview Details
* **Date:** 24 September 2026
* **Registration Timing:** 9:00 AM to 12:00 Noon
* **Venue:** 4th Floor Conference Hall, Administrative Block, Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital, Mangolpuri, Delhi - 110083.

### 📄 Required Documents (Original + Self-Attested Copies)
* Completed application form with passport-size photo.
* MBBS and PG degree/diploma mark sheets and certificates.
* DMC registration certificate.
* Date of Birth certificate (Class 10th).
* Aadhaar Card and Category certificate (OBC/EWS certificates must be for the current financial year).
* NOC for candidates currently in government service.

website_content.markdown_content:
## UPSC ESE 2027 Recruitment Overview
**Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** is inviting applications for the Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2027. This prestigious exam recruits candidates for Group 'A' and Group 'B' services across various Central Government Ministries and Departments.

### 🛠️ Engineering Disciplines
* Civil Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Online Application Start:** 16.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 06.10.2026
* **Preliminary Examination (Stage-I):** 31.01.2027
* **Main Examination (Stage-II):** 18.06.2027

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** A degree in Engineering from a recognized University or specified professional membership examinations (e.g., Institution of Engineers India).
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 30 years as of 01.01.2027.
* **Age Relaxations:** 
    * SC/ST: Up to 5 years
    * OBC: Up to 3 years
    * PwBD: Up to 10 years

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Stage-I (Preliminary):** Objective type (General Studies & Engineering Aptitude + Discipline specific).
2. **Stage-II (Main):** Conventional type (Discipline specific).
3. **Stage-III (Interview):** Personality Test.

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹200
* **Female/SC/ST/PwBD:** Exempted

website_content.summary: The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission has released the admit cards for the Combined Civil Services Examination-I (CCSE-I). Candidates appearing for the Group 1 Preliminary Examination on September 27, 2026, can now download their hall tickets.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TNPSC Group 1 Preliminary Exam 2026

The **Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC)** has officially released the hall tickets for the **Combined Civil Services Examination-I (Group I Services)**. It is mandatory for all candidates to carry a printed copy of the admit card to the examination center.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Hall Ticket Release Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Prelims Exam Date:** 27 September 2026 (Sunday)
* **Exam Timing:** 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM
* **Duration:** 3 Hours (180 Minutes)

### 🛠️ How to Download Hall Ticket
1. Visit the official TNPSC portal at **tnpsc.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **'Hall Ticket Download'** section on the homepage.
3. Select the link for **Combined Civil Services Examination-I**.
4. Log in using your **OTR ID / Registration Number** and **Date of Birth**.
5. Verify your details and download the PDF.
6. Take a clear printout for the exam day.

### 📄 Required Documents for Exam Day
To avoid denial of entry, candidates must carry:
* **Printed Hall Ticket** (TNPSC Group 1 2026)
* **Passport-size Photograph**
* **Original Photo ID** (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN Card, Driving License, or Passport)
* **Black Ballpoint Pen**

### ⚠️ Key Exam Guidelines
* **Reporting Time:** Reach the center well before the time mentioned on the hall ticket.
* **Prohibited Items:** Mobile phones and electronic gadgets are strictly banned.
* **Verification:** Double-check your name, photo, and exam center address on the admit card.

website_content.title: Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) FTE Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: HCL is hiring 43 Executives on a Fixed Tenure basis across 11 specialized disciplines. Apply by October 5, 2026, for a high-paying PSU opportunity.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
**Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL)**, a Miniratna Category-I CPSE, is inviting applications for the engagement of Executives on a **Fixed Tenure basis** for various projects across India. 

## Key Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **43** across 11 Disciplines:
* **Electrical:** 8 Posts
* **Geology & Mechanical:** 6 Posts each
* **Civil & M&HS:** 4 Posts each
* **Industrial Safety, Mineral Processing, Finance, Survey:** 3 Posts each
* **Environment Management:** 2 Posts
* **Human Resources:** 1 Post

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Engineering/Technical:** Bachelor's degree in relevant field (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, etc.) as specified.
* **Medical (M&HS):** MBBS with 3 years experience.
* **Finance:** CA or ICWA Final examination passed.
* **HR:** MBA/PG Degree in Personnel Management/HR or MSW.
* **Specialized:** PG in Geology, Environment Science, or Mining/Civil with Surveyor Certificate.

## Pay Scale & Age Limit
Compensation depends on the Grade (FTE-I to FTE-VI):
* **Salary Range:** ₹75,400 to ₹1,69,600 consolidated pay.
* **Age Limit:** 35 to 52 years (Depending on Grade).
* **Age Relaxation:** OBC (3 yrs), SC (5 yrs), PwD (10-15 yrs), Ex-SM (5 yrs).

## Selection Process
* **Method:** 100% weightage on **Personal Interview (PI)**.
* **Shortlisting:** Ratio of 1:5 (or 1:10 for single posts) based on experience and additional qualifications.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start:** 21 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 5 October 2026 (11:00 PM)
* **Reckoning Date for Eligibility:** 1 September 2026

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹500
* **SC/PwBD:** Exempted

website_content.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has announced the exam dates for CSIR NET December 2026. This national-level test determines eligibility for Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) and Assistant Professor positions.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CSIR NET December 2026 Overview
The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** has officially released the schedule for the Joint CSIR-UGC NET December 2026. This exam is crucial for candidates aspiring to enter the fields of research and academia in **Science and Technology**.

### 📌 Key Exam Details
* **Exam Mode:** Online (Computer-Based Test - CBT)
* **Exam Level:** National
* **Medium of Exam:** English & Hindi
* **Purpose:** Eligibility for **Junior Research Fellowship (JRF)** and **Lectureship/Assistant Professor** positions.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Dates:** 20 and 21 December 2026

### 📝 Application Process
Once the registration link is active, candidates should follow these steps:
* **Registration:** Visit the official portal and complete the 'New Registration'.
* **Form Filling:** Enter personal, educational, and subject preferences.
* **Document Upload:** Upload a valid photograph (10 KB–200 KB) and signature (4 KB–30 KB).
* **Fee Payment:** Complete the payment via Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
* **Submission:** Download and save the final application form for future reference.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* Ensure the use of a **valid mobile number and email ID**.
* Details must match official government documents exactly.
* Double-check the **selected subject and exam city** before final submission.

website_content.title: Karnataka UGNEET 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has announced the Round 2 final seat allotment for MBBS and BDS courses for the 2026 session. Candidates can now access their allotment status via the official KEA portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the **Round 2 Final Seat Allotment** for Karnataka NEET UG (UGNEET) 2026. This allotment applies to candidates seeking admission to **MBBS and BDS courses** under the Karnataka state quota.

## Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Course focus:** MBBS and BDS Admission
* **Allotment Stage:** Round 2 (Final)
* **Official Portal:** cetonline.karnataka.gov.in

## Important Dates
* **Round 2 Option Entry:** September 7 – September 9, 2026
* **Provisional Allotment Result:** September 11, 2026
* **Exit Window:** September 11 – September 14, 2026
* **Final Seat Allotment Result:** September 16, 2026

## How to Check Allotment Status
1. Visit the official KEA portal at **cetonline.karnataka.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **UGNEET 2026** or **Admission** section.
3. Click on the link for **Round 2 Final Seat Allotment Result**.
4. Log in using your **NEET application/roll number** and password/DOB.
5. Enter the CAPTCHA and view your allotted college and seat type.
6. Download and print the **Allotment Letter** for future reporting.

## Critical Instructions
* **Avoid Unofficial Links:** Use only the official KEA website to avoid fraud.
* **Credential Safety:** Keep your login details secure.
* **Careful Selection:** Carefully review your choice options before confirming to avoid affecting future rounds.
* **Documentation:** Save PDF copies of your allotment letter, fee receipts, and confirmation slips immediately.

website_content.title: STPI Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
website_content.summary: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) invites online applications for 15 Apprentice Trainee positions across India. Eligible candidates must apply by September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Software Technology Parks of India (STPI), an autonomous society under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, is recruiting **Apprentice Trainees** under the Apprenticeship Act-1961 for a period of one year.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 15
* **Locations:** HQ, Bengaluru, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Guwahati, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Noida, Mohali, Pune.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * B.E/B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, ECE, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or IT.
    * OR Bachelor's degree in Arts, Commerce, or Administration.
* **Passing Year:** Candidates must have completed their qualification in **June 2021 or thereafter**.
* **Age Limit (as of 14.09.2026):**
    * Minimum: 18 Years
    * Maximum (UR): 27 Years
    * Maximum (OBC): 30 Years
    * Maximum (SC/ST): 32 Years

## Stipend Structure
* **B.E/B.Tech Holders:** Rs. 15,000/- per month
* **Bachelor (Arts/Comm/Admin) Holders:** Rs. 12,300/- per month
* **Note:** Higher stipends up to **Rs. 20,000/-** may be offered based on interview performance.

## Selection Process
Selection will be carried out through **shortlisting based on interview performance**. There is no written examination.

## Application Steps
1. **Mandatory Registration:** Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) Portal first to obtain a Student Enrolment ID.
2. **Online Application:** Visit the STPI official website's Career Section and fill out the application form mentioning the NATS Enrolment ID.
3. **Deadline:** Ensure submission on or before September 30, 2026.

* **Technical/Support:** Library Assistant, Lab Assistant (Bio/Chem/Phys/Comp), and Nurse

## Selection Process

1. **Computer Based Test (CBT):** A centralized online examination conducted across India.
2. **Demo-cum-Interview:** Post-CBT stage conducted individually by the respective DAV schools.

## Important Dates

| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Registration Starts** | 16 September 2026 |
| **Deadline to Submit Form** | 08 October 2026 |
| **Verification Window** | 25 Sept to 16 Oct 2026 |
| **CBT Examination** | December 2026 |

## Application Fee
* **All Categories:** Rs. 300/- (Payable online after verification approval).

## Key Application Steps
* **Online Registration:** Fill out the form at the official portal and submit as "Form Ready for Verification".
* **Document Verification:** Visit a designated DAV Verification Centre between Sept 25 and Oct 16.
* **Payment:** Pay the CBT fee within 7 days of being marked "Verified and Approved".
* **CBT:** Download the admit card in November and appear for the exam in December.

website_content.title: UPSC Section Officers and Stenographers LDCE Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: UPSC has announced Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations (LDCE) for Section Officers (Grade-B) and Stenographers (Grade-B/I). Eligible in-service candidates must apply online by October 6, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released notifications for two Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations (LDCE): the **Combined Section Officers' (Grade-'B') LDCE, 2026** and the **Combined Stenographers' (Grade-'B'/Grade-'I') LDCE for 2022, 2023 & 2024**. This is an internal recruitment process specifically for eligible serving government employees.

## Key Examination Details
* **Organization:** Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
* **Exam Type:** Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE)
* **Application Mode:** Online
* **Exam Dates:** December 12th and 13th, 2026

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 06.10.2026 (until 06:00 PM)
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline (Section Officers):** 23.10.2026
* **Examination Dates:** 12.12.2026 & 13.12.2026

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Restriction:** Only serving government employees who meet the conditions prescribed for their respective service/cadre are eligible.
* **Regulations:** Recruitment is conducted as per DoPT Rules published in the Gazette of India dated 16.09.2026.

## Section Officers' Grade-B Categories
Candidates can compete for various categories including:
* Central Secretariat Service
* Indian Foreign Service (General Cadre, Branch 'B')
* Railway Board Secretariat Service
* Intelligence Bureau
* Armed Forces Headquarters Civil Service
* Employees' State Insurance Corporation

## Examination Centres
The exam will be conducted at the following centers:
* Chennai
* Delhi
* Kolkata
* Mumbai
* Nagpur

## Selection Process & Exam Pattern
* **Pattern:** Includes both Objective Type Question Papers and Descriptive Papers.
* **Negative Marking:** Applicable for objective papers.
* **Key Papers:** Focus on Government of India Secretariat procedures, General Financial and Service Rules, and Noting/Drafting/Precis Writing.
* **Selection:** Based on written examination and verification of service records.

website_content.title: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Notification: Specialist Cadre Officer Posts
website_content.summary: State Bank of India (SBI) invites applications for Specialist Cadre Officer (SCO) roles across SBIL Kolkata and IT Risk divisions. Apply by October 6, 2026, for high-paying leadership and technical positions.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Overview
State Bank of India is hiring for **Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO)** on a contract basis for a period of 3 years (extendable up to 5 years). This recruitment covers two main advertisements: one for SBIL Kolkata and another for IT Risk roles.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Registration Starts:** 16.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply & Pay Fee:** 06.10.2026
* **Eligibility Cut-off Date:** 31.08.2026

### 💼 Vacancy Details
**1. SBIL Kolkata (Advt 20):**
* **Dean:** 1 Post (Age 40-55)
* **Faculty:** 1 Post (Age 35-55)
* **Marketing Executive:** 1 Post (Age 28-40)

**2. IT Risk (Advt 22):**
* **Deputy Vice President:** 2 Posts (Age 36-45)
* **Assistant Vice President:** 2 Posts (Age 32-42)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**SBIL Posts:**
* **Dean:** MBA/PhD/PGDM with 15 years of experience (min. 3 years in leadership roles).
* **Faculty:** Postgraduate with 6 years of teaching/corporate training experience.
* **Marketing Executive:** MBA in Marketing with 5 years of experience (min. 3 years in Executive Education).

**IT Risk Posts:**
* **Education:** BE/B.Tech (CS/IT/Cybersecurity) or MCA/M.Sc (IT).
* **Certification:** CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or CISA is required.
* **Experience:** 9-12 years in IT domain (with specific focus on IT risk/info security).

### 💰 Remuneration (Annual CTC)
* **Dean:** Up to ₹98 Lakhs
* **Faculty:** Up to ₹63 Lakhs
* **Deputy VP (IT Risk):** Up to ₹60 Lakhs
* **Assistant VP (IT Risk):** Up to ₹50 Lakhs
* **Marketing Executive:** ₹52 Lakhs

### 🛠 Selection Process
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on bank-defined parameters.
2. **Interview:** (Demo session required for Dean/Faculty).
3. **CTC Negotiation:** Final stage for selected candidates based on merit.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **General/EWS/OBC:** ₹750
* **SC/ST/PwBD:** Nil

website_content.title: GMC Jalgaon Professor and Associate Professor Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Government Medical College, Jalgaon invites offline applications for 21 contractual positions of Professors and Associate Professors. The application window closes on 25 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Government Medical College, Jalgaon, under the Directorate of Medical Education and Research, Mumbai, is recruiting medical faculty on a **contractual basis** for a period of 364 days.

## Vacancy Details
* **Professor:** 11 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 10 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 21

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Nationality:** Must be an Indian citizen and a resident of **Maharashtra**.
* **Educational Qualification:** Appropriate MD, MS, DNB, or recognized medical qualification in the relevant subject.
* **Experience:**
    * **Professor:** Minimum 3 years experience as Associate Professor + NMC research publications + Basic Course in Medical Education Technology & Biomedical Research.
    * **Associate Professor:** Minimum 4 years experience as Assistant Professor + NMC research publications + Basic Course in Medical Education Technology & Biomedical Research.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **69 years** at the time of appointment.

## Remuneration (Monthly)
* **Professor:** ₹1,85,000
* **Associate Professor:** ₹1,70,000

## Selection Process
Selection is based on a **Merit Assessment (100 Marks)** followed by an interview:
* Qualification: 50 Marks
* Additional Qualification: 5 Marks
* Teaching Experience: 20 Marks
* Research Publications: 10 Marks
* Interview: 15 Marks
* *Minimum Qualifying Mark: 41%*

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 8 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 11 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25 September 2026 (by 5:00 PM)

## How to Apply
1. Download the prescribed application form from the official website.
2. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (SSC, Degree, Experience, Domicile, etc.).
3. Submit the application **personally or via registered post** to the Dean, Government Medical College, Jalgaon.

website_content.title: RPSC SI Police / Platoon Commander Re-Exam Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: The RPSC has released the admit cards for the Sub Inspector (SI) Police and Platoon Commander Re-Examination 2021. The exam is scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## RPSC SI Police Re-Examination 2026

The Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has officially released the admit cards for the **Sub Inspector (SI) Police / Platoon Commander Recruitment Re-Examination 2021**. Please note that this is a re-conducted exam for candidates who participated in the original 2021 process.

### 📅 Key Dates
* **Exam City Details Released:** 13 September 2026
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Re-Examination Date:** 20 September 2026

### 📝 How to Download Your Admit Card
1. Visit the official RPSC recruitment portal.
2. Navigate to the **'News & Events'** or **'Candidate Corner'** section.
3. Locate the link for the **SI / Platoon Commander Re-Exam 2021** admit card.
4. Log in using your **Registration Number** and **Date of Birth**.
5. Complete the captcha verification.
6. Download the PDF and take a clear **colour printout on A4 paper**.

### 📂 Mandatory Documents for Exam Day
* **Printed Admit Card** (Colour print recommended).
* **Original Photo ID Proof** (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, or Driving Licence).

website_content.title: JEE Main 2027 Session 1 Exam Dates Released
website_content.summary: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially announced the exam dates for JEE Main 2027 Session 1. The examinations are scheduled to be held from January 22 to January 30, 2027.
website_content.markdown_content:
## JEE Main 2027 Overview
The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** has released the official Examination Calendar for the Joint Entrance Examination (Main) 2027. This examination is the primary gateway for admission to premier institutes including **NITs, IIITs, and CFTIs**, and serves as the qualifying exam for **JEE Advanced 2027**.

## Important Exam Dates (Session 1)
* **Exam Dates:** January 22, 23, 24, 28, 29, and 30, 2027
* **Buffer Date:** January 31, 2027
* **Session 2:** Scheduled for April 2027

## Key Examination Details
* **Mode of Exam:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Special Note:** The drawing section for B.Arch will be conducted **offline**.
* **Conducting Body:** National Testing Agency (NTA)

## Application Process
Once the registration window opens, candidates should follow these steps:
* Visit the official portal.
* Complete initial registration with basic personal details.
* Fill out the detailed application form.
* Upload required documents (Photo and Signature).
* Pay the application fee online.

## Essential Instructions
* **Verification:** Regularly check the official website for the detailed Information Bulletin regarding fees and registration dates.
* **Documentation:** Ensure Aadhaar card and other identity documents are updated before applying.
* **Session 2:** Candidates appearing in Session 1 do not need to fill a completely new form for Session 2.

website_content.title: Greater Chennai Corporation Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Chennai City Urban Health Mission is inviting offline applications for 512 estimated contractual Staff Nurse vacancies. Eligible candidates must apply by September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Greater Chennai Corporation, through the Chennai City Urban Health Mission, is recruiting **512 (estimated)** Staff Nurses. These positions are purely temporary/contractual and will be deployed across various institutions under the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Medical and Rural Health Services, and Medical Education & Research.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must possess a **GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery)** or **B.Sc. Nursing** degree from a recognized Government or Government-approved Private Nursing College.
* **Professional Registration:** A valid registration with the **Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council** is mandatory.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum age is **50 years**.

## Important Dates
* **Application Deadline:** 25th September 2026, by 5:00 PM.

## Application Process
This recruitment follows an **offline application process**:
1. Download the application form from the official GCC or NHM-TN website.
2. Complete the form and attach two recent passport-size color photographs.
3. Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents.
4. Submit the physical application to the **City Health Officer / Member Secretary, Chennai City Urban Health Mission, 3rd Floor, Amma Maaligai Ripon Buildings, Chennai - 600 003**.

## Mandatory Documents for Submission
* **Proof of Identity/Age:** Birth Certificate, SSLC, or HSC certificate.
* **Academic Proof:** Diploma/B.Sc. Degree certificate and all mark sheets.
* **Registration:** Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration certificate.
* **Language Proficiency:** Evidence of Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th marks).
* **Other Documents:** Community certificate, Proof of residency (Aadhar/Voter ID), and a Character and Conduct certificate issued within the last 3 months.

website_content.title: IRCTC SCZ Hospitality and Tourism Monitors Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: IRCTC South Central Zone is recruiting 28 Hospitality and Tourism Monitors via walk-in interviews in Bhubaneswar and Hyderabad.
website_content.markdown_content:
## IRCTC SCZ Recruitment 2026

Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd (IRCTC), South Central Zone, is inviting applications for fixed-term contract positions for **Hospitality Monitors** and **Tourism Monitors**.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
* **Hospitality Monitors:** 22 Posts (includes 4 OBC backlog vacancies)
* **Tourism Monitors:** 6 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** 28

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

#### 1. Hospitality Monitors
* **Education:** B.Sc in Hospitality & Hotel Administration / BBA/MBA (Culinary Arts) / B.Sc Hotel Management & Catering Science / MBA (Tourism & Hotel Management).
* **Age Limit:** Up to 28 years (No experience), 28-30 years (1 yr exp), 30-35 years (2 yrs exp). UR limit is 35 years.

#### 2. Tourism Monitors
* **Education:** 3-Year Bachelor's degree in Tourism **OR** Bachelor's degree in any stream + 1-year diploma in Travel & Tourism.
* **Experience:** 1 to 2 years in Tour Operation/Travel Agency Firms.
* **Age Limit:** Up to 35 years (UR).

### 💰 Remuneration & Benefits
* **Hospitality Monitors:** CTC ₹30,000/month + Daily Allowance (up to ₹350) + Lodging charges + National Holiday Allowance.
* **Tourism Monitors:** CTC ₹30,000 to ₹35,000/month (based on qualification) + Daily Allowance + Lodging charges.
* **Medical Insurance:** Provided as per age and post.

### 🗓️ Walk-in Interview Schedule

| Post | Venue | Date | Time |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hospitality** | IHM, Bhubaneswar | 05.10.2026 | 10:30 - 17:30 |
| **Hospitality** | IHM, Hyderabad | 08.10.2026 | 10:30 - 17:30 |
| **Tourism** | IRCTC Regional Office, Bhubaneswar | 06.10.2026 | 10:30 - 17:30 |
| **Tourism** | IRCTC Ltd, Secunderabad | 09.10.2026 | 10:30 - 17:30 |

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Download the application form from the official website.
2. Fill in all details and attach self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates.
3. Carry the completed form, original documents, and two passport-size photographs to the designated venue on the scheduled date.

website_content.title: Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27 Notification
website_content.summary: The District Urban Development Cell, Gadag, is recruiting 154 Pourakarmikas (Municipal Sanitation Workers) on a direct-payment basis. Interested candidates must apply offline by September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Gadag Pourakarmika Recruitment 2026-27

The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Gadag, has released a notification for the recruitment of **Pourakarmika (Municipal Sanitation Workers)** for the Gadag-Betageri City Municipal Council. These are temporary positions based on a direct-payment/honorarium (**Nera Paavati**) system.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 29.08.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 29.08.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30.09.2026

## 📋 Vacancy Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 154 Posts
* **Special Reservation:** 15 posts (10%) are reserved for legal heirs of persons deceased under the Manual Scavengers Act.

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** No formal educational qualification required.
* **Language:** Must be able to speak **Kannada**.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 50 years (as of notification date). No age relaxation available.
* **Nationality:** Must be an Indian Citizen.

## 💰 Application Fee
Fees must be paid via **Demand Draft (DD)** in favor of the Project Director, District Urban Development Cell, DC Office, Gadag.
* **SC/ST/Category-1/Women:** ₹100
* **General/2A/2B/3A/3B:** ₹200

## 🛠 Selection Process
Selection is based on **scrutiny and priority** (No exam or interview):
1. **Priority 1:** Candidates with 1+ year of prior service as Pourakarmika, Loader, or UGD Helper.
2. **Priority 2:** Family members of Pourakarmikas deceased during COVID-19 or in service.
3. **Priority 3:** Candidates with 1+ year experience in allied sanitation roles.
4. **Priority 4:** Eligible legal heirs under the Manual Scavengers Act.

## 📝 How to Apply
1. **Obtain Form:** Collect the application form from the District Urban Development Cell (DC Office, Room No. 123, Gadag) or the City Municipal Council, Gadag-Betageri.
2. **Documentation:** Attach self-attested copies of age proof, category certificates, and service experience proofs.
3. **Payment:** Attach the required Demand Draft (DD).
4. **Submission:** Submit the completed form **offline** at the concerned local body office by **September 30, 2026**.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Tripura Medical Counselling Committee (TRMCC), under the Directorate of Medical Education, Government of Tripura, has officially announced the **Revised Provisional Allotment Result for Round 2** of the NEET UG 2026 counselling process. This result applies to candidates seeking admission into **MBBS and BDS** courses under the state quota.

## Key Highlights
* **Important Update:** A previous provisional result was withdrawn due to technical issues; candidates must use the **Revised** version.
* **Automatic Cancellation:** Candidates upgraded to a new seat in Round 2 will have their Round 1 seat cancelled automatically.
* **Result Format:** The result is published as a PDF containing the list of allotted candidates.

## How to Check Your Result
1. Navigate to the official TRMCC portal.
2. Access the **'UG Counselling'** section.
3. Click on the link for the **Revised Provisional Allotment Result of Round-2**.
4. Open the PDF and use `Ctrl+F` to search for your **Roll Number** or **Candidate ID**.
5. Verify the allotted college, course, quota, and category.

## Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Documentation:** Keep your NEET UG admit card, scorecard, and all original certificates ready. Incomplete sets may lead to rejection by the institute.
* **Reporting:** Report to the allotted institute within the specified deadline to avoid automatic cancellation of the seat.
* **Verification:** Do not act upon any results published prior to the Revised Provisional Allotment list.

website_content.title: RITES Limited Recruitment 2026: Engineering Professionals (Ports & Waterways)
website_content.summary: RITES Limited (Navratna CPSE) is inviting applications for Senior and Assistant Manager positions in Ports, Waterways, and Coastal Modelling. Apply by October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚢 RITES Limited Recruitment 2026

RITES Limited, a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, is recruiting **Engineering Professionals** on a regular basis for specialized roles in maritime and coastal infrastructure.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 08.10.2026
* **Written Test (Tentative):** 25.10.2026

###  vacancy Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Age Limit |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Sr. Manager (Ports & Waterways) | 1 | 38 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Ports & Waterways) | 2 | 32 Years |
| Assistant Manager (Coastal Modelling) | 2 | 32 Years |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**Educational Qualification:**
* **Bachelor's Degree** in Civil Engineering (Full-time).
* **Master's Degree** in Marine Engineering & Management / Ocean Structures / Structural Engineering or Coastal Engineering.
* **Minimum Marks:** 60% for UR/EWS and 50% for Reserved categories.

**Work Experience:**
* **Sr. Manager:** Minimum 8 years professional experience (including 5 years in design/analysis of marine structures).
* **Assistant Manager:** Minimum 2 years professional experience in marine structure design or numerical modelling of coastal processes.

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Sr. Manager:** ₹60,000 – ₹1,80,000
* **Assistant Manager:** ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000
* **Additional Benefits:** Medical facilities, Group Insurance, Maternity/Paternity leave, and Leave Encashment.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Written Test:** 125 objective questions (No negative marking).
2. **Document Scrutiny:** Verification of eligibility documents.
3. **Interview:** Final selection based on 60% Written Test + 40% Interview weightage.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹600 + taxes
* **EWS/SC/ST/PwBD:** ₹300 + taxes (Refundable upon participation)

website_content.summary: Airports Authority of India (AAI) invites applications from retired Short Service Commission Officers (SSCOs) for 39 Consultant positions. The last date to apply via email is October 1, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Airports Authority of India (AAI), a Schedule ‘A’ Mini Ratna Category-1 PSE, is seeking retired Short Service Commission Officers (SSCOs) from the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, or Coast Guard to serve as **Consultants** on a contract basis to support Air Traffic Services (ATS) at Joint User Defence Airfields.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 1 October 2026
* **Interview Date:** To be intimated via email to shortlisted candidates

## Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **39**

| Location | Vacancies |
| :--- | :--- |
| Pune Airport (SMC) | 11 |
| Goa (Dabolim) Airport (SMC + ATC) | 15 |
| Port Blair Airport (SMC) | 04 |
| Darbhanga Airport | 03 |
| Purnea Airport | 04 |
| Kanpur Airport | 02 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Eligible Candidates:** Retired SSCOs of Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, or Coast Guard.
* **Educational Qualification:** Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
* **Professional Qualification:** Basic ATC Course/ATM and AL (Basic) and GCA/ATSS Course.
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of cumulative ATC duties (at least 1 year at a Joint User Defence Airfield).
* **Age Limit:** Maximum 50 years as of 01.10.2026. (Gap since retirement must not exceed 6 years).

## Selection Process
* **No Written Exam.**
* Selection is based solely on **Application Verification** and a **Personal Interview**.
* Merit ranking of the interview determines final selection.

## How to Apply
1. Download the Application Form (Annexure-1) from the official notification.
2. Attach self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates.
3. Merge all documents into a **single PDF (Max 5 MB)**.
4. Email the PDF to **[email protected]** on or before October 1, 2026.

**Note:** Applications sent via any other mode will be rejected.

website_content.title: CTET Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026 - 22nd Edition
website_content.summary: The CBSE is conducting the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) 2026 on December 12 and 13. This is a mandatory qualifying exam for teaching positions in KVS, NVS, and EMRS schools.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CTET 2026 Overview
The **Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)** is a national-level entrance exam conducted by CBSE to determine the eligibility of candidates for teaching classes 1 to 8 in central government schools.

### 📅 Key Exam Details
* **Exam Dates:** December 12 and 13, 2026
* **Mode of Exam:** Offline (Pen and Paper / OMR based)
* **Certificate Validity:** Lifetime
* **Negative Marking:** None

### 📝 Exam Structure
Candidates can appear for one or both papers based on their teaching goals:
* **Paper 1:** For those aspiring to teach **Classes 1 to 5** (Primary Level)
* **Paper 2:** For those aspiring to teach **Classes 6 to 8** (Upper Primary Level)

### 📊 Marking Scheme & Qualifying Marks
Each paper consists of **150 MCQs** for **150 Marks** with a duration of **2 hours 30 minutes**.

| Category | Qualifying Marks | Percentage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| General / UR | 90/150 | 60% |
| SC / ST / OBC / PwD | 82-83/150 | 55% |

### 📚 Syllabus Highlights

#### Paper 1 (Primary Stage)
* **Child Development & Pedagogy (30 Marks)**
* **Language I & II (30 Marks each)**
* **Mathematics (30 Marks)**
* **Environmental Studies (30 Marks)**

#### Paper 2 (Upper Primary Stage)
* **Child Development & Pedagogy (30 Marks)**
* **Language I & II (30 Marks each)**
* **Subject Specialization (60 Marks):** Either *Mathematics & Science* OR *Social Studies/Social Science*.

### 💡 Preparation Strategy
* Focus heavily on **CDP** as it is common to both papers.
* Use **NCERT Textbooks** for EVS, Science, and Social Studies.
* Solve **Previous Year Question Papers** to understand the pattern.
* Attempt all questions since there is **no negative marking**.

website_content.title: HPPSC Assistant Professor (Sanskrit) Provisional Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: HPPSC has released the provisional answer key for the Assistant Professor (College Cadre) Sanskrit screening test held on September 14, 2026. Eligible candidates can challenge the answer key online from September 16 to September 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) has published the provisional answer key for **Paper-I (Screening Test)** for the recruitment of **Assistant Professor (College Cadre) Sanskrit** under the Department of Higher Education, Himachal Pradesh.

## Key Dates
* **Exam Date:** 14 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Objection Window Opens:** 16 September 2026
* **Objection Window Closes:** 20 September 2026

## Objection Details
* **Objection Fee:** ₹100 per question (Non-refundable)
* **Submission Mode:** Online only
* **Requirement:** Every objection must be accompanied by an authentic supporting document/reference in **PDF format**.

## Step-by-Step Process to Raise Objections
1. Log in to the official HPPSC applicant portal using registered credentials.
2. Access the provisional answer key section for **Assistant Professor (College Cadre) Sanskrit, Paper-I**.
3. Identify and select the question(s) you wish to challenge.
4. Upload the required supporting PDF document for each question.
5. Complete the payment of ₹100 per question via the online link.
6. Submit the final objection within the specified window (16–20 Sept 2026).

## Important Instructions
* No offline objections will be accepted.
* Objections without the fee payment or supporting PDF documents will be summarily rejected.

## UAS Mandya UG Admission 2026-27 (ICAR Quota)

The University of Agricultural Sciences, Mandya has officially released the provisional admission list for candidates selected via the **ICAR Quota (CUET-2026/UG)**.

* B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
* B.Tech (Food Technology)

website_content.summary: AIIMS Gorakhpur is recruiting for 68 Group-A Faculty positions across 31 medical departments. Applications close on October 13, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Gorakhpur has released a detailed advertisement for the recruitment of **Faculty (Group-A)** posts. These positions are available via Direct Recruitment, Deputation, and Contractual basis.

### 📌 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **68 Posts** across 31 departments/specialties:
* **Professor:** 18 Posts
* **Additional Professor:** 8 Posts
* **Associate Professor:** 24 Posts
* **Assistant Professor:** 18 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Essential Qualification:**
* **Basic:** MBBS or equivalent recognized by NMC.
* **Post Graduate:** MD/MS or NMC-recognized equivalent in the relevant subject.
* **Super-Specialty:** DM/MCh for relevant posts.

**Teaching Experience (Post-Qualification):**
* **Professor:** 14 Years (General) / 11-12 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Additional Professor:** 10 Years (General) / 7-8 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Associate Professor:** 6 Years (General) / 3-4 Years (Super-Specialty)
* **Assistant Professor:** 3 Years (General) / No experience required for Super-Specialty

### 💰 Salary & Pay Scale (7th CPC)
* **Professor:** Level-14A (₹1,68,900 – ₹2,20,400)
* **Additional Professor:** Level-13A2+ (₹1,48,200 – ₹2,11,400)
* **Associate Professor:** Level-13A1+ (₹1,38,300 – ₹2,09,200)
* **Assistant Professor:** Level-12 (₹1,01,500 – ₹1,67,400)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 14.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 14.09.2026
* **Application Deadline:** 13.10.2026 (Online & Hard Copy)

### 📝 Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹2,000
* **SC/ST:** ₹500
* **PwBD/Retired Faculty:** Nil

### 🛠 How to Apply
1. **Online:** Submit the application via the official Google Form.
2. **Documents:** Upload PDF/Word copies of application, brief of candidate, and PPT.
3. **Hard Copy:** Send signed application and self-attested documents via Speed/Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Gorakhpur by **13.10.2026**.

## Gujarat NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Allotment Details

The Admission Committee for Professional Undergraduate Medical Educational Courses (**ACPUGMEC**) has officially released the **Round 2 seat allotment results** for candidates seeking admission into MBBS and BDS courses in Gujarat.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Conducting Body:** ACPUGMEC
* **Courses Covered:** MBBS and BDS
* **Result Declaration Date:** September 14, 2026
* **Allotment Type:** Rank-wise and Institute-wise PDFs

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Choice Filling:** September 7 to September 11, 2026
* **Revised Provisional Merit List:** September 8, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 14, 2026

### 🔍 How to Check Your Result (Without Login)
1. Visit the official portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Medical & Dental'** tab under the 'Undergraduate Admission' section.
3. Click on the **'Round 2 Seat Allotment Result'** link.
4. Open the Rank-Wise or Institute-Wise PDF and search for your Name, NEET Roll Number, or Rank using **Ctrl+F**.

* Do not rely on SMS/Email; check the official portal for the most accurate status.
* Ensure you download the official PDF from the verified government website.
* If not allotted a seat in Round 2, keep an eye on subsequent or mop-up round announcements.

website_content.title: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) Apprentice Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited invites online applications for 210 Technician (Vocational) and Trade Apprentice positions. Eligible Kerala domicile candidates can apply by October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), a premier Miniratna Schedule 'A' Government of India company, is offering **210 apprenticeship seats** for one year of training under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

## Vacancy Details
A total of 210 seats are available, split as follows:
* **ITI Trade Apprentices:** 205 seats across 16 trades (Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Machinist, etc.)
* **Technician (Vocational) Apprentices:** 5 seats in disciplines like Accounting, Nursing, and CRM.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Education (ITI):** 10th Standard pass and ITI (National Trade Certificate - NTC) in notified trades.
* **Education (Vocational):** Pass in Vocational Higher Secondary Education (VHSE) in the concerned discipline.
* **Age Limit:** Minimum **18 years** as of 08.10.2026.
* **Domicile:** Must be a **domicile of Kerala**.

## Selection Process
There is **no written examination**. Selection is based on:
1. **Merit Shortlisting:** Based on percentage of marks in the prescribed qualification.
2. **Certificate Verification:** Original document check for shortlisted candidates.
3. **Medical Fitness:** Final selection subject to medical clearance.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 08.10.2026
* **Age Reckoning Date:** 08.10.2026

## Key Highlights
* **Application Fee:** Nil (Free)
* **Stipend:** Rs. 11,000/- per month
* **Training Duration:** One Year

website_content.title: TG TET Answer Key 2026 for In-Service Teachers Released
website_content.summary: The Department of School Education, Telangana has released the provisional answer keys and response sheets for TGTET-In-Service Teachers 2026. Candidates can now review their performance and challenge incorrect answers by September 17.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TG TET In-Service Teachers 2026 Answer Key

The **Department of School Education, Government of Telangana (SCERT & TGTET Cell)** has officially released the provisional answer key for the Teacher Eligibility Test for In-Service Teachers conducted via Computer-Based Test (CBT).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **CBT Exam Dates:** 7 September to 11 September 2026
* **Provisional Answer Key Release:** 15 September 2026
* **Objection Window:** 15 September to 17 September 2026
* **Expected Result Date:** 28 to 30 September 2026

### 📋 Key Examination Details
* **Exam Mode:** Online Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Total Marks:** 150 Marks (for Paper-I and Paper-II)
* **Papers Available:** Paper-I (Classes I-V) and Paper-II (Mathematics & Science / Social Studies)

### 🛠️ How to Download Answer Key & Response Sheet
1. Visit the official portal at **tgtet.aptonline.in**.
2. Click on the **"Answer Key"** or **"Initial Key Download"** link.
3. Select the relevant **Paper and Language Medium**.
4. Log in with registration details to download the PDF.
5. Cross-verify your Response ID with the Official Correct Option.

### 🚩 How to Raise an Objection
Candidates finding discrepancies in the provisional key can challenge them until **17 September 2026**:
* Log in to the objection portal using Application Number and Password/DOB.
* Select the specific **Question ID** you wish to challenge.
* Upload **valid documentary proof** or reference sources in PDF format.
* Pay the applicable objection fee via the online gateway.
* Submit the form and save the acknowledgment receipt.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Verification:** Ensure you match the Question ID for your specific shift and medium to avoid errors.
* **Proof Required:** Objections without supporting evidence will not be considered.
* **Finality:** The final result will be based on the **Final Answer Key** issued after the review of all objections.

website_content.title: UKSSSC Scaler Recruitment 2026 - Uttarakhand Van Vikas Nigam
website_content.summary: Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) invites online applications for 200 Scaler (Group-C) positions. The application process closes on October 22, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🌲 UKSSSC Scaler Recruitment 2026

The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) is recruiting for the post of **Scaler** under the Uttarakhand Van Vikas Nigam (Forest Development Corporation).

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Scaler (Group-C)
* **Total Vacancies:** 200
* **Pay Scale:** ₹19,900 – ₹63,200 (Level-2)
* **Nature of Post:** Non-gazetted, Temporary (covered under EPF)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 22 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 22 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 26 October to 27 October 2026
* **PST/PET Date:** Tentatively from 19 November 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Must have passed **Intermediate (12th)** or equivalent with **Science or Mathematics** from a recognized board/school in India/Uttarakhand.
* **Preferential Qualification:** 2 years service in Territorial Army OR NCC 'B' or 'C' certificate.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 28 years (as of 01 July 2026). Age relaxations apply for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories.
* **Domicile:** Candidate must be registered with Uttarakhand Employment Exchange, hold a domicile certificate, or have completed schooling in Uttarakhand.

### 🏃 Physical Standards (PST/PET)
**Height Requirements:**
* **Male:** 163 cm (Relaxed to 152 cm for ST/Gorkha/Garhwali/Kumaoni etc.)
* **Female:** 150 cm (Relaxed to 145 cm for ST/Gorkha/Garhwali/Kumaoni etc.)

**Physical Efficiency Test (Qualifying):**
* **Race:** Male (25 km in 4 hrs) | Female (14 km in 4 hrs)
* **Shot Put:** Male (5.00m) | Female (3.50m)
* **Long Jump:** Male (4.00m) | Female (2.00m)
* **High Jump:** Male (1.10m) | Female (0.70m)

### ✍️ Selection Process
1. **Stage 1:** Qualifying PST and PET.
2. **Stage 2:** Written Competitive Exam (100 Marks, Objective Type, 2 hours).
   * *Negative Marking:* 1/4th mark deducted for each wrong answer.
   * *Min Qualifying Marks:* 45% for UR/EWS/OBC and 35% for SC/ST.
3. **Stage 3:** Document Verification.

### 💳 Application Fee
* **UR/OBC:** ₹300
* **SC/ST/EWS/Divyang (Uttarakhand):** ₹150
* **Orphans:** No Fee

website_content.title: HPPSC Scientific Officer (NDPS) Recruitment 2026 - Syllabus & Exam Pattern
website_content.summary: HPPSC is recruiting for the post of Scientific Officer (NDPS), Group-B under the Directorate of Forensic Services. Candidates must clear a descriptive Subject Aptitude Test (SAT) covering Forensic Science and Chemistry.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) is conducting the recruitment process for **Scientific Officer (NDPS), Group-B** for the Directorate of Forensic Services, Home Department, H.P. The primary selection stage is the **Subject Aptitude Test (SAT)**.

## Exam Pattern: Subject Aptitude Test (SAT)
* **Question Type:** Descriptive
* **Total Marks:** 120
* **Duration:** 3 Hours
* **Structure:** Divided into two parts (Part-I and Part-II), each carrying 60 marks.

## Detailed Syllabus

### Part-I: Forensic Science Fundamentals (60 Marks)
* **Forensic Basics:** History, scope, Locard's Principle, and AI/ML applications.
* **Crime Scene Management:** Evidence collection, 3D recording, blood stain analysis, and road accident reconstruction.
* **Dactylography:** Fingerprint classification, Henry system, and NAFIS.
* **Instrumental Methods:** Microscopy (SEM, TEM), Spectroscopy (AAS, ICP-MS), and Chromatography (HPLC, TLC).
* **Quality & Law:** ISO/IEC 17025:2017, BNS, BNSS, BSA 2023, and the NDPS Act.
* **Research:** Methodology, ethics, and plagiarism detection.

### Part-II: Chemistry & Pharmacology (60 Marks)
* **Chemistry Basics:** Organic, Inorganic, and Physical chemistry, Stereochemistry, and Proteins/Lipids.
* **NDPS Specialization:** Narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, and active constituents of Papaver somniferum and Cannabis sativa.
* **Forensic Chemistry:** Arson investigation, petroleum products, and alcohol analysis.
* **Analytical Chemistry:** Volumetric/gravimetric techniques and GLP.
* **Separation Techniques:** GC-MS, LC-MS, and drug extraction methods (Stas-Otto).
* **Forensic Pharmacology:** Pharmacokinetics, drug metabolism, and toxicological studies.

## Key Preparation Strategies
* **Segmented Study:** Treat Part-I (Forensics) and Part-II (Chemistry/Pharmacology) as separate study blocks.
* **Focus on Instruments:** Deep dive into the principles and applications of spectroscopy and chromatography.
* **Descriptive Practice:** Since the exam is descriptive, practice long-form answer writing within the 3-hour time limit.
* **Legal Review:** Thoroughly study the BNS, BNSS, BSA 2023, and NDPS Act.

## MBOSE SSLC Examination 2026-27 Overview

The **Meghalaya Board of School Education (MBOSE)** has officially announced the datesheet for the Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC) Examination for the 2026-27 academic session. Students are advised to note the dates and timings to prepare accordingly.

### 📅 Key Examination Dates
* **Exam Start Date:** December 4, 2026
* **Exam End Date:** December 16, 2026
* **Exam Timing:** 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Regular Subjects)

* **December 4, 2026:** English
* **December 7, 2026:** Science
* **December 9, 2026:** Indian Languages / Additional English
* **December 11, 2026:** Health and Physical Education / Computer Science / Vocational Subject
* **December 14, 2026:** Social Science
* **December 16, 2026:** Mathematics / Special Mathematics

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Reporting Time:** All candidates must report to the examination hall by **9:30 AM**.
* **Duration:** Regular subject exams run for **3 hours**; Vocational theory papers run for **1 hour** (10 AM to 11 AM).
* **Updates:** The board may reschedule examinations due to unforeseen circumstances. Students must regularly monitor the official website for revisions.

### 🛠️ How to Download the Datesheet
1. Visit the official portal.
2. Navigate to the **Notifications** or **Latest Updates** section.
3. Click on the link for **SSLC Examination 2026-27 Datesheet**.
4. Save the PDF and take a printout for reference.

website_content.title: KNRUHS Final MBBS Part-II July 2026 Backlog Results
website_content.summary: KNRUHS Warangal has released the provisional results for the Final MBBS Part-II (2019 Regulation) backlog examinations held in July 2026. Successful candidates can verify their pass status by register number on the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS)**, Warangal, has officially published the provisional results for the **Final MBBS Part-II (2019 Regulation)** backlog examinations conducted in July 2026.

## Key Result Details
* **Conducting Authority:** KNRUHS, Warangal, Telangana
* **Examination Session:** July 2026
* **Candidate Category:** Backlog Candidates
* **Result Date:** September 15, 2026
* **Result Format:** Provisional list of successful candidates by Register Number

## Subjects Covered
The results are released subject-wise for the following areas:
* General Medicine
* General Surgery
* Obstetrics & Gynaecology
* Ophthalmology
* Otorhinolaryngology (ENT)
* Pediatrics

## How to Check Your Result
1. Access the official KNRUHS website.
2. Open the PDF notification titled **"Results of Final MBBS Part-II (2019 Regulation) Examinations - July 2026 (Backlog Candidates)".**
3. Search for your **Register Number** under the relevant subject headings.
4. If your register number is listed under a subject, you have passed that specific subject.

## Important Instructions
* **Provisional Status:** This is a provisional list of successful candidates.
* **Subject-wise Pass:** Results are declared per subject, not as a combined pass/fail status for the entire Part-II exam.
* **Mark Statements:** Physical mark statements are **not available for download**; candidates must collect them from their respective colleges.

website_content.title: RITES Limited Recruitment 2026 - Engineering Professionals
website_content.summary: RITES Limited is inviting applications for 33 regular posts including DGM, Manager, and Assistant Manager across various engineering disciplines. The application window closes on October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview

RITES Limited is recruiting Engineering Professionals on a regular basis across two distinct clusters:

* **Cluster-I:** Manager & Assistant Manager (29 Posts)
* **Cluster-II:** Deputy General Manager (DGM) (4 Posts)

## Vacancy Details

| Cluster | Designation | Total Posts | Age Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cluster-II** | Deputy General Manager (DGM) | 04 | 41 Years |
| **Cluster-I** | Manager | 15 | 35 Years |
| **Cluster-I** | Assistant Manager | 14 | 32 Years |

## Eligibility Criteria

### Academic Qualifications
* **Essential:** Full-time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or Geophysics (as per post).
* **Specialization:** Master's Degree in Structural Engineering or Geophysics required for specific DGM and Manager roles.
* **Marks:** Minimum 60% (First Class) for UR/EWS; 50% for reserved categories.

### Experience Requirements
* **DGM (Cluster-II):** Minimum 11 years post-qualification experience.
* **Manager (Cluster-I):** Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience.
* **Assistant Manager (Cluster-I):** Minimum 2 years post-qualification experience.

## Pay Scale

* **DGM:** ₹70,000 – ₹2,00,000
* **Manager:** ₹50,000 – ₹1,60,000
* **Assistant Manager:** ₹40,000 – ₹1,40,000

## Important Dates

* **Application Start Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 08 October 2026
* **Written Test (Cluster-I only):** 25 October 2026

## Selection Process

* **Cluster-I:** Written Test (125 objective questions) followed by an Interview.
* **Cluster-II:** Selection based on Interview (No written test).

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview

website_content.summary: The Telangana Employment Assistants Mission (TEAM) is inviting offline applications for 70 outsourcing posts across 24 categories at the Government General Hospital and district offices. The submission deadline is September 23, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The District Collector's Office, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri, through the **Telangana Employment Assistants Mission (TEAM)**, is hiring for various paramedical, technical, and support roles on an outsourcing basis.

## Key Vacancies & Remuneration
A total of **70 posts** are available across 24 categories:

* **High Pay (Rs. 22,750/-):** Speech Therapist, Psychiatric Social Worker, Lab Technician, ECG Technician, Dental Technician, Child Psychologist, Audiometry Technician, Radiographic Technician, O.T Technician, Blood Bank Technician.
* **Mid Pay (Rs. 19,500/-):** Tailor, Record Clerk, Plumber, Museum Assistant, Driver, Data Entry Operator, Carpenter, Barber, Theatre Assistant.
* **Support Pay (Rs. 15,600/-):** Audio Visual Technician, Ward Boy, Office Subordinate, Lab Attendant, Dhobi/Packer.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Domicile:** Only candidates domiciled in **Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district** are eligible. (Spouse domicile is accepted for non-residents married to locals).
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 44 years.
* **Education:** Varies by post (from 10th Pass for Office Subordinates to PhD for Child Psychologists). Detailed qualifications are listed in the official notification.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 23.09.2026 (up to 5:00 PM)

## Application Process
* **Mode:** **Offline (Physical Submission Only)**
* **Application Fee:** Rs. 50/- (Cash only, non-refundable)
* **Submission Location:** Office of TEAM, District Collector's Office, Room No. F8, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District.
* **Documents Required:** Self-attested copies of qualification certificates, experience certificates, income certificate, Aadhar card, and 10th class certificate.

website_content.markdown_content:
## RMLAU Result 2026 Overview
Dr Rammanohar Lohia Avadh University (RMLAU), Ayodhya, has released the results for the **Odd Semester examinations (2025-26 academic session)** in phases. This includes both NEP and Non-NEP courses.

* **Courses Covered:** BA, BSc, BCom, MA, MSc, MCom and other UG/PG programmes.
* **Result Type:** Provisional online marksheet (Originals to be collected from respective colleges).
* **Verification Required:** Roll Number, Registration Number, and Date of Birth.

* **Exam Period:** 2nd December 2025 to 17th January 2026.
* **NEP 5th Sem (UG) & 3rd Sem (PG):** Declared early-to-mid April 2026.

### Steps to Check Result
1. Visit the official RMLAU website or dedicated result portal.

* **Error Reporting:** Immediately report any discrepancies in name, roll number, or marks to the college examination cell.
* **Documentation:** Maintain both digital and printed copies for future admissions or job applications.

website_content.title: Karnataka PGCET 2026 Counselling Round 1 Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has concluded the Round 1 option entry for PGCET 2026. Candidates for MBA, MCA, M.E./M.Tech, and M.Arch are now awaiting the seat allotment results.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** is conducting the counselling process for the Post Graduate Common Entrance Test (PGCET) 2026 to allocate seats in professional post-graduate courses.

## Courses Covered
* **MBA**
* **MCA**
* **M.E./M.Tech**
* **M.Arch**

## Important Dates (Round 1)
* **Result Declaration:** 19 August 2026
* **Draft Seat Matrix Published:** 8 September 2026
* **Claim Slip Download:** 10 September to 15 September 2026
* **Option Entry Window:** 11 September to 15 September 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** Awaited

## How to Check Seat Allotment Result
1. Visit the official portal: **cetonline.karnataka.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **PGCET 2026 counselling** section.
3. Click on the seat allotment result link for Round 1.
4. Log in using your **CET number** and the credentials provided on your claim slip.
5. View the allotted college, course, and category.
6. Download and print the allotment result for future reference.

## Essential Instructions for Candidates
* **Roster Based:** Allotment depends on the roster, your entered options, and seat availability; rank alone does not guarantee a seat.
* **Mock Results:** Mock allotments are indicative and not a final promise as demand shifts after options are edited.
* **Option Strategy:** Candidates are advised not to shorten their option lists; a wider, correctly ordered list improves chances.
* **Reporting:** Candidates must report to the allotted institute within the specified deadline to prevent cancellation of the seat.
* **Official Sources:** Only trust dates published on the official KEA portal.

website_content.summary: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has initiated Round 2 registration for NEET MDS 2026 admissions. This round includes AIQ, Deemed, Central Universities, and AFMS dental seats.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Overview
The **Medical Counselling Committee (MCC)** has officially opened the registration window for **NEET MDS 2026 Round 2**. This phase is critical for candidates seeking admission into Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) programs across India.

### 🎓 Seats Covered
* **50% All India Quota (AIQ)** seats
* **100% Deemed Universities** seats
* **100% Central Universities** seats
* **AFMS Dental Institutions** seats

### 📅 Important Dates
| Event | Date |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Online Registration** | Sept 15 to Sept 19, 2026 (3:00 PM) |
| **Choice Filling Window** | Starts Sept 16, 2026 |
| **Choice Locking Window** | Sept 19 (4:00 PM) to Sept 20 (10:00 AM) |
| **Seat Allotment Result** | September 23, 2026 |
| **Reporting at Institute** | Sept 24 to Sept 30, 2026 |

### 📝 Application Process
1. **Registration:** Visit the official MCC portal and fill in personal, academic, and NEET MDS details.
2. **Payment:** Pay the required registration fee and security deposit.
3. **Choice Filling:** Arrange preferred colleges and courses in priority order.
4. **Choice Locking:** Ensure choices are locked by **10:00 AM on September 20, 2026**.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Deadlines:** Complete payment before 3:00 PM on Sept 19 to avoid technical glitches.
* **Upgradation:** Candidates holding a Round 1 seat must report to their current institute before opting for an upgrade.
* **Finality:** Once locked, choices cannot be edited. Double-check your preference list carefully.

website_content.summary: The WCD&SC Department, Nirmal District, is inviting online applications for 89 Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) posts. Eligible women candidates must apply by September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Nirmal District Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) Recruitment 2026

The Women, Child, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare Department, Nirmal District, Government of Telangana, has released a notification for the recruitment of **Anganwadi Teachers (AWT)** across four ICDS projects: Bhainsa, Khanapur, Mudhole, and Nirmal.

### 🗓️ Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 11 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 30 September 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
* **Age Reckoning Date:** 1 July 2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Gender:** Only Women applicants are eligible.
* **Education:** Must have passed **Intermediate (12th Class)**.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 35 years (as of July 1, 2026).
* **Locality Rules:** 
    * Applicant must be a **local resident** of the concerned Anganwadi Center's area (Ward for Urban, Gram Panchayat for Rural).
    * Specific SC/ST sub-plan area restrictions apply as per the official vacancy list.

### 📊 Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 89 (AWT only)
* **ICDS Projects:** Bhainsa, Khanapur, Mudhole, Nirmal
* **Selection Basis:** Merit-based selection (No written exam).

### 🏆 Selection Process
Selection is based on total marks awarded by the District-level Selection Committee:
* **Intermediate Marks (Merit):** 70 Marks
* **Interview:** 10 Marks
* **Special Category Bonus:** 
    * Orphans: 10 Marks
    * Widows: 5 Marks
    * PwD: 5 Marks

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Visit the official department website.
2. Identify the AWC ID/Name relevant to your local Gram Panchayat/Ward.
3. Ensure you match the reserved category for that specific center.
4. Submit the online application form before the deadline.

website_content.title: Kerala LLB 5-Year Integrated Law Counselling Vacant Seat Round 2026
website_content.summary: CEE Kerala has opened the Mop-Up round for admission to Integrated Five-Year LLB (LLB5) programmes. Eligible candidates can now register fresh or revised options to secure remaining seats across state law colleges.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Commissioner for Entrance Examinations (CEE), Kerala, is conducting the **Vacant Seat (Mop-Up) Round** for admission to the Integrated Five-Year LLB (LLB5) programme. This round is designed to fill seats remaining after the regular Phase 1 and Phase 2 allotment rounds due to non-reporting or category conversions.

## Key Highlights
* **Exam Name:** Kerala Law Entrance Examination (KLEE) 2026
* **Course:** Integrated Five-Year LLB (LLB5)
* **Stage:** Vacant Seat / Mop-Up Round
* **Authority:** CEE, Kerala

## Important Dates
* **KLEE 2026 Exam:** June 28, 2026
* **Final Rank List:** July 29, 2026
* **Phase 1 Allotment:** August 17, 2026
* **Phase 2 Allotment:** September 3, 2026
* **Mop-Up Round:** Currently Active/Upcoming (Check portal for specific deadlines)

## How to Register for Mop-Up Round
1. Visit the official CEE Kerala portal.
2. Access the **'Integrated Five Year LLB 2026 - Candidate Portal'**.
3. Log in using your application number and password.
4. Review the college-wise and category-wise vacant seats.
5. Submit your preferred options in order of priority.
6. Pay the registration fee if applicable and print the confirmation.

## Critical Instructions
* **Finality:** Allotments in the mop-up round are generally treated as final.
* **Previous Admissions:** If a new seat is allotted, previous admissions are typically cancelled.
* **Verification:** Regularly monitor your registered email and mobile number for official updates.
