website_content.title: UPESSC Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: UPESSC is recruiting 12,405 Assistant Teachers for Urban and Sambaddh Primary posts across Uttar Pradesh. Applications are open from September 16, 2026, for qualified candidates with a degree, BTC, and TET.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Uttar Pradesh Shiksha Seva Chayan Aayog (UPESSC)**, Prayagraj, has announced a massive recruitment drive for Assistant Teachers under the Basic and Secondary Education Departments.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Total Vacancies:** 12,405
* **Assistant Teacher (Primary, Urban):** 11,508 posts (Basic Education Dept)
* **Assistant Teacher (Sambaddh Primary):** 897 posts (Secondary Education Dept)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * Graduate degree from a recognized university.
    * Training qualification: B.T.C. / D.El.Ed. / B.El.Ed. or equivalent.
    * Must have qualified the **Teacher Eligibility Test (TET)** conducted by State or Central Government.
* **Age Limit (as of 01.07.2026):**
    * **Urban Posts:** 21–40 years.
    * **Sambaddh Primary:** Minimum 21 years.
    * *Age relaxations apply for SC/ST/OBC (5 years), PwBD (15 years), and Shiksha Mitras (up to 60 years).*

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15.09.2026
* **Application Start Date:** 16.09.2026
* **Last Date for Fee Payment:** 15.10.2026
* **Correction Window:** Until 19.10.2026
* **Written Exam Date:** 03 & 04 December 2026

## Salary & Application Fee
* **Salary:** Pay Level-6 (₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400)
* **Application Fee:**
    * General/OBC/EWS: ₹1,000
    * SC/ST: ₹500
    * PwBD: ₹300

## Selection Process & Exam Pattern
Selection is based on a **Merit List** derived from a written examination:
* **Total Marks:** 360 marks
* **Questions:** 120 Objective Type (MCQs)
* **Duration:** 2 Hours
* **Marking:** +3 for correct answer; -1 for wrong answer (Negative Marking applies).
* **Language:** Bilingual (Hindi & English).

## Overview
The **Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS)** has officially released the **Phase 2 (Competent Authority Quota)** seat allotment list for the MBBS course for the academic session 2026-27.

* **Allotment Release Date:** September 15, 2026
* **Phase 2 Reporting Deadline:** September 19, 2026 (by 4:00 PM)

* **Reporting:** Candidates must report to the allotted college, complete document verification, and pay the required fees strictly before the deadline.

* **Eligibility Warning:** Failure to join after the Phase 2 allotment will result in ineligibility for any subsequent counseling rounds.

2. Navigate to the "Phase 2 MBBS Seat Allotment 2026-27" link.

website_content.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Shiksha Seva Chayan Ayog (UPESSC) is recruiting 2,607 Pravakta (PGT/Lecturer) posts across 26 subjects. Eligible candidates must apply online by October 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The UP Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has announced direct recruitment for **2,607 Pravakta (PGT/Lecturer)** positions in government-aided secondary schools across Uttar Pradesh under Advertisement No. 06/2026.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 18 September 2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 17 October 2026
* **Application Correction Last Date:** 21 October 2026
* **Written Examination:** 15 and 16 December 2026

## Vacancy Details
A total of **2,607 vacancies** are available across 26 subjects:
* **Boys' Schools:** 2,329 posts
* **Girls' Schools:** 278 posts
* **Top Subjects:** Hindi (374), English (285), Sanskrit (264), and Geography (248).

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Education:** 
    * **General Subjects:** Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject AND a B.Ed degree from an NCTE-recognized programme.
    * **Physical Education:** Graduate degree AND M.P.Ed.
    * **Painting Arts:** High School + Diploma in Fine Arts AND B.Ed.
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 62 years (as of 1 July 2026).
* **Nationality:** Must be a citizen of India.

## Salary & Benefits
* **Pay Level:** Level-8
* **Pay Scale:** ₹47,600 – ₹1,51,100

## Selection Process
The final merit list is based on a total of **400 marks**:
1. **Written Examination (360 Marks):** 120 objective questions (30 GK + 90 Subject-specific). Marking: +3 for correct, -1 for wrong.
2. **Interview (40 Marks):** Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview.

## Application Fee
* **General / OBC / EWS:** ₹1,500
* **SC / ST:** ₹750
* **PwD:** ₹500

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The University of Petroleum and Energy Studies (UPES), Dehradun, has activated the registration process for **B.Tech Admissions for the 2027-28 academic session**. Aspiring engineers can now apply through multiple entrance pathways.

* **UPESEAT** (UPES Engineering Aptitude Test)

* **CUET UG**
* **Class 12 Board Merit**
* **SAT**

* **Application Fee:** ₹1,750 (specifically for the UPESEAT route)

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. Visit the official UPES admissions portal.

5. Upload necessary documents and pay the application fee online.
6. Review and submit the form; download the confirmation page for future use.

## Important Instructions

* Review specific eligibility criteria for different B.Tech specializations as they may vary.
* Keep monitoring the official portal for announcements regarding exam dates, admit cards, and results.

website_content.title: BSA Gorakhpur KGBV Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: BSA Gorakhpur invites offline applications from eligible female candidates for 132 contract-based teaching and non-teaching posts in KGBV schools. The application deadline is September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Office of the District Basic Education Officer (BSA), Gorakhpur, is hiring for various contract-based (**Samvida**) positions for the 2026-27 academic session. These roles are specifically for Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalayas (KGBV) and upgraded KGBVs.

**⚠️ Important:** Only **Female Candidates** are eligible to apply.

## Vacancy Details (Total: 132 Posts)

### Teaching Posts
* **Principal:** 4 Posts
* **PGT (Hindi, English, Maths, Bio, Chem, Phys, CS):** Multiple Posts
* **Full-Time Teachers (Classes 6-8):** Multiple Posts
* **Part-Time Teachers (Computer, Art, Craft, Music):** Multiple Posts

### Non-Teaching Posts
* **Accountant / Office Superintendent / Clerk**
* **Lab Assistant**
* **Head Cook / Assistant Cook**
* **Peon / Chowkidar**

## Eligibility & Qualification
* **Principal/PGT:** Post Graduate with B.Ed.
* **Full-Time Teacher:** Graduate with B.Ed.
* **Accountant:** Graduate in Commerce with Computer knowledge.
* **Clerk:** Intermediate pass with typing proficiency (Hindi 25 wpm / English 30 wpm).
* **Support Staff (Cook/Peon/Chowkidar):** Class 8th Pass.

## Age Limit (as of 01-04-2026)
* **General Posts:** 25 to 45 Years
* **Principal:** 30 to 45 Years

## Salary (Monthly Honorarium)
* **Principal:** ₹30,000
* **PGT:** ₹22,000
* **Full-Time Teacher:** ₹25,410
* **Clerk/Accountant:** ₹11,000 - ₹12,705
* **Support Staff:** ₹5,978 - ₹7,970

## Selection Process
* **Merit-Based:** Principal, PGT, Teachers, Accountant, and Lab Assistant (based on academic marks).
* **Typing Test:** Office Superintendent/Clerk.
* **Interview:** Cook, Peon, and Chowkidar.

## How to Apply
1. Download the application form from the official district website.
2. Fill the form clearly (no overwriting) and attach self-attested documents.
3. Enclose **three self-addressed envelopes** with ₹58 postage stamps each.
4. Send via **Registered Post/Speed Post** to: *Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Sitapur Aankh Ka Aspatal Campus, Park Road, Gorakhpur – 273001*.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Admission Overview
Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS), Warangal, is inviting applications for the **Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing) 2 Years Degree Course (2 YDC)** for the Academic Year 2026-27. This admission process covers seats under the **Competent Authority Quota** in both Government and Private Nursing colleges across Telangana.

## Key Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15-09-2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 16-09-2026 (09:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 24-09-2026 (05:00 PM)

## Course Details
* **Course:** Post Basic B.Sc. (Nursing)
* **Duration:** 2 Years
* **Academic Year:** 2026-27
* **Quota:** Competent Authority (Convener) Quota

## Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Registration:** Visit the portal and register using a valid mobile number and email ID (OTP verification required).
2. **Form Filling:** Complete the registration form with accurate candidate details.
3. **Payment:** Confirm caste category and pay the non-refundable registration fee through the payment gateway.
4. **Login:** Use your Roll Number and Registration Number to access the application form.
5. **Uploads:** Upload a passport-size photo and signature (both must be in JPG/JPEG format and under 100 KB).
6. **Documentation:** Upload all required certificates and print the final application for reference.

## Important Guidelines
* **Anti-Drug Policy:** Candidates must tick the Anti-Drug undertaking and submit a signed declaration from both the student and parent/guardian at the time of admission.
* **Zero Tolerance:** Ragging is strictly prohibited and can lead to immediate cancellation of the seat.
* **Updates:** No individual notifications will be sent; candidates must monitor the official website regularly.
* **Accuracy:** Providing false information may lead to criminal action.

Vadodara Municipal Corporation (VMC) has released notification No. 382/2025-27 for filling **178 vacancies** across 15 different categories. These positions are on a **purely temporary, 11-month contract basis**.

## Vacancy Details & Remuneration
The roles vary from high-level planning to technical assistance. Key positions include:
* **Urban Planner:** 05 Posts (₹80,000/month)
* **Archaeology and Museology Officer:** 01 Post (₹50,000/month)
* **Dy. Environmental Engineer:** 04 Posts (₹43,950/month)
* **Assistant Environmental Engineer:** 19 Posts (₹39,250/month)
* **Garden Supervisor/Assistant:** 57 Posts (₹20,000 - ₹30,000/month)
* **Work Assistants (Civil/Mech/Elec):** 68 Posts (₹20,000/month)
* **Other roles:** GIS Operator, Librarian, Draftsman, and Surveyor.

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **45 years** for all posts.
* **Educational Qualifications:** 
    * **Technical Roles:** Diploma/Degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering.
    * **Specialized Roles:** Masters in Urban Planning, Post-Graduate in Archaeology, or B.Sc in Horticulture.
    * **Support Roles:** ITI certificates for Draftsman and Surveyors, B.Lib for Librarians.
* **Experience:** Required for specific senior roles (ranging from 1 to 10 years depending on the post).

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 11/09/2026

## Application Process
Applications must be submitted **online** via the official VMC portal. Candidates should ensure all documents are ready for upload as per the Gujarati instructions provided in the official notification.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University (KBCNMU), Jalgaon, is inviting applications for the post of **Temporary Assistant Professor (Contract)** for the academic year 2026-27. These positions are self-supporting and based on a contract.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 138 posts across 54 subject codes.
* **Nature of Job:** Purely temporary and contract basis.
* **Posting Locations:** University Schools/Departments (Jalgaon), Science and Commerce College (Molgi), and Tribal Academy (Nandurbar).

* **Notification Date:** 11.09.2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 12.09.2026
* **Online Application Deadline:** 28.09.2026
* **Hard Copy Submission Deadline:** 05.10.2026 (up to 5:00 PM)

## Eligibility Criteria
Eligibility varies based on the subject group:

**1. UGC/State Government Rules (General Subjects):**
* Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject.
* Must have cleared **NET/SET** or hold a **Ph.D.** degree as per UGC regulations.

**2. AICTE Rules (Computer Science/IT & Engineering):**
* **CS/IT:** B.E./B.Tech/B.S. & M.E./M.Tech/M.S. or B.E./B.Tech & MCA with first class in any one degree.
* **Engineering/Tech:** B.E./B.Tech/B.S. & M.E./M.Tech/M.S. with first class in any one degree.
* **Management:** Master's degree in Business Administration/PGDM/CA/ICWA/M.Com with first class and 2 years of professional experience.

## Selection Process
* **Short-listing:** Based on Maharashtra Government Resolution dated 08 March 2019 (Table 3A).
* **Final Selection:** Through a personal interview.

## Application Fee
* **Open Category:** Rs. 750/-
* **Reserved Category:** Rs. 375/-

website_content.markdown_content:
## AIIMS B.Sc. Nursing & Allied Health Care Open Round 2026

AIIMS New Delhi has opened the **final round (Open Round)** for seat allocation for the August-2026 session. This is the last opportunity for eligible candidates to secure a seat.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Vacancies:** 239 vacant seats for B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing across 19 participating AIIMS institutes.
* **Courses Covered:** B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing and B.Sc. Allied & Health Care Courses.
* **Security Deposit:** A mandatory deposit of **Rs 25,000** is required for eligibility.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration & Choice Filling:** September 11 to September 16, 2026 (until 5:00 PM)
* **Seat Surrender Deadline:** September 15, 2026 (for existing seat holders)
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 19, 2026
* **Reporting/Joining Period:** September 24 to September 28, 2026

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* **Eligibility Requirement:** Candidates must complete **both** the registration/choice filling and the payment of the security deposit to be considered.
* **Payment Warning:** The security deposit must be paid from the **candidate's, parent's, or relative's bank account**. Payments from cyber cafés or shared accounts are strictly prohibited as refunds are processed to the original source account.
* **Penalty Clause:** Candidates who are allotted a seat but fail to report within the stipulated dates will face a **penalty of Rs 25,000** in addition to the forfeiture of their security deposit.

### 🛠️ How to Register
1. Log in to the official portal using entrance exam credentials.
2. Click on the **'Open Round of Seat Allocation'** link.
3. Verify details and select preferred AIIMS institutes in order of priority.
4. Submit choices and pay the security deposit via the online payment link.

website_content.title: GADVASU Group C Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: GADVASU Ludhiana is inviting online applications for 45 Group C positions including Steno Typist, Clerk, and Storekeeper. The application window is open from September 16 to October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GADVASU Group C Recruitment 2026

Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University (GADVASU), Ludhiana, has released Advertisement No. 03/2026 for the recruitment of **45 Group C posts**. 

### Vacancy Details
* **Clerk:** 20 Posts
* **Steno Typist:** 15 Posts
* **Storekeeper:** 10 Posts
* **Total:** 45 Vacancies

### Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualifications:**
* **Storekeeper:** Bachelor's degree with Economics / B.Com / B.B.A.
* **Clerk & Steno-Typist:** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.

**Mandatory Requirements (All Posts):**
* **Computer Proficiency:** 120-hour certified course in PC use/IT or 'O' level certificate from DOEACC.
* **Punjabi Language:** Must have passed Matriculation in Punjabi from PSEB or a recognized board.

### Selection Process
All candidates must first pass the **Qualifying Punjabi Language Test (Exam-I)**. Following this, the process differs by post:

* **Storekeeper:** Main Examination (Exam-II) focusing on General Knowledge and Core Subjects (Commercial Math, GST, Store Keeping, etc.).
* **Clerk:** Main Examination (Exam-II) followed by a **Qualifying Typing Proficiency Test** in both Punjabi (Raavi font) and English.
* **Steno-Typist:** Main Examination (Exam-II) and a **Shorthand Proficiency Test** (English & Punjabi), where shorthand marks contribute to the final merit.

### Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 16 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 8 October 2026 (4:00 PM)
* **Hard Copy Deadline (In-service only):** 21 October 2026

website_content.markdown_content:
## MAT September 2026 CBT Admit Card Details

The **All India Management Association (AIMA)** is set to release the hall tickets for the Management Aptitude Test (MAT) September 2026 session. Candidates who registered for the Computer Based Test (CBT) can access their admit cards starting from **5:00 PM on September 17, 2026**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **CBT Registration Closing Date:** September 14, 2026
* **PBT Admit Card Release:** September 10, 2026
* **PBT Exam Date:** September 13, 2026
* **CBT Admit Card Release:** September 17, 2026 (Expected)
* **CBT Exam Date:** September 20, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download Admit Card
1. Visit the official website **mat.aima.in**.
2. Click on the login link for registered candidates.
3. Enter your **registered email ID/application number** and **password**.
4. Locate the "MAT CBT Admit Card" link on your dashboard.
5. Download and verify all details carefully.
6. **Print two clear copies** on A4-size paper for the exam day.

### ⚠️ Essential Instructions
* **Mandatory Document:** Entry to the exam hall is strictly prohibited without the admit card.
* **Center Allotment:** Test center changes are not permitted once the admit card is issued.
* **Discrepancies:** Contact AIMA immediately if any errors are found in the admit card.
* **Reporting:** Reach the test center well before the reporting time mentioned on the hall ticket.

## SSC Selection Post Phase XIV 2026 Admit Card

The **Staff Selection Commission (SSC)** has officially released the hall tickets for the **Selection Post Phase 14 Examination 2026** (Advt. No. Phase XIV/2026). Candidates who successfully applied during the window of 13 April to 4 May 2026 can now download their admit cards via the official portal.

### 📅 Key Examination Dates
* **Admit Card Release Date:** 14 September 2026
* **Exam Duration:** 16 September to 26 September 2026
* **Exam Mode:** Computer-Based Examination (CBE)
* **Daily Schedule:** 3 shifts per day

### 🛠 How to Download Your Admit Card
1. Visit the official SSC website: **ssc.gov.in**.
2. Navigate to the **"Login"** or **"Candidate Corner"** section.
3. Select the appropriate regional website if required.
4. Click on the link for **"SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Admit Card 2026"**.
5. Enter your **Registration Number/Roll Number** and **Date of Birth or Password**.
6. Submit the details to view and download your admit card.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* Carefully verify your **exam date, shift, reporting time, and venue**.

website_content.title: APPSC Welfare Officers Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: APPSC announces recruitment for 90 posts of Assistant Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, and Hostel Welfare Officers. Online applications are open from 9 October to 29 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The **Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)** has issued brief notifications (No. 25/2026 & 26/2026) for direct recruitment to various welfare officer positions across the state's Social, Tribal, and Backward Classes Welfare departments.

## Vacancy Details
A total of **90 provisional vacancies** are available:
* **Assistant Social Welfare Officer:** 11 Posts
* **Assistant Tribal Welfare Officer:** 06 Posts
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** 73 Posts (Distributed across Social, Tribal, and BC Welfare services)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Assistant Social/Tribal Welfare Officer:** Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university or equivalent.
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** Educational qualifications will be specified in the Detailed Notification (due by 9 October 2026).
* **Crucial Date:** The date of the Detailed Notification will be the cutoff date for age and qualification eligibility.

## Salary Structure
* **Assistant Welfare Officers:** ₹48,440 – 1,37,220
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** ₹37,640 – 1,15,500

## Selection Process
Selection will be based on a **single-level online Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT)**. There will be no screening test regardless of the number of applications.

**Exam Scheme:**
* **Assistant Welfare Officers:** 3 Papers (General Studies & Mental Ability + 2 Subject Papers), Total 450 Marks.
* **Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II:** 2 Papers (General Studies & Mental Ability + Education), Total 300 Marks.
* **Negative Marking:** 1/3rd mark deduction for each wrong answer.

## Important Dates
* **Detailed Notification:** On or before 9 October 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 9 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 29 October 2026 (11:59 PM)

website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview

Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released brief notifications for three distinct technical roles. Candidates must apply online via the official portal.

* **Horticulture Officer (A.P. Horticulture Service):** 37 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Horticulture Officer:** 4-year B.Sc. Degree / B.Sc. (Hons) Degree in Horticulture from a recognized University/ICAR accredited institution.
* **Assistant Director (FSL):** 
    * **Forensic Engineering:** B.E. in Mechanical/Structural/Civil/Production Engineering.
    * **Physics:** M.Sc. in Physics or equivalent (Material Science, Nuclear Physics, etc.).
    * **Chemistry:** M.Sc. in Chemistry or B.Sc. with A.I.C. in Forensic Sciences.
    * **Biology:** M.Sc. in Botany/Zoology/Microbiology/Biochemistry/Bio-Tech/Genetics/Forensic Science or Degree in Medicine with B.Sc.
    * *Note: 5 years practical experience in Forensic/Analytical/Police Lab is required for AD (FSL) posts.*
* **Assistant Environmental Engineer:** Educational qualifications will be specified in the Detailed Notification (due by 6 Oct).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Detailed Notification:** By 6 October 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 6 October 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 27 October 2026 (11:59 PM)

### 💰 Salary Scale
* **Assistant Environmental Engineer & AD (FSL):** Rs. 57,100 – 1,47,760
* **Horticulture Officer:** Rs. 54,060 – 1,40,540

### ✍️ Selection Process
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT - Online).
* **Pattern:** Single-level examination (No screening test).
* **Negative Marking:** 1/3rd mark deduction for wrong answers (Confirmed for Env. Engineer & Horticulture Officer).
* **Additional Test:** Computer Proficiency Test (CPT) required for Environmental Engineer and AD (FSL).

website_content.markdown_content:
## UP NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Counselling

The **Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh**, has announced the commencement of Round 2 counselling for MBBS and BDS courses. This round aims to fill the remaining vacancies across government and private medical colleges in the state.

### 🎓 Seats Available
* **Government Colleges:** 85% State Quota seats.
* **Private Colleges/Universities:** 100% State Quota seats.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Registration Window:** September 14, 2026 to September 17, 2026
* **Registration Fee Deadline:** September 17, 2026
* **Merit List Release:** September 17, 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking:** September 17 to September 19, 2026
* **Seat Allotment Result:** September 21, 2026
* **Reporting to College:** September 22 to September 25, 2026

### 📝 Registration Process
1. Visit the official portal and click on the **Round 2 Registration link**.

website_content.title: APPSC Recruitment 2026: Apply for 255 Assistant Director, Statistical Officer & Other Posts
website_content.summary: APPSC has announced 255 provisional vacancies for various technical and administrative roles. Applications are open from October 13 to November 2, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview
The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released notifications for direct recruitment to 255 provisional vacancies across six diverse roles. Selection will be based on a single-level Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 13 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 02 November 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Crucial Date for Eligibility:** Date of Detailed Notification

### 💼 Post-wise Vacancy & Salary Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Pay Scale (Rs.) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Assistant Statistical Officer | 196 | 37,640 - 1,15,500 |
| Analyst Grade-II | 18 | 48,440 - 1,37,220 |
| Assistant Director (Econ & Stat) | 17 | 57,100 - 1,47,760 |
| Inspector of Factories | 12 | 65,360 - 1,54,980 |
| English/Telugu Reporters | 11 | 57,100 - 1,47,760 |
| Assistant Director (Tribal Welfare) | 01 | 48,440 - 1,37,220 |

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Inspector of Factories:** Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Industrial Engineering + 2 years industrial experience.
* **Reporters:** Bachelor's Degree + Shorthand and Typewriting qualifications (English/Telugu).
* **Assistant Statistical Officer:** Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as a main subject or as a paper in the degree.
* **Analyst Grade-II:** Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Bio-Chemistry, Biology or Environmental Sciences.
* **Assistant Director (Tribal Welfare):** Master's Degree in Social Anthropology, Sociology or Social Work + 2 national journal publications.
* **Assistant Director (Econ & Stat):** Postgraduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or Computer Science.

### ✍️ Selection Process
* **Mode:** Single-level online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT).
* **Screening:** No screening test will be conducted.
* **Marking:** 1/3rd negative marking for wrong answers in objective papers.

## TS LAWCET 2026 Round 3 Counselling Overview
The Telangana Council of Higher Education (TGCHE) is conducting the **Round 3 (Phase 3) Counselling** for law admissions. This is a critical opportunity for candidates who qualified the TS LAWCET 2026 to secure a seat in prestigious law colleges.

* **Course Options:** 3-Year LLB and 5-Year Integrated LLB

1. Visit the official counselling portal.
2. Log in using your **TS LAWCET 2026 Hall Ticket Number** and credentials.
3. Complete the registration-cum-verification form with academic and personal details.
4. Upload clear, scanned copies of required certificates.
5. Pay the applicable counselling fee online.
6. Submit the form and download the confirmation page.
7. Track certificate verification status for web options and seat allotment.

### Important Instructions

* **Security:** Never share your OTP or login password with third parties.
* **Documentation:** Ensure all uploaded documents are valid and clear to avoid rejection.
* **Deadlines:** Failure to report by the seat allotment deadline will result in cancellation of the seat.

website_content.summary: APPSC invites online applications for 299 provisional vacancies across 8 subordinate services in Andhra Pradesh. Applications are open from October 16 to November 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Recruitment 2026 Overview
The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released brief notifications for **299 provisional vacancies** across eight different subordinate services. Selection will be based on a single-level **Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT)**.

## Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Vacancies | Pay Scale (₹) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| Executive Officer Grade-III | 104 | 25,220 – 80,910 |
| Industrial Promotion Officer | 78 | 54,060 – 1,40,540 |
| Supervisor Grade-I (Women Only) | 29 | 37,640 – 1,15,500 |
| Forest Section Officer | 26 | 32,670 – 1,01,970 |
| Forest Beat Officer | 23 | 25,220 – 80,910 |
| Draughtsman Grade-II | 20 | 34,580 – 1,07,210 |
| District Probation Officer Grade-II | 15 | 44,570 – 1,27,480 |
| Forest Range Officer | 04 | 48,440 – 1,37,220 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Executive Officer Grade-III:** Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university.
* **District Probation Officer:** Bachelor's in Social Work/Psychology or specified Master's degree.
* **Supervisor Grade-I:** Bachelor's in Home Science, BSW, Sociology, or specified B.Sc. streams (Women only).
* **Forest Section Officer:** Bachelor's degree in Science/Engineering (specific subjects).
* **Draughtsman Grade-II:** ITI Trade Certificate in Draughtsman (Civil).
* **Forest Beat Officer:** Intermediate (12th) pass or equivalent.
* **Forest Range Officer:** Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Science, or Engineering (specific subjects).

## Important Dates
* **Detailed Notification:** On or before 16 October 2026
* **Online Application Starts:** 16 October 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 5 November 2026 (11:59 PM)

## Selection Process
* **Mode:** Online Computer-Based Recruitment Test (CBRT).
* **Stages:** Single-level examination (No Screening Test).
* **Normalization:** Marks will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple sessions.

website_content.title: Mysore City Corporation (MCC) UGD Helper Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Mysuru Mahanagara Palike is recruiting 116 UGD Helpers through a special internal process. Applications must be submitted offline by October 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Mysuru Mahanagara Palike (MCC) has announced a **special, one-time recruitment** for 116 UGD Helper (Under Ground Drainage Helper) positions. Please note that this is **not an open recruitment** and is restricted to existing personnel.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 116
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 27,000 – Rs. 46,675
* **Application Mode:** Offline (In-person submission)
* **Selection Basis:** Purely on merit based on length of continuous service

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Employment Status:** Must be currently working in MCC on daily-wage, contract, outsourcing, or equal-pay-for-equal-work terms.
* **Experience:** Minimum **2 years of continuous service** performing UGD Helper or equivalent duties.
* **Language:** Must be conversant in **Kannada**.
* **Exclusions:** Candidates engaged through STP (Sewage Treatment Plant) or Wet Well contracts are not eligible.
* **Age Limit:** 18 to 55 years.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 09 October 2026, 5:30 PM

## Documents Required
* Prescribed application form with passport-size photo
* Proof of Date of Birth
* Certified proof of current engagement and service length at MCC
* Certified ESI and PF documents
* Relevant Caste/Income/Rural/Disability certificates (if applicable)

## How to Apply
1. Collect the free application form from the **MCC Central Office, Sayyaji Rao Road, Mysuru-570004**.
2. Fill in the details accurately and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
3. Submit the completed form **by hand** at the MCC Central Office on or before the deadline.

website_content.title: Deoghar Home Guard (Grih Rakshak) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: JGRV Deoghar has announced 772 vacancies for Rural and Urban Home Guard posts. Eligible candidates from Deoghar district must apply online by October 26, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Overview
Jharkhand Griha Raksha Vahini (JGRV), Deoghar has released Advertisement No. 01/2026 for the enrolment of **Home Guards (Grih Rakshak)**. This is a voluntary enrolment opportunity for residents of Deoghar to serve the nation.

## 📊 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **772**
* **Rural Home Guard:** 635 Posts (Block-wise distribution)
* **Urban Home Guard:** 137 Posts (Technical & Non-Technical)
* **Women's Reservation:** 50% of posts are earmarked for women.

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
### 1. Educational Qualification
* **Rural Home Guard:** Minimum 7th class pass.
* **Urban Home Guard:** Minimum Matric (10th) pass.

### 2. Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 19 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 40 Years

### 3. Residence
* Candidates must be permanent/ordinary residents of the respective Deoghar block or urban area.

### 4. Physical Standards
| Parameter | Male (Gen/OBC/BC) | Male (ST/SC) | Female (All) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Height** | 162 cm | 157 cm | 148 cm |
| **Chest** | 79 cm | 76 cm | N/A |

## 🛠️ Selection Process
1. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** Race, High Jump, Long Jump, and Shot Put.
2. **Hindi Writing Ability Test:** Qualifying test (30% minimum marks).
3. **Technical Skill Test:** Only for Urban Technical candidates.
4. **Final Phase:** Merit List $\rightarrow$ Document Verification $\rightarrow$ Medical $\rightarrow$ Police Verification.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 11 October 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 26 October 2026 (up to 5:00 PM)
* **Exam Dates:** To be announced via newspapers/website.

## 💰 Application Fee & Allowance
* **Fee:** Rs. 100/- (Online payment)
* **Allowance:** This is a **voluntary enrolment**, not a salaried job. Duty allowance is paid only for days actually deployed on duty.

website_content.summary: Surat Municipal Corporation has released the provisional answer keys and OMR download instructions for Supervisor, Junior Pharmacist, Assistant Auditor, and Technical Officer posts. Candidates must submit objections by September 15, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SMC Provisional Answer Key 2026

The Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) Recruitment Department has released the official notice regarding the provisional answer keys for the written examinations held on **06/09/2026**. This update is critical for candidates who appeared for the following positions:

* **Supervisor (Computer)**
* **Junior Pharmacist**
* **Assistant Auditor**
* **Technical Officer**

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notice Release Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Answer Key Objection Window:** 11 September to 15 September 2026
* **Last Date to Download OMR Sheet:** 17 September 2026

### 📥 How to Download Your OMR Sheet
Candidates must download their OMR sheets before the deadline to avoid missing out:
1. Visit the **RECRUITMENT** section on the official SMC website.
2. Click on the **"ANSWER KEY(S)"** link.
3. Enter your **Application Number** (Format: AAAA/BBBBBB/CCC/DDDDDD), **Seat Number**, and **Date of Birth**.
4. Save the PDF for your records.

### ⚠️ Objection Process (Query Reporting)
If you disagree with the provisional answer key, you may raise an objection under these conditions:
* **Format:** Use the prescribed "Query Reporting Form for Provisional Answer Key".
* **Evidence:** Attach a certified/self-attested color scanned copy of valid documentary evidence.
* **Submission:** Send via e-mail to the official recruitment email address.
* **Deadline:** Objections must be submitted between **11/09/2026 and 15/09/2026**. Objections after this window will not be considered.

## CGSSB FWLN26 Examination 2026

* **Sample Assistant** (Namuna Sahayak)

The **High Court of Judicature at Patna** has officially released the hall tickets for the recruitment of **Ex-Cadre Assistant (Group-C)** under Advt No. PHC/03/2026. website_content.summary: The National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu (NHM-TN) is inviting offline applications for 4,724 Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurse positions across various districts. The application deadline is September 25, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NHM Tamil Nadu Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026

The District Health Society, under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu, has announced a massive recruitment drive for **Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurses**. These positions are available across institutions under the Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Medical and Rural Health Services, Medical Education & Research, and the Greater Chennai Corporation.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 4,724
* **Post Name:** Contractual/Temporary Staff Nurse
* **Nature of Job:** Purely Temporary / Contract Basis
* **Application Mode:** Offline (Physical Submission)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Candidates must possess a **GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery)** or **B.Sc. Nursing** degree from an Indian Nursing Council-recognised institution.
* **Professional Registration:** Valid registration with the **Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council** is mandatory.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum age is **50 years**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 25-09-2026 (until 5:00 PM)

### 📍 Job Locations
Vacancies are available across districts of Tamil Nadu. 
**Note:** This recruitment is NOT applicable to **Tiruppur** and **Chengalpattu** districts due to the Model Code of Conduct.

### 📝 How to Apply
1. Download the application form and district-wise vacancy details from the official NHM-TN website.
2. Complete the form and attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents.
3. Submit the physical application to the **Office of the District Health Officer/District Health Society** of the concerned district by the deadline.

website_content.markdown_content:
## 👮 Ladakh Police Constable Recruitment 2026

The Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh, via the **Ladakh Police Subordinate Service Recruitment Board (LPSSRB)**, has announced direct recruitment for the post of **Constable (Level-02)**. 

### 📊 Vacancy Details
Total Vacancies: **331**
* **Executive, Armed/IRP, SDRF:** 141 Posts
* **Border Battalion:** 168 Posts (District-wise)
* **Women Battalion:** 22 Posts (District-wise)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** Passed 10th Class/Matriculation from a recognized board. 
  * *Special Case:* Serving SPOs with 3+ years of service are eligible with an 8th Pass qualification.
* **Age Limit (as of 01.01.2026):** 18 to 28 years.
  * **Relaxations:** SC/ST/ALC (5 years); Serving SPOs/VHGs (Up to 37 years).
* **Domicile:** Must possess a valid Domicile Certificate of the UT of Ladakh.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Physical Standard Test (PST):** Qualifying
2. **Physical Endurance Test (PET):** Qualifying
3. **Document Scrutiny:** Qualifying
4. **Incentive Marks:** Up to 5% for NCC/Computer/Driving License
5. **Written Examination:** 100 Marks (Objective Type)

### 📖 Written Exam Pattern
* **General Knowledge:** 60 Marks
* **Reasoning:** 15 Marks
* **Arithmetic Abilities:** 15 Marks
* **General Science:** 10 Marks
* **Duration:** 80 Minutes | **Negative Marking:** None

### 💰 Application Fee
* **UR/EWS:** ₹600
* **SC/ST/ALC:** ₹500

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 24 August 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 29 August 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 15 September 2026
* **PST/PET Commencement:** 22 September 2026 onwards

website_content.markdown_content:
## NPCIL Kakrapar Recruitment 2026 Result

The Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL), Kakrapar Site, has officially declared the results for advertisement **SITE/HRM/01/2025**. The post-wise merit lists and cut-off marks for selected and waitlisted candidates are now available.

**Key Highlights:**
* **Total Posts:** 197 Permanent Vacancies
* **Positions:** Stipendiary Trainee/Scientific Assistant (ST/SA), Stipendiary Trainee/Technician (ST/TN), and Assistant Grade-1
* **Result Date:** 11 September 2026
* **Selection Process:** Based on written examination merit

## Post-wise Merit List Availability
Results have been released for the following streams:
* **ST/SA (Category-I):** Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Chemical, Chemistry, and Physics.
* **ST/TN (Category-II):** Fitter, Electrician, Electronics, Instrumentation, Welder, Machinist, AC Mechanic, Diesel Mechanic, and Plant Operator.
* **Assistant Grade-1:** HR, F&A, and C&MM streams.

## How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official NPCIL careers portal.
2. Navigate to the notice board for advertisement **SITE/HRM/01/2025**.
3. Click on the merit list/cut-off link corresponding to your applied post/trade.

## Important Note
Candidates on the waitlist should wait for further official communication. Always verify results through the official portal to avoid unofficial or misleading information.

website_content.title: MPESB Naib Tehsildar Departmental Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: MPESB invites applications for 73 Naib Tehsildar posts through a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination. This recruitment is exclusively for eligible serving employees of the MP Revenue Department.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📢 Recruitment Overview
**MPESB** has announced the **Naib Tehsildar Departmental Limited Competitive Examination 2026**. Please note that this is a **Limited Departmental Exam** and is NOT open to the general public.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 17 September 2026
* **Application Deadline:** 01 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 17 September to 06 October 2026
* **Probable Exam Date:** Starting from 14 November 2026

### 🔢 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **73**
* **Clerical Service Cadre:** 46 Posts
* **Patwari/Revenue Inspector Cadre:** 27 Posts
*(Includes Direct Recruitment and Backlog vacancies)*

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Departmental Status:** Must be a regular/officiating employee for at least **5 years** in the Revenue Mandal, Commissioner Land Records, Principal Revenue Commissioner, Divisional Commissioner, or Collector establishments.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Arts, Science, Commerce, or Agriculture from a recognized university.
* **Age Limit:** Maximum **55 years** as of 01 January 2026.

### 💰 Salary & Fees
* **Pay Scale:** Level-9 (₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800)
* **Application Fee:** ₹2,000 (plus portal charges)

### ✍️ Selection Process
Selection is based on two objective-type papers (100 marks each):
* **Paper I:** General Reasoning, GK, Hindi, English, Maths, Science, and Computer Knowledge.
* **Paper II:** Govt Service Rules, Revenue Terminology, Land Revenue Code 1959, Revenue Book Circular, and Land Records Rules.
* **Qualifying Marks:** 55% for General; 40% for SC/ST.

website_content.title: SCVTUP UP ITI 2nd Allotment Result 2026
website_content.summary: The State Council for Vocational Training, Uttar Pradesh (SCVTUP) has released the 2nd round seat allotment results for ITI admissions 2026. Candidates must complete their physical reporting and fee payment by September 17, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP ITI Admission 2026 - 2nd Round Seat Allotment

The **State Council for Vocational Training, Uttar Pradesh (SCVTUP)** has announced the 2nd Allotment Result for admissions into Government and Private Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) across the state for the 2026 session.

### 📌 Key Admission Details
* **Admission Mode:** Purely Merit-Based (No written exam).
* **Eligibility Basis:** Marks obtained in Class 8th or Class 10th.
* **Allocation Process:** Seat allotment is conducted in multiple rounds. Candidates not allotted a seat in the first round are automatically considered for subsequent rounds.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **2nd Allotment Result Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Reporting & Fee Payment Deadline:** 17 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Allotment Result
1. Visit the official admission portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Round 2 seat allotment result'** section.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Password**.
4. View your allotted institute and trade/branch.
5. Download and print the **Seat Allotment Letter** for the physical reporting process.

### ⚠️ Crucial Instructions
* **Login Credentials:** Note that Round 2 requires an Application Number and Password (unlike Round 1 which used DOB).
* **Freeze vs Float:** If the option is available, 'Floating' allows you to seek a better seat in the next round, while 'Freezing' confirms your current seat.
* **Deadline:** Failure to report to the allotted institute by **17 September 2026** will result in the forfeiture of the seat.

website_content.markdown_content:
## WBUAFS B.F.Sc. (Hons.) Admission 2026-2027

The West Bengal University of Animal and Fishery Sciences (WBUAFS) has released the official notification for the **Counselling cum Admission** process for the 4-year Bachelor of Fishery Science [B.F.Sc. (Hons.)] degree program.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Counselling & Physical Reporting:** 15-09-2026
* **Reporting Time:** 10:45 A.M. to 11:45 A.M.
* **Commencement of Classes:** 16-09-2026

### 🎓 Course Overview
* **Course:** Bachelor of Fishery Science [B.F.Sc. (Hons.)]
* **Duration:** 4 Years
* **Academic Session:** 2026-2027

### 📜 Reservation & Eligibility Rules
* **OBC Candidates:** Must provide a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026. Without this, candidates will be treated as General/UR.
* **EWS Certificates:** Must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 as per West Bengal Government guidelines.
* **Domicile Proof:** Domicile certificates issued by elected representatives (MLA, MP, Councilor, etc.) are **NOT acceptable**. Use Proforma b or e-District certificates.
* **PwD:** Seats are filled on a horizontal basis within respective categories.

### ⚠️ Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Merit-Based:** Admissions are strictly based on the Provisional Merit List.
* **Documents:** Original documents are mandatory for verification during reporting.
* **Anti-Ragging:** Selected candidates must submit an online Anti-Ragging affidavit via www.antiragging.in or www.amanmovement.org at the time of registration.
* **Provisional Nature:** All admissions are provisional and subject to verification of documents and eligibility.

website_content.title: ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026: Apply for Technical Assistant, Technician 'B' & More
website_content.summary: ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) invites online applications for 22 specialized posts across various technical and support roles. The application window is open from 15 September to 5 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚀 ISRO IPRC Recruitment 2026

The **ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC)**, located in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu, has released a recruitment notification (Advt No. IPRC/RMT/2026/01) for various technical and support positions. 

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 12 September 2026
* **Application Start Date:** 15 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 05 October 2026

### 🛠️ Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Total Posts | Qualification |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Technical Assistant** (Auto/Mech/EC) | 5 | First Class Diploma in relevant branch |
| **Technician 'B'** (Turner/Fitter/Welder/etc) | 13 | 10th Std + ITI (NCVT/NAC) |
| **Cook 'A'** | 1 | 10th Std + 5 Years Experience |
| **Fireman 'A'** | 3 | 10th Std + Physical Fitness |

### 💰 Pay Scale
* **Technical Assistant:** Level 7 (Rs. 44,900 – Rs. 1,42,400)
* **Technician ‘B’:** Level 3 (Rs. 21,700 – Rs. 69,100)
* **Cook ‘A’ & Fireman ‘A’:** Level 2 (Rs. 19,900 – Rs. 63,200)

### 🎓 Eligibility Highlights
* **Technical Assistant:** Must possess a **First Class Diploma** in the specified engineering discipline.
* **Technician 'B':** Must have passed **10th/SSC** and hold an **ITI certificate** with NTC/NAC from NCVT.
* **Cook 'A':** Requires a certificate of experience from a well-established hotel/canteen (individual certificates not accepted).
* **Fireman 'A':** Requires 10th pass and a **Preliminary Medical Examination Certificate** to be uploaded during application.

### 📝 Selection Process
* **Cook 'A':** Selection involves a **Skill Test** based on experience certificates.
* **Fireman 'A':** Candidates must meet prescribed **Physical Fitness Standards**.
* For other posts, please refer to the detailed advertisement on the official portal.

website_content.title: HAL Design Trainee & Management Trainee Interview Call Letter 2026
website_content.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has released the interview call letters for the Design Trainee (DT) and Management Trainee (MT) 2026 recruitment. Shortlisted candidates can now download their letters for the personal interviews scheduled in Bengaluru.
website_content.markdown_content:
## HAL DT & MT Interview Call Letter 2026

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), a Maharatna CPSE, has officially issued the **Interview Call Letters** for candidates who cleared the CBT written exam for the posts of **Design Trainee (DT)** and **Management Trainee (MT)**.

### 📌 Quick Overview
* **Organization:** Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)
* **Advertisement No:** HAL/CHRC-TM/RECT-02/2026
* **Total Vacancies:** 120 (60 DT + 60 MT)
* **Current Stage:** Interview Call Letter Download
* **Interview Venue:** Bengaluru

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Interview Call Letter Release:** 12 September 2026
* **Personal Interview Dates:** 21 to 25 September 2026

### 🛠️ How to Download Call Letter
1. Visit the official login portal at **cbexams.com**.
2. Navigate to the link for **Interview Call Letter - DT/MT 2026**.
3. Log in using your **Application Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Download the call letter and take at least two clear printouts.

### 📂 Documents Required for Interview
* **Printed Call Letter:** Mandatory copy of the interview letter.
* **Identity Proof:** Valid government-issued photo ID.
* **Educational Records:** Original and photocopies of all mark sheets and degree certificates.
* **Category Certificate:** Valid SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates (if applicable).
* **PwBD Certificate:** From a competent authority (if claiming reservation).

### ⚠️ Key Instructions
* **Single Application:** Candidates who applied for both DT and MT posts face rejection.
* **Posting Locations:** Selected trainees may be posted in Bengaluru, Tumakuru, Hyderabad, Nasik, Koraput, Barrackpore, Lucknow, Kanpur, or Korwa.
* **Caution:** HAL does not take payments for employment; beware of fraudsters.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Bharathiar University Result 2026

Bharathiar University, Coimbatore, has announced the results for multiple examination cycles across various academic streams. Results are released on a rolling basis depending on the evaluation cycle.

**Categories Covered:**
* **UG & PG Exams** (Affiliated Colleges)
* **University Department Exams**
* **Distance/Online Education** (CDOE/SDE)
* **M.Phil & Ph.D. Exams**

**How to Check Your Result:**
1. Visit the official university portal.
2. Navigate to the **Students** section and click on **Results**.
3. Select the applicable **category** (e.g., Affiliated Colleges or CDOE).
4. Choose the specific **examination cycle** (Month/Year).
5. Enter your **Register Number** and click Submit.
6. Download the **provisional mark sheet** (PDF) for your records.

**Important Instructions:**
* **Provisional Status:** The online mark sheet is provisional. Please use the original mark sheet issued by the university for official job applications or admissions.
* **Error Troubleshooting:** If you encounter an 'Invalid Register Number' error, please verify the number and ensure the correct examination cycle is selected.
* **Pending Results:** If your result is not visible, it indicates that the specific cycle has not yet been declared.

website_content.title: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: UPSSSC has announced 132 vacancies for the Senior Instructor (Jyeshtha Anudeshak Cadre). Applications are open from September 14 to October 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
* **Post Name:** Senior Instructor (Jyeshtha Anudeshak Cadre)
* **Total Vacancies:** 132
* **Advertisement Number:** 21-Exam/2026
* **Conducting Body:** UPSSSC

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 14 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 05 October 2026

## Selection Process
Candidates will be selected through a two-stage process:
1. **Shortlisting:** Based on UP PET 2025 scores.
2. **Main Written Exam:** Objective type (MCQ) examination.

## Exam Pattern
* **Total Questions:** 100
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Duration:** 2 Hours
* **Negative Marking:** 0.25 marks deducted for each incorrect answer.

## Detailed Syllabus
### 1. Discipline-Specific Technical Section
Tests core subject knowledge at the degree/post-graduate level for 13 disciplines, including:
* Agriculture, Agricultural Engineering, Plant Protection, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, Agronomy, Soil Science, Agricultural Extension, Production, Economics/Sociology, and Public Health.

### 2. General Awareness Section
* **General Knowledge:** Indian History, Polity, Economy, Geography, General Science, and Current Affairs.
* **UP Special GK:** History, Culture, Geography, and Government Schemes of Uttar Pradesh.
* **Computer Knowledge:** Basics of hardware/software, MS Office, Internet, and Cyber Security.

website_content.title: BLW Varanasi Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27
website_content.summary: Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW) invites online applications from eligible Indian sportspersons for 25 vacancies across various sports disciplines. The application window closes on October 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🏆 BLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27

Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW), Varanasi, under Indian Railways, is recruiting talented sportspersons for **25 positions** under the Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) for the year 2026-27.

### 📋 Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **25**
* **Basketball (Men):** 6 Posts
* **Volleyball (Men):** 7 Posts
* **Wrestling (Men):** 4 Posts
* **Handball (Men):** 8 Posts

**Pay Level Distribution:**
* Pay Level-5: 2 Posts
* Pay Level-2: 8 Posts
* Pay Level-1: 15 Posts

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualification:**
* **Pay Level 5:** Graduation/Degree from a recognized university.
* **Pay Level 2:** 12th Pass (+2 stage) or equivalent.
* **Pay Level 1:** 10th Pass / ITI or equivalent.

**Sports Qualification:**
Candidates must meet specific achievement norms (Category A, B, or C) based on the Pay Level they are applying for. Achievements must be from events held on or after **01.04.2024**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12.09.2026
* **Application Closing Date:** 12.10.2026
* **Age Cut-off Date:** 01.01.2027

### 🔞 Age Limit (as of 01.01.2027)
* **Minimum Age:** 18 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 25 Years
* *Note: No age relaxation is provided for any community.*

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General Category:** ₹400
* **SC/ST/Ex-SM/PwBD/Minorities/EBC:** ₹250
* **Note:** Fees are **refundable** for candidates who actually appear in the trials.

### ⚙️ Selection Process
Selection is based on a composite score of 100 marks:
1. **Sports Trials:** 40 Marks (Minimum 25 required to be 'FIT')
2. **Sports Achievements:** 50 Marks
3. **Educational Qualification:** 10 Marks

**Final Step:** Medical Examination and a mandatory 5-year Service Bond.

website_content.title: NCRTC Supervisor-I & Junior Maintainer Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: NCRTC is recruiting for 90 technical posts including Supervisor-I and Junior Maintainer for the Namo Bharat Project. Apply by October 9, 2026, via the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚆 NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Overview
NCRTC has announced vacancies under two separate notices for the **Namo Bharat Project**. This is a prime opportunity for technical graduates and diploma holders to work with a prestigious Joint Venture of the Govt of India and State Governments.

### 📊 Vacancy Breakdown
* **Notice No. 33/2026 (Contract Basis):** 23 Posts (Supervisor-I & Junior Maintainer)
* **Notice No. 32/2026 (Direct Recruitment):** 67 Posts (Operations & Maintenance Staff)
* **Total Vacancies:** 90

### 🛠️ Post Details & Eligibility
**1. Supervisor-I (Pay Level S1):**
* **Trades:** IT, Full Stack Developer, Corporate Hospitality, Corporate Communications, Electrical, Civil, Electronics, Mechanical, and Operations.
* **Qualification:** B.E/B.Tech, 3-Year Diploma, or relevant Graduate/PG degree in the specified field.

**2. Junior Maintainer (Pay Level NS3):**
* **Trades:** Electrical, Fitter, RAC, and Electronics.
* **Qualification:** ITI (NCVT/SCVT) certificate in the relevant trade. (**Note:** Higher qualifications are not accepted for ITI posts).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Application Starts:** 10.09.2026
* **Last Date to Apply:** 09.10.2026 (23:55 hrs)
* **Tentative CBT Date:** November/December 2026

### 💰 Salary & Benefits
* **Supervisor-I:** Initial Basic Pay ₹37,000 (Scale: ₹37,000 – ₹1,15,000)
* **Junior Maintainer:** Initial Basic Pay ₹18,250 (Scale: ₹18,250 – ₹59,200)
* **Additional Perks:** VDA, HRA, and Cafeteria allowances as per company rules.

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Computer Based Test (CBT):** 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. No negative marking.
2. **Medical Fitness Test:** Standards as per Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM).

### 🕒 Age Limit (as of 10.09.2026)
* **Maximum Age:** 28 Years
* **Relaxation:** SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD (10-15 years).

website_content.title: NEET MDS Counselling 2026 Round 2 Registration and Schedule
website_content.summary: MCC has announced the Round 2 counselling cycle for NEET MDS 2026 AIQ seats starting September 10, 2026. Candidates seeking fresh registration or seat upgrades are eligible to participate.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NEET MDS 2026 Round 2 Overview
The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) is conducting the Round 2 counselling process for **50% All India Quota (AIQ)** seats in government dental colleges and **100% seats** in deemed/central universities. Simultaneously, various state authorities are releasing their respective state quota schedules.

## Eligibility for Round 2
Candidates may participate in Round 2 if they:
* Did not participate in Round 1.
* Did not secure a seat in Round 1.
* Wish to **upgrade** their previously allotted seat.

## Key Dates
* **Round 2 AIQ and State Schedule:** September 10, 2026

## How to Apply
1. **Registration:** New candidates must complete fresh registration; existing candidates can log in using previous credentials.
2. **Details:** Enter NEET MDS roll number, application number, and date of birth.
3. **Payment:** Pay the required registration fee and security deposit online.
4. **Choice Filling:** Select and lock preferred colleges/courses before the deadline.

## Critical Instructions
* **Freeze vs Float:** Candidates who selected 'Freeze' are generally ineligible for further rounds. Those on 'Float' may seek upgrades.
* **Choice Locking:** Once locked, preferences cannot be edited.
* **Documentation:** Original documents must be ready for reporting to avoid forfeiture of the allotted seat.
* **Dual Tracking:** Candidates eligible for both AIQ and State quotas must track both portals independently.

website_content.title: Karnataka PGCET 2026 Claim Slip & Option Entry Guide
website_content.summary: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the PGCET 2026 claim slips on September 10, 2026. This document is mandatory for candidates seeking admission to MBA, MCA, and MTech programs to proceed with option entry.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** has officially released the claim slips for the **Post Graduate Common Entrance Test (PGCET) 2026**. This slip is a critical document required for the counselling and seat allotment process.

## Key Highlights
* **Exam:** Karnataka PGCET 2026
* **Eligible Courses:** MBA, MCA, and MTech
* **Conducting Body:** Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
* **Release Date:** September 10, 2026

## Steps to Download Claim Slip
1. Visit the official KEA PGCET portal.
2. Click on the **Karnataka PGCET 2026 claim slip** link on the login page.
3. Enter your **Application Number**, **Password**, and **Captcha**.
4. Verify your details and download the file as a **PDF**.

## Option Entry Process
Once the claim slip is downloaded, candidates can access the option entry dashboard:
* **Access:** Use the QR code on the claim slip or enter the application and PGCET number.
* **Verification:** Complete the OTP verification via the registered mobile number.
* **Payment:** Pay the mandatory option entry processing fee of **₹750**.
* **Preference:** Select preferred colleges and courses in order of priority.

## Important Instructions
* **PDF Format:** Always download the official PDF; avoid using screenshots for counselling.
* **Discrepancies:** Report any errors in category or eligibility to KEA immediately.
* **Preparation:** Keep your registered mobile number and application credentials ready for OTP verification.

website_content.title: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026 Notification
website_content.summary: UPSSSC has announced 132 vacancies for the post of Senior Instructor (Jyeshtha Anudeshak) across 13 disciplines. Eligible candidates with a valid PET-2025 score can apply by October 5, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
UPSSSC is inviting applications for the **Senior Instructor (Jyeshtha Anudeshak)** cadre under the Directorate General, Deendayal Upadhyay State Rural Development Institute. These are permanent positions offering a competitive pay scale.

## Key Highlights
* **Total Vacancies:** 132 Posts
* **Pay Scale:** Level-6 (₹35,400 - ₹112,400)
* **Selection Process:** Main Written Examination (No Interview)
* **Application Mode:** Online

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 10-09-2026
* **Application Start Date:** 14-09-2026
* **Application Deadline:** 05-10-2026
* **Correction Window Closes:** 12-10-2026

## Eligibility Criteria

### Age Limit (as of 01-07-2026)
* **Minimum Age:** 21 Years
* **Maximum Age:** 40 Years
*(Age relaxation applicable as per UP Govt norms)*

### Mandatory Requirement
* Candidates must possess a valid **PET-2025 score card**. Shortlisting for the Main Exam will be based on normalized PET-2025 scores (15 times the number of vacancies).

### Educational Qualifications
Qualifications vary by discipline. Most roles require at least **50% marks** in the following:
* **Agricultural Engineering:** Bachelor's degree in Agricultural Engineering
* **Plant Protection / Horticulture / Agronomy / Soil Science / Ag Extension:** B.Sc. (Agriculture)
* **Animal Husbandry:** B.V.Sc. or M.V.Sc.
* **Women Welfare:** B.Sc. in Home Science / Home Economics / Nutrition / Diet
* **Cooperation / Panchayat:** M.A. (Economics) / M.Sc. (Ag Economics) / M.Com / M.A. (Sociology)
* **Agriculture (Specific):** Postgraduate degree in Agriculture (min 55% marks)
* **Public Health:** Graduate degree + Sanitary Inspector certificate
* **Production:** Degree/Diploma in Agricultural/Mechanical/Electrical/Civil Engineering + 2 years experience

## Exam Pattern
Selection is based on a 100-mark objective test (120 minutes) with **25% negative marking**:
* **Rural Development Knowledge:** 50 Marks
* **Analytical Ability & DI:** 15 Marks
* **Computer & IT Concepts:** 15 Marks
* **UP State General Knowledge:** 20 Marks

## Application Fee
* **All Categories (Gen/OBC/SC/ST):** ₹25 (Online processing fee)

website_content.title: NBEMS FMGE October 2026 Registration
website_content.summary: NBEMS has opened online registrations for the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) October 2026 session. Eligible candidates must apply by September 25, 2026, for the exam scheduled on October 31.
website_content.markdown_content:
## FMGE October 2026 Overview
The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) is conducting the **Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE)** for the October 2026 session. This is a mandatory screening test for foreign medical graduates to obtain registration to practice medicine in India.

## Important Dates
* **Registration Start Date:** September 11, 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Registration End Date:** September 25, 2026 (11:55 PM)
* **Exam Date:** October 31, 2026
* **Expected Result Date:** November 30, 2026
* **NMC Eligibility Application Window:** September 1, 2026, to September 30, 2026

## Key Examination Details
* **Exam Format:** Computer-Based Test (CBT)
* **Exam Centers:** Across India
* **Application Fee:** ₹6,195 (Payable via UPI, Credit/Debit Card)

## Application Process
1. **Registration:** Create an account on the official NBEMS portal.
2. **Form Filling:** Enter personal and academic details accurately.
3. **Documentation:** Upload all required certificates as specified.
4. **Payment:** Complete the fee payment of ₹6,195.
5. **Submission:** Review the application and submit it before the deadline.

## Critical Instructions
* **One Application Only:** Candidates submitting multiple forms may only receive an admit card for the application with the highest ID.
* **NMC Eligibility:** The NMC Eligibility Certificate must be applied for separately; it is not integrated into the FMGE application.

website_content.title: NMC MBBS Seat Matrix 2026-27
website_content.summary: The National Medical Commission (NMC) has released the official seat matrix for Undergraduate (MBBS) courses for the 2026-27 academic year. This matrix will serve as the foundational data for NEET UG 2026 counselling across government and private medical colleges.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Medical Assessment & Rating Board (MARB) of the **National Medical Commission (NMC)** has officially published the seat matrix for MBBS courses for the academic session 2026-27. This list includes all approved intakes for medical colleges in India, excluding Institutes of National Importance (INIs).

## Key Highlights
* **Release Date:** September 10, 2026
* **Basis of Matrix:** Approvals granted as of July 13, 2026
* **Scope:** Covers Government and Private medical colleges (Excludes AIIMS and JIPMER)
* **Purpose:** Primary reference for NEET UG 2026 counselling

## Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Verification:** Candidates must cross-verify seat availability in the official matrix before filling choices during AIQ or State Quota counselling.
* **INI Seats:** Seats for AIIMS and JIPMER are **not** included in this list and will be notified separately.
* **Revisions:** The matrix is subject to change based on Appeal Committee decisions; candidates should re-check the portal closer to their counselling round.
* **Validity:** Only seats listed in this official matrix are valid for admission; any offer outside this matrix is invalid.
* **Counselling Schedule:** This notice is for the seat matrix only. For registration and round dates, refer to the **Medical Counselling Committee (MCC)** or respective state authorities.

## How to Access the Seat Matrix
1. Visit the official NMC portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Latest News'** or **'Notice Board'** section.
3. Locate the PDF titled **'Seat Matrix for Undergraduate (MBBS) Courses for the Academic Year 2026-27'**.
4. Download the PDF and use `Ctrl+F` to search for your preferred state or college.

website_content.title: UPSC Recruitment 2026 (Advt No. 11/2026) - 212 Vacancies
website_content.summary: UPSC is recruiting for 212 vacancies across 7 professional posts including Assistant Public Prosecutors, Medical Specialists, and Law Officers. Application window closes on October 2, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released Advertisement No. 11/2026 for the selection of candidates for seven distinct posts across various Central Government Ministries, Departments, and the UT of Ladakh.

## Vacancy Breakup
* **Assistant Public Prosecutor (Govt. of NCT of Delhi):** 140 Posts
* **Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine):** 60 Posts
* **Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy):** 4 Posts
* **Public Law Officer / District Litigation Officer (UT of Ladakh):** 4 Posts
* **Assistant Editor (Indian Bureau of Mines):** 2 Posts
* **Specialist Grade II (Anaesthesiology & Paediatrics):** 2 Posts

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Medical Roles:** MBBS plus PG degree/diploma in respective specialties with required teaching or clinical experience (usually 3-5 years).
* **Law Roles:** Degree in Law with required experience at the bar (2-3 years). Ladakh posts require a valid Domicile Certificate.
* **Assistant Editor:** Bachelor's degree in Journalism/Mass Communication or related field with 3 years of editing experience.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 12.09.2026
* **Closing Date (General Posts):** 02.10.2026 (1800 hrs)
* **Closing Date (Ladakh Posts):** 09.10.2026

## Selection Process
* **Mode:** Recruitment by Selection (Interview-based).
* **Shortlisting:** In case of high application volume, UPSC may implement shortlisting criteria based on desirable qualifications or a Recruitment Test (RT).
* **Suitability:** Minimum marks required in interviews vary by category (UR: 50, OBC: 45, SC/ST/PwBD: 40).

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS (Male):** ₹25
* **Women/SC/ST/PwBD:** Exempted

### How to Apply for NCWEB Special Drive Admission 2026

The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, has released the hall tickets for the 2026 recruitment cycle. Candidates who applied for the various administrative and medical positions can now access their admit cards.

website_content.title: Bihar Class 11 Spot Admission 2026-28
website_content.summary: BSEB has announced the final spot admission window for vacant Class 11 seats for the 2026-28 academic session. Eligible students can apply through the OFSS portal from September 15 to September 18, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
 The **Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB)** is conducting the final round of admissions for Class 11 (Intermediate) via the **Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS)**. This spot admission window is specifically for filling the remaining vacant seats across various institutions in Bihar.

## Key Highlights
* **Academic Session:** 2026-28
* **Admission Type:** Spot Admission (Final Round)
* **Portal:** ofssbihar.net

## Important Dates
* **Window Opens:** September 15, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** September 18, 2026
* **Total Duration:** 4 Days

## Eligibility & Application Process
* **Eligibility:** Students who have completed Class 10 and are seeking admission into Class 11.
* **Existing Applicants:** Use your OFSS reference number/barcode and registered mobile number to generate the spot application.
* **New Applicants:** Register and fill out the **Common Application Form (CAF)** on the portal.
* **Selection:** Check the institution-wise vacant seat list and select your preferred school/college and stream.
* **Final Step:** Pay the fee (if applicable) and submit the printed application with original documents to the institution's principal for verification.

## Important Instructions
* **Urgency:** Seats are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.
* **Final Opportunity:** As this is the final window, missing this deadline may result in losing a seat for the current academic session.
* **Verification:** Keep all original documents ready for physical verification at the selected school/college.

website_content.title: Karnataka UGNEET 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment Result
website_content.summary: Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) is scheduled to release the Karnataka NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment Result on September 11, 2026. Candidates seeking admission to MBBS and BDS courses can check their allotment status on the official portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Karnataka NEET UG 2026 Round 2 Overview

The **Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)** conducts the state centralised counselling for admission to undergraduate medical (**MBBS**) and dental (**BDS**) courses under the 85% state quota and 100% private college quota seats.

### Important Dates

* **Round 2 Option Entry Window:** September 7, 2026 (2:00 PM) to September 9, 2026 (2:00 PM)
* **Round 2 Seat Allotment Result Date:** September 11, 2026 (Expected)
* **Round 1 Final Seat Allotment:** August 28, 2026

### Steps to Check Round 2 Seat Allotment

* Visit the official KEA counselling portal.
* Click on the link for **UGNEET 2026 Round 2 Seat Allotment Result**.
* Enter your **KEA Application Number** and **Password / Date of Birth**.
* View your allotted college, branch, and category details.
* Download and print the allotment order for document verification and admission reporting.

### Crucial Guidelines for Candidates

* Evaluate your post-allotment choices (**Choice 1, Choice 2, Choice 3, or Choice 4**) carefully, as each determines eligibility for subsequent rounds and fee payment timelines.
* Complete the required tuition fee payment and report to the allotted college before the designated deadline to prevent cancellation of the seat.
* Ensure all original academic and identity certificates are ready for physical verification.

website_content.title: OPTCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 100 Graduate, Diploma & ITI Posts
website_content.summary: Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL) has released an official recruitment notification for 100 Graduate, Diploma, and ITI Trade Apprentice positions. Odisha domiciles can register and apply online from September 2, 2026, until October 1, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview

Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL), a state-owned power transmission utility in Odisha, invites online applications from eligible Odisha domicile candidates for a 1-year apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961. A total of **100 seats** are available across Degree Engineering, Degree Non-Engineering, Diploma Technician, and ITI Trade disciplines.

## Vacancy Details & Stipend

* **Degree Engineering Apprentice (34 Seats)** – Stipend: **₹12,300/month**
  * Electrical: 32 | IT: 1 | Telecom: 1
* **Degree Non-Engineering Apprentice (7 Seats)** – Stipend: **₹12,300/month**
  * Human Resources: 4 | Finance: 2 | Law: 1
* **Diploma Technician Apprentice (23 Seats)** – Stipend: **₹10,900/month**
  * Electrical: 20 | Telecom: 1 | Civil: 2
* **ITI Trade Apprentice (36 Seats)** – Stipend: **₹9,600/month**
  * ITI Electrician: 33 | ITI Electronic Mechanic: 3

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **Degree Engg:** BE/B.Tech in Electrical, Computer Science/IT, or Electronics & Telecom / Instrumentation.
* **Degree Non-Engg:** MBA (HR) / MSW / PG Degree in Personnel Management OR M.Com / B.Com with CMA Inter OR LLM / LLB.
* **Diploma:** Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering.
* **ITI:** ITI in Electrician or Electronics Mechanic Trade.
* **Passing Year:** Qualifying exam must be completed during Academic Year **2023–24, 2024–25, or 2025–26** (Passed by 1 July 2026).

### General Conditions
* **Domicile:** Only Indian nationals belonging to the State of Odisha are eligible.
* **Age Limit:** Minimum 18 years as on **1 August 2026**.
* **Exclusions:** Candidates with existing job experience of 1 year or more or who have previously completed apprenticeship training are NOT eligible.
* **NATS/NAPS Registration:** Must be registered on NATS 2.0 or NAPS portal with an Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

## Selection Process

Selection will be based on academic merit, written test, or interview depending on the specific discipline requirements. Shortlisted candidates will be notified for document verification.

## Important Dates

* **Advertisement Date:** 29 August 2026
* **Online Application Start Date:** 2 September 2026 (12:00 AM)
* **Online Application Closing Date:** 1 October 2026 (11:59 PM)

## How to Apply

1. Register on the government portal:
   * Degree & Diploma candidates: Register on **NATS 2.0** (`nats.education.gov.in`).
   * ITI Trade candidates: Register on **NAPS** (`apprenticeshipindia.gov.in`).
2. Get your enrollment/registration number.
3. Visit the OPTCL Official Website (`optcl.co.in`) -> HRD Section -> Training & Development -> **Advertisement for Engagement of Apprentices 2026**.
4. Complete and submit the online application form before October 1, 2026.

website_content.summary: The West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education (WBCHSE) has released the schedule for the HS Semester III Examination 2027. Exams are scheduled to take place from September 21 to October 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## WBCHSE HS Semester III Examination 2027

The **West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education (WBCHSE)** has officially announced the examination routine for the Higher Secondary (Class 12) Semester III Examination, 2027.

### 📅 Key Exam Details
* **Examination Dates:** 21 September 2026 to 7 October 2026
* **Exam Timing:** 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM (Single Shift)
* **Mode of Exam:** Offline at designated exam centres across West Bengal
* **Admit Cards:** Released to schools on 27 August for student distribution

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Mandatory Documents:** Carry the official **Admit Card** and a valid **School Identity Card** to every single exam.
* **Reporting Time:** Reach the examination centre well before the scheduled reporting time.
* **Prohibited Items:** Electronic devices, including mobile phones, are strictly banned inside the examination hall.
* **Compliance:** Follow all directions provided by the invigilators and school administration.
* **Updates:** Keep checking official notifications as the Council may revise the schedule if necessary.

### 🛠 How to Download the Routine
1. Visit the official WBCHSE website.
2. Look for the notification: **"Routine of Semester-III of Higher Secondary Examination, 2027."**
3. Click the link to open/download the PDF.
4. Verify the date, day, and timing for your respective subjects.

website_content.title: NIT Agartala Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: NIT Agartala invites online applications for 51 Non-Teaching positions across various Pay Levels. The application process closes on October 20, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
NIT Agartala is conducting a direct recruitment drive for **51 Non-Teaching posts** under the 7th CPC Pay Levels. Selection is based on a **Computer Based Test (CBT)** with no interviews involved.

## Vacancy Details
| Post Name | Pay Level | Total Posts |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Technical Assistant | PL-6 | 7 |
| Junior Engineer (Civil/Electrical) | PL-6 | 5 |
| Library & Information Assistant | PL-6 | 5 |
| SAS Assistant | PL-6 | 2 |
| Pharmacist | PL-5 | 1 |
| Senior Technician | PL-4 | 9 |
| Technician | PL-3 | 14 |
| Lab Attendant | PL-1 | 8 |

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Technical Assistant/JE:** First Class B.E./B.Tech/MCA or Diploma in relevant field.
* **Library Assistant:** Bachelor's degree in Science/Arts/Commerce + B.Lib.I.Sc.
* **SAS Assistant:** Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education with sports/cultural record.
* **Pharmacist:** B.Pharma or 10+2 (Science) + 2 years Diploma with experience.
* **Technician/Senior Technician:** 10+2 Science (60%) or 10th + ITI or Diploma.
* **Lab Attendant:** 10+2 in Science.

## Selection Process
* **Exam Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT).
* **Structure:** Most posts feature a two-part exam (Part I: General Aptitude; Part II: Technical/Subject specific).
* **Lab Attendant:** Single-part exam covering English, GK, Numerical Ability, and Computers.
* **No Interview:** Final merit is based solely on CBT marks.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start:** 20 September 2026 (10:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 20 October 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **CBT Date:** To be announced separately on the official website.
