website_content.title: SSC SI Delhi Police and CAPFs Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) is recruiting for 1,871 Sub-Inspector posts across Delhi Police and CAPFs. Eligible graduates can apply online from September 10 to September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚨 SSC Sub-Inspector Recruitment 2026

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced vacancies for **Sub-Inspectors (SI)** in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs). This is a premier opportunity for graduates to join the prestigious security forces of India.

### 📊 Vacancy Breakup
* **SI (GD) in CAPFs:** 1,467 Posts
* **SI (Executive) Delhi Police (Male):** 205 Posts
* **SI (Executive) Delhi Police (Female):** 112 Posts
* **SI (Fire) in CISF (Male):** 234 Posts
* **Total Vacancies:** **1,871**

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**1. Educational Qualification:**
* **SI (Delhi Police & CAPFs):** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
* **SI (Fire) CISF:** B.Sc (Physics, Chemistry, Math) **OR** Matriculation + 3-year Diploma in relevant Engineering fields.
* **Note:** Male candidates for Delhi Police must possess a valid **LMV Driving License** by the time of PE&MT.

**2. Age Limit (as of 01.08.2026):**
* **SI (Delhi Police/CAPFs):** 20–25 Years
* **SI (Fire) CISF:** 18–30 Years
* *Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/ESM as per Govt norms.*

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 10.09.2026
* **Application End Date:** 30.09.2026 (23:00 hrs)
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 01.10.2026
* **Correction Window:** 08.10.2026 to 10.10.2026

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General/OBC:** ₹100
* **Women/SC/ST/ESM:** Exempted

### 🛠 Selection Process
1. **Paper-I:** Objective MCQ (Reasoning, GK, Quant, English)
2. **PST/PET:** Physical Standard & Endurance Tests (Qualifying)
3. **Paper-II:** Objective MCQ (Higher difficulty level)
4. **DME:** Detailed Medical Examination

### 💵 Pay Scale
* **Pay Level:** Level-6
* **Salary Range:** ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400

website_content.title: IIT JAM 2027 Registration and Application Process
website_content.summary: IIT Kharagpur invites applications for the Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM) 2027. Registration is open from September 12 to October 12, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## IIT JAM 2027 Overview
The **Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM) 2027** is organized by **IIT Kharagpur** for admission to postgraduate programs. The exam will be conducted as a Computer-Based Test (CBT) in two sessions.

## Important Dates
* **Information Brochure Released:** August 31, 2026
* **Registration Opens:** September 12, 2026
* **Application Deadline:** October 12, 2026 (11:59 PM)
* **Exam Date:** February 14, 2027 (Sunday)

## Application Process
1. **Registration:** Register on the JOAPS portal using a valid email ID and mobile number.
2. **Enrolment:** Use the provided Enrolment ID and OTP to log in.
3. **Details:** Enter personal details, academic qualifications, test paper choices, and preferred exam cities.
4. **Documentation:** Upload photograph, signature, and relevant certificates in the prescribed format.
5. **Payment:** Pay the application fee via debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI.
6. **Submission:** Review all details carefully and submit the application.

## Key Instructions for Candidates
* **Session Management:** Candidates opting for two subjects must ensure they fall in different sessions (forenoon and afternoon).
* **Document Accuracy:** Strictly follow the prescribed size and format for uploads to avoid rejection.
* **Verification:** Regularly check the registered email and JOAPS dashboard for any deficiency flags.
* **Correction Window:** Double-check all entries before submission, as changes are only possible during the official correction window.

website_content.summary: The Uttar Pradesh Pariksha Niyamak Adhikari has announced the Phase 2 seat allotment and counselling schedule for the 2026 D.El.Ed course. This round targets candidates from other states and reserved categories who have not yet been allotted an institute.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
**UP D.EI.Ed (Diploma in Elementary Education)** Phase 2 counselling is now open for eligible candidates. Please note that this process is based on the state rank list already published in August.

## Important Dates
* **Choice Filling (Round 1):** September 7 to 10, 2026
* **Seat Allotment (Round 1):** September 11, 2026 (Expected)
* **Document Verification:** September 12 to 24, 2026
* **Choice Filling (Round 2):** September 11 to 15, 2026
* **Seat Allotment (Round 2):** September 16, 2026
* **Online Reporting/Locking:** September 25, 2026
* **Classes Commence:** September 28, 2026

## Eligibility for Phase 2
This round is specifically for candidates who have **not** yet received a training institute allotment, including:
* Candidates from other states
* UP resident OBC/SC/ST candidates
* Special reservation category candidates

## How to Check Your Rank/Allotment
1. Visit the official portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Know Your Rank'** section.
3. Select the appropriate rank-slab PDF (1-20k, 20k-80k, or 80k+) or log in using your registration number and date of birth.
4. Search for your name/application number to verify your status.

## Key Instructions
* Keep your **registration number, password, and DOB** ready for choice filling.
* Ensure document verification is completed by September 24 to secure the seat.

website_content.markdown_content:
## BRABU 1st Merit List 2026 - Vocational/Professional Courses

Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University (BRABU) has officially announced the **1st Merit List for the 2026 session** for various Vocational and Professional programmes. 

**Key Highlights:**
* **Total Candidates Recommended:** 2,611
* **Coverage:** Approximately 30 affiliated colleges and university departments.
* **Admission Cycle:** T.D.C. Part-I/Semester-1 & P.G. (Self-Finance).

### Courses Included in the Merit List
The following Professional and Vocational (Self-Finance) programmes are covered:
* **Management:** BBA & MBA (Vocational/Professional)
* **Computer Applications:** BCA & MCA (Vocational/Professional)
* **Science & Tech:** B.Sc Biotechnology, Industrial Chemistry, Industrial Microbiology, Industrial Fish & Fisheries
* **Specialized Fields:** B.Sc Clinical Nutrition and Dietetics, Library & Information Science, Mass Communication
* **Diplomas:** Diploma in Yogic Studies, P.G. Diploma in Library & Information Science, P.G. Diploma in Hindi Journalism and Mass Communication

### Important Instructions for Candidates
1. **Document Verification:** Candidates highlighted in the merit list **must** have their documents verified by the concerned allotted college.

3. **Finalization:** Admission will be finalized only after successful verification and correction.

### How to Check Your Result
* Visit the official university portal.
* Locate the **"Vocational/ Professional Courses"** admission section.
* Download the **1st Merit List PDF 2026**.
* Search using your **Application Number** or **Name** to find your allotted college and category.

website_content.title: GSSSB Provisional Answer Key & Response Sheet 2026
website_content.summary: GSSSB has released the provisional answer key for the CBRT exam held on September 8, 2026, covering 8 technical cadre posts. Candidates can now review their responses and submit online objections until September 16, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GSSSB CBRT Answer Key 2026 Overview

The Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB) has published the **Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet** for the Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) conducted on **September 8, 2026**. This notification applies to eight technical cadre posts, including regular recruitment and special recruitment for Divyang candidates.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Date:** 8 September 2026
* **Notice Published:** 9 September 2026
* **Objection Window Opens:** 10 September 2026, 3:00 PM
* **Objection Window Closes:** 16 September 2026, 11:55 PM

### 📝 Exam Structure
* **Total Questions:** 210
* **Part-A:** 90 Questions
* **Part-B:** 120 Questions

### 🛠 How to Download the Answer Key
1. Log in to the candidate portal using your **Advertisement Number, Confirmation Number, and Date of Birth**.
2. Navigate to the **'Candidate Response'** tab.
3. Click the generate link to view your Participant ID, responses, and the official key.
4. Save the document as a PDF for future reference.

### 🚩 Process to Raise Objections
If you disagree with the provisional key, follow these steps before the deadline:
* **Access Form:** Log in and click the **'Objection Form'** tab.
* **Details:** Fill in your roll number and select the specific **Question ID**.
* **Evidence:** You must upload supporting documentary proof (Book name, Author, Page number) in **PDF/JPG/JPEG** format (max 400 KB).
* **Submission:** Review your entry carefully as submitted objections cannot be edited.

website_content.title: Haryana Court Clerk Answer Key 2026
website_content.summary: S.S.S.C. has released the Provisional Answer Key and Candidate Response Sheets for the Clerk recruitment exam (Advt. No. 36C/SSSC/HR/2026). Candidates can raise objections against the objective section between September 14 and September 16, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Society for Centralized Recruitment of Staff in Subordinate Courts (S.S.S.C.), High Court of Punjab & Haryana, has issued an official notice regarding the **Candidate Response Sheets and Provisional Answer Key** for the Clerk recruitment examination.

## Important Dates
* **Exam Conducted:** 24 August 2026 to 7 September 2026
* **Notice Date:** 10 September 2026
* **Objection Window Opens:** 14 September 2026, 4:00 PM
* **Objection Window Closes:** 16 September 2026, 4:00 PM

## How to Raise Objections
1. Visit the official SSSC website during the active window.
2. Log in using your **registered credentials** to access the Response Sheet and Answer Key.
3. Select the specific objective question(s) you wish to challenge.
4. Provide the proposed correct answer with **clear reasoning and documentary proof**.
5. Pay the non-refundable objection fee of **₹25 per question** online.
6. Submit the challenge before the deadline.

## Critical Instructions
* **Scope:** Objections are accepted **only** for the objective portion of the test.
* **Validity:** Objections without supporting documentary proof will not be considered.
* **Mode of Submission:** Only submissions via the official online portal are valid; email or post submissions will be rejected.
* **Fee:** The ₹25 fee is non-refundable regardless of the outcome.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) has officially published the **Provisional Answer Keys** for the Hindi subject papers of the Uttarakhand Special Subordinate Education (Lecturer-Group 'C') Services General/Women Branch Exam-2025. This release covers both **Paper 1 and Paper 2** across all question series (**A, B, C, and D**).

## Key Highlights
* **Exam Name:** UKPSC Lecturer (Group 'C') Services 2025
* **Subject:** Hindi (Paper 1 & 2)
* **Answer Key Type:** Provisional
* **Question Series:** A, B, C, D
* **Mode of Exam:** Offline (MCQ)

## Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** December 30, 2025
* **Application Window:** Dec 31, 2025, to Jan 20, 2026
* **Exam Date (Hindi):** May 30, 2026
* **Answer Key Release Date:** September 9, 2026

## How to Download the Answer Key
1. Visit the official UKPSC website.
2. Navigate to the **'Answer Key'** section or the candidate corner.
3. Click on the notice for **'Lecturer-Group 'C' Services General/Women Branch Exam-2025 Provisional Answer Key (Hindi)'**.

website_content.title: RCF Assistant Officer (Secretarial) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: RCF Ltd invites applications for 10 posts of Assistant Officer (Secretarial) EO Grade. Apply online between 10th September and 26th September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited (RCF Ltd), a Government of India Undertaking, is recruiting for the position of **Assistant Officer (Secretarial), EO Grade**.

## Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Assistant Officer (Secretarial)
* **Total Vacancies:** 10
* **Pay Scale:** Rs. 30,000 - Rs. 1,20,000
* **Approximate Gross Salary:** ₹65,000 per month
* **Job Locations:** Trombay/Thal units, Area Offices & Marketing Offices across India

## Important Dates
* **Registration Starts:** 10 September 2026 (8:00 AM)
* **Application Deadline:** 26 September 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Eligibility Cut-off Date:** 01 July 2026

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification (Two Routes)
* **Route A:** Graduate (any discipline) + Post Graduate (any discipline) + 1-year Govt-recognized Diploma in Secretarial Practice/Stenography/Office Management.
* **Route B:** Bachelor's degree specifically in Office Management & Secretarial Practice/Office Administration + Post Graduate (any discipline).

### Experience & Requirements
* **Work Experience:** Minimum 4 years of relevant experience as Secretarial Assistant/Secretary (post-graduation).
* **Minimum Marks:** 55% in final year of Graduation (50% for SC).
* **Age Limit (as of 01.07.2026):** UR/EWS: 32 years | OBC (NCL): 35 years | SC: 37 years.

## Selection Process
1. **Online Test:** 100 Objective questions (50 Discipline-related + 50 General Aptitude/English).
2. **Skill Test (Qualifying):** Assessing Practical Job Knowledge, Computer Knowledge, and Communication Skills.

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** Rs. 1,000 + GST/Bank Charges
* **SC/ST/PwBD/Female/Ex-SM:** Exempted

website_content.title: APPSC Group A & B Gazetted (Technical) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: APPSC invites online applications for 37 Gazetted technical posts across the Finance and Home Departments. Eligible APST candidates must apply by 12 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has announced recruitment for **Group-A & Group-B Gazetted (Technical) Posts-2026 (Part-II)**. This is a prestigious opportunity for permanent residents of Arunachal Pradesh to serve in the Finance and Home Departments.

## Vacancy Breakdown
* **Finance & Accounts Officer / Treasury Officer:** 7 Posts (Group-A, Level 10)
* **Sub-Treasury Officer:** 7 Posts (Group-B, Level 7)
* **Assistant Director (Prosecution):** 5 Posts (Group-A, Level 10)
* **Assistant Public Prosecutor:** 18 Posts (Group-B, Level 8)

## Eligibility Criteria
**Mandatory Requirements:**
* **Nationality:** Citizen of India.
* **Residence:** Must hold a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) of Arunachal Pradesh.
* **Status:** Must be an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) member.
* **Language:** Proficiency in an indigenous tribal language of Arunachal Pradesh is essential.

**Educational Qualification:**
* **Finance/Treasury Roles:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or any degree with Statistics/Mathematics as a compulsory subject.
* **Legal Roles:** Bachelor of Law (LLB) with a minimum of 7 years of active practice in criminal courts (or experience as a First Class Magistrate).

## Important Dates
* **Online Application Start:** 21 September 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Application Deadline:** 12 October 2026 (5:00 PM)

## Selection Process
1. **Screening Test:** Objective type (conducted if application volume is high).
2. **Written Examination:** Consists of General English & GS (150 marks) and two Subject Papers (150 marks each).
3. **Viva-Voce:** Final interview (50 marks).

## Age Limit
* **Minimum:** 21 Years
* **Maximum:** 35 Years
* **Relaxation:** Up to 5 years for APST and up to 15 years for APST PwBD candidates.

website_content.summary: Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) has announced the semester results for UG and PG law programs. Students can now access and download their provisional marksheets online.
website_content.markdown_content:
## KSLU Result 2026 Overview
Karnataka State Law University (KSLU) has officially released the semester results for various law courses for the 2026 session. Students are advised to download their marksheets for academic record-keeping.

**Key Details:**
* **Courses Included:** LLB (3-year), BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB (5-year integrated), and LLM.
* **Result Mode:** Online via official portal.
* **Login Credentials:** Registration Number or Seat Number.

## Steps to Check KSLU Result 2026
1. Visit the official university portal.
2. Navigate to the **'Examination'** or **'Results'** section on the homepage.
3. Select your specific **course, semester, and exam session** from the dropdown menu.
4. Enter your **Registration/Seat Number** and the captcha code.
5. Click **Submit** to view your marksheet.
6. Download the PDF and take a printout for future reference.

## Important Guidelines for Students
* **Official Source:** Only use the official KSLU website to avoid fraudulent third-party links.
* **Verification:** Carefully check your name, registration number, and subject-wise marks immediately after downloading.
* **Provisional Nature:** Note that the online marksheet is **provisional**. The original marksheet will be issued by your respective college or the university.
* **Discrepancies:** Report any errors in marks or personal details to your college examination cell immediately.
* **Revaluation:** Students seeking Revaluation (RV) or Challenge Valuation (CV) should check the official notification for fees and deadlines.

The Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission is conducting the recruitment process for the post of **Assistant District Prosecution Officer (Sahayak Jila Lok Abhiyojan Adhikari)** under the Home Department.

* **Post Name:** Assistant District Prosecution Officer (ADPO)

website_content.title: BSF Answer Key 2026: HC (Ministerial) & ASI (Stenographer)
website_content.summary: The Border Security Force (BSF) has activated the Objection Management Portal for candidates who appeared in the CBT and Descriptive Examinations for various Non-GD cadre posts. Eligible candidates can now view their response sheets and challenge the provisional answer key.
website_content.markdown_content:
## BSF Answer Key 2026 Overview
The Directorate General, Border Security Force (BSF), under the Ministry of Home Affairs, has released the provisional answer keys for recruitment notifications under 2024. This applies to candidates who appeared for exams on **1 and 3 September 2026**.

### 📌 Posts Covered
* **ASI (Stenographer)** - Direct Entry & LDCE across all CAPFs
* **HC (Ministerial)** - LDCE across all CAPFs
* **Non-GD Cadre Posts** in BSF

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Dates:** 1 & 3 September 2026
* **Answer Key Release:** 10 September 2026
* **Objection Window:** 10 September to 12 September 2026
* **Special Case:** Candidates who took the HC (Ministerial) exam on 2 September (Jaipur & Kanpur centres) can access their portal **after 18 September 2026**.

### 🛠️ How to Download & Challenge
1. **Visit Official Portal:** Go to the BSF recruitment website.
2. **Login:** Use your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/DOB.
3. **Review:** View your candidate response sheet and compare it with the provisional answer key.
4. **Raise Objection:** Select the question, provide supporting documentary evidence, and pay the objection fee (if applicable).
5. **Submit:** Save the confirmation page for future reference.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions
* The objection window closes strictly on **12 September 2026** for most posts.
* Ensure all supporting documents are uploaded to avoid rejection of the challenge.
* Download a copy of your response sheet for your own records.

website_content.markdown_content:
## WB PUBDET 2026 Round 2 Allotment Overview
The **West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board (WBJEEB)** will announce the Round 2 seat allotment results for the Presidency University Bachelor Degree Entrance Test (PUBDET) 2026. Candidates who participated in the choice-filling process for Round 2 can now prepare to check their allotted subjects and seat status.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Round 2 Seat Allotment Result:** September 10, 2026 (Expected)

### 🎓 Admission Details
* **University:** Presidency University, Kolkata
* **Programmes:** BA / BSc Honours

1. Visit the official portal: **wbjeeb.nic.in**.

website_content.title: UP NEET UG Round 1 MBBS Cutoff 2026
website_content.summary: The Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), UP has released the Round 1 MBBS cutoff and seat allotment results for NEET UG 2026. Candidates can now verify college-wise and category-wise opening and closing ranks.
website_content.markdown_content:
## UP NEET UG Round 1 MBBS Cutoff 2026

The **Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh** has officially announced the Round 1 seat allotment result and the corresponding cutoff ranks for MBBS admissions 2026.

### 📌 Quick Overview
* **Exam:** NEET UG 2026
* **Counselling Authority:** DGME, Uttar Pradesh
* **Course:** MBBS
* **Counselling Round:** Round 1
* **Result Date:** September 7, 2026

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Cutoff/Allotment
1. Visit the official UP NEET counselling portal.
2. Navigate to the **Counselling Section**.
3. Select the **"Allotted Candidate List"** or **"Allotted and Vacant Seats"** option.
4. Choose the Round 1 MBBS cutoff details.
5. Review the institute-wise and category-wise opening and closing ranks.

### ⚠️ Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Category Verification:** Always check the cutoff for your specific category (**General/EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwD**) as ranks vary significantly.
* **Specific Combinations:** Remember that a closing rank is specific to a combination of college, course, category, and quota.
* **Official Source:** Rely solely on the official DGME portal for allotment status; avoid unofficial estimates.
* **Admission Process:** Allotted candidates must complete reporting and admission formalities within the deadline prescribed by DGME.
* **Round 2 Outlook:** Closing ranks for Round 1 are not guaranteed for Round 2, as seats may shift.
* **Documentation:** Keep your NEET UG scorecard, rank letter, and other verification documents ready.

website_content.summary: UPPBPB has announced the revised schedule for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) for Home Guard Enrolment 2025. Revised admit cards will be available from 10 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Revised PET Schedule Update
Due to continuous rainfall across Uttar Pradesh, the UP Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPBPB) has postponed the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) for the Home Guard Enrolment 2025.

**Key Date Changes:**
* **Original PET Date:** 08 September 2026
* **Revised PET Start Date:** 14 September 2026
* **Revised Admit Card Release:** 10 September 2026

## How to Download Revised Admit Card
Candidates must download the new admit card to verify their revised centre and date:
1. Visit the official UPPBPB portal.
2. Click on the **Revised Home Guard PET Admit Card 2026** link.
3. Enter your **Registration Number** and **Date of Birth**.
4. Submit and download the printed copy.

## Important Instructions for Candidates
* **Valid Admit Card:** Do not use any admit card downloaded before 7 September 2026. Only the revised card released on 10 September is valid.
* **Centre Verification:** Double-check your allotted venue, as centres may have changed.
* **Required Documents:**
    * Printed copy of the Revised PET Admit Card.
    * Original valid photo ID proof.
* **Reporting:** Reach the venue well before the reporting time to avoid delays.

website_content.title: MP Police Constable Syllabus and Exam Pattern 2026
website_content.summary: Complete guide to the MP Police Constable 2026 recruitment process, featuring the detailed syllabus, exam pattern, and physical standards conducted by MPESB.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The MP Police Constable recruitment is conducted by the **Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB)**. The selection process is multi-stage, ensuring only the most fit and capable candidates are selected for the force.

## Exam Pattern
The written examination is a **Computer Based Test (CBT)** designed at an 8th-class difficulty level.

* **Total Questions:** 100 MCQs
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Duration:** 120 Minutes
* **Negative Marking:** No Negative Marking

### Subject-wise Distribution
* **General Knowledge & Reasoning:** 40 Marks
* **Intellectual Ability & Mental Ability:** 30 Marks
* **Science & Simple Arithmetic:** 30 Marks

## Selection Process
1. **Written Exam:** Qualifying CBT covering GK, Reasoning, and Mathematics.
2. **Physical Tests:** Includes the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST).
3. **Final Stages:** Document Verification and Medical Examination.

## Physical Standards (PST)
| Category | Gender | Height | Chest |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| UR / SC / OBC | Male | 168 cm | 81 cm – 86 cm |
| UR / SC / OBC | Female | 155 cm | N/A |
| ST | Male | 160 cm | 76 cm – 81 cm |
| ST | Female | 155 cm | N/A |

## Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
Candidates must qualify in the following events:
* **800m Run**
* **Shot Put**
* **Long Jump**

## Preparation Tips
* **Focus on Basics:** Since the level is 8th class, strengthen your fundamentals in Maths and Science.
* **Balanced Study:** Allocate time proportionally across all three sections (40/30/30).
* **Physical Training:** Start training for the 800m run and jumps early; do not wait for written results.

website_content.summary: SAC ISRO is inviting online applications for 48 temporary positions including JRF, Research Associate, and Project Scientist-I. The application window closes on September 30, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## ISRO SAC Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Space Applications Centre (SAC), a lead centre of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**, is recruiting for temporary, project-based positions across various scientific and engineering disciplines.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Registration Starts:** 10.09.2026 (10:00 hrs)
* **Application Deadline:** 30.09.2026 (17:00 hrs)
* **Cut-off Date for Age/Qualification:** 30.09.2026

###  vacancies Breakdown (Total: 48)
* **Junior Research Fellow (JRF):** Post Codes 01–07 (Semiconductors, VLSI, Photonics, Atmospheric Sciences, Computer Science, etc.)
* **Research Associate (RA):** Post Codes 08–10 (Oceanic Sciences, Mathematics, Physics, Environmental Sciences)
* **Project Scientist-I (PS-I):** Post Codes 11–16 (Geophysics, Ecology, Remote Sensing, Hydrology, RF & Microwave)

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria

**Educational Qualification:**
* **JRF:** M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc in relevant fields. **Note:** Must have qualified NET, GATE, or other national-level exams.
* **RA:** Ph.D. in relevant fields OR M.E./M.Tech with 3 years of research/teaching experience and one SCI-listed journal paper.
* **PS-I:** Ph.D. or M.E./M.Tech in specialized fields (e.g., Geophysics, Water Resources).

**Minimum Marks Required:**
* **M.E./M.Tech:** 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA.
* **B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc:** 65% aggregate or 6.84 CGPA.

### ⏳ Age Limit (as of 30.09.2026)
* **JRF:** Maximum 28 Years
* **RA / PS-I:** Maximum 35 Years
* *Age relaxation applicable for SC/ST (5 years) and OBC-NCL (3 years) as per Govt rules.*

### 💰 Salary & Fellowship
* **JRF:** ₹37,000 (1st & 2nd Year) $ightarrow$ ₹42,000 (Subsequent years) + HRA
* **Project Scientist-I:** ₹56,000 + HRA
* **Research Associate:** ₹58,000 to ₹67,000 (Depending on level) + HRA

### 🛠 Selection Process
* The selection is strictly **Interview-based**. Shortlisting will be done based on academic records and subject specialization if applications are high.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Maharashtra B.Pharma & Pharm.D Admission 2026-27

The State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra, has progressed to the CAP Round 1 stage for pharmacy admissions. While the **Final Merit List is now available**, please note that the Round 1 seat matrix is temporarily on hold and will be published shortly.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Final Merit List:** Released
* **Choice Filling (Expected):** September 10 - September 11, 2026
* **Seat Matrix:** To be published soon

### 📝 Step-by-Step Guide to Choice Filling
1. **Login:** Visit the portal and log in using your Application ID and Password.
2. **Selection:** Navigate to the CAP Round 1 Option Form and select preferred colleges/course codes.
3. **Ordering:** Arrange your choices in strict order of preference.
4. **Confirmation:** Save the draft and **lock the form using SMS or Email OTP**. 
5. **Verification:** Download the 'Confirmed Option Form PDF' for your records.

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Hardware:** Use a **desktop or laptop** to avoid errors during the drag-and-drop reordering of preferences.
* **Browser:** Use updated versions of Chrome, Firefox, or Edge with **pop-up blockers disabled** for OTP verification.
* **Session Timeout:** The portal has a **15-minute idle timeout**; save your drafts frequently.
* **Locking:** If you do not lock the form with an OTP, the system will auto-lock the saved choices at the deadline.
* **Seat Forfeiture:** Failure to submit required documents or the **₹1,000 seat acceptance fee** within the timeline will result in automatic forfeiture of the seat.

website_content.title: SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) PE & MT Admit Card 2026
website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the PE&MT Admit Card for 7,201 Delhi Police Constable posts. Eligible candidates who cleared the CBT can now download their hall tickets for the physical test on 18 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 🚨 SSC Delhi Police Constable PE & MT 2026

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has officially released the **Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE&MT) Admit Card** for the Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Recruitment. This is the critical second stage for candidates who have successfully cleared the Computer Based Examination (CBT).

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Admit Card Release:** 10 September 2026
* **PE & MT Exam Date:** 18 September 2026
* **CBT Result Date:** 19 June 2026

### 🏃 Physical Endurance Test (PET) Eligibility

**For Male Candidates:**
* **Up to 30 Years:** 1600M Race (6 Mins) | Long Jump (14 Ft) | High Jump (3.9 Ft)
* **30-40 Years:** 1600M Race (7 Mins) | Long Jump (13 Ft) | High Jump (3.6 Ft)
* **Above 40 Years:** 1600M Race (8 Mins) | Long Jump (12 Ft) | High Jump (3.3 Ft)

**For Female Candidates:**
* **Up to 30 Years:** 1600M Race (8 Mins) | Long Jump (10 Ft) | High Jump (3 Ft)
* **30-40 Years:** 1600M Race (9 Mins) | Long Jump (9 Ft) | High Jump (2.9 Ft)
* **Above 40 Years:** 1600M Race (10 Mins) | Long Jump (8 Ft) | High Jump (2.6 Ft)

### 📏 Physical Measurement Test (PMT)
* **Height (Male):** UR/OBC/EWS/SC: 170 cms | ST: 165 cms
* **Height (Female):** UR/OBC/EWS: 157 cms | SC/ST: 155 cms
* **Chest (Male):** UR/OBC/EWS/SC: 81-85 cms | ST: 76-80 cms

### 📂 Required Documents
Candidates must carry the following to the venue:
* **Printed copy** of the PE & MT Admit Card
* **Original valid photo ID proof**
* Any other specific documents mentioned in the individual admit card

### 🛠️ Selection Process
1. Computer Based Test (CBT)
2. Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE & MT)
3. Document Verification
4. Medical Examination

website_content.title: CIHTS Teaching Recruitment 2026 - 59 Faculty Vacancies
website_content.summary: CIHTS Varanasi is inviting online applications for 59 teaching positions including Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor across 40 subject combinations. The application window closes on October 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CIHTS Teaching Recruitment 2026

The **Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies (CIHTS)**, a Deemed to be University located in Sarnath, Varanasi, has announced a major recruitment drive for teaching faculty members.

### 📌 Vacancy Overview
* **Total Vacancies:** 59
* **Post Ranks:** Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor
* **Subject Scope:** 40 distinct subject/post combinations
* **Key Departments:** 
    * Sanskrit & Mool Shastra
    * Sowa-Rigpa & Bhot Jyotish
    * Sampradaya Shastra (Sakya, Nyingma, Gelug, Kargyud)
    * Classical & Modern Languages (Chinese, Japanese, German, French)
    * Social Sciences (Asian History, Political Science, Tibetan History)
    * Tibetan Language & Literature
    * Centre for Teacher Education

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Online Registration Starts:** 08 September 2026
* **Online Application Deadline:** 07 October 2026
* **Hard Copy Submission:** Must be received by registered post within 3 days from the online submission deadline.

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Professor:** Ph.D. in concerned discipline, 10 years of teaching/research experience, and minimum 10 research publications in UGC-listed journals.
* **Associate Professor:** Ph.D. in concerned discipline, 8 years of experience, and minimum 7 research publications.
* **Assistant Professor:** Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. as per UGC norms.
* **Specialized Posts:** Specific qualifications apply for Sowa-Rigpa (NCISM-2022) and Teacher Education (NCTE-2021) posts.

### ⚙️ Selection Process
* **Mode:** Screening/Shortlisting followed by an Interview or Written Test (depending on the post).
* **Note:** Candidates must attend the selection process at their own expense.

website_content.markdown_content:
## BMC Executive Assistant Recruitment 2024 - Result Update

The **General Administration Department of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)** has issued two critical updates regarding the recruitment of **Karyakari Sahayak (Executive Assistant)**. 

### 📢 Key Notice Details
* **Notice MPR/921 (07.09.2026):** Contains the list of candidates removed from the earlier Provisional Selection List No. 4 after document verification.
* **Notice MPR/964 (07.09.2026):** Provides a category-wise provisional status of candidates.

### 🔍 Understanding Your Status
Candidates are advised to check the **'Remarks/अभिप्राय'** column against their name. The statuses are categorized as follows:
* **Eligible:** Document verification successful.
* **Relatively Eligible / Pending:** Awaiting verification of specific certificates; track further communications.
* **Ineligible / Absent:** Not selected or missed the process.
* **Removed:** Specifically listed in notice MPR/921.

### 🛠️ How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official MCGM portal.
2. Locate the PDF for Notice **MPR/921** or **MPR/964**.
3. Search using your **Roll Number** or **Application Sequence Number**.
4. Verify your status in the remarks column.

**Note:** These are provisional lists. Publication in these lists does not guarantee final appointment.

website_content.title: MP Police Constable (GD) Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Madhya Pradesh Police invites applications for 7,500 Constable (GD) positions. Eligible candidates can apply online through the MP Online portal from 22 September to 6 October 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
MP Police, under the Home Department, is recruiting for **Constable (General Duty)** positions. The examination is conducted by the Madhya Pradesh Karmachari Chayan Mandal (MPESB), Bhopal.

## Vacancy Details
Total Posts: **7,500**
* **Constable (GD - Special Armed Force):** 700 posts (Male only)
* **Constable (GD - excluding SAF):** 6,800 posts (Male & Female)

## Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * UR/SC/OBC: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board.
    * ST Category: 8th pass.
* **Age Limit (as on 06-Oct-2026):** 
    * Minimum: 18 Years
    * Maximum: 33 years (General/EWS/Other States), 38 years (Reserved/Females), up to 43 years for specific relaxation categories.
* **Domicile:** Must have a live registration at a Madhya Pradesh State Employment Office. Non-domicile candidates can apply under the UR category.

## Selection Process
1. **Written Online Examination:** 100 MCQs, 100 Marks, 2 Hours. **No negative marking.**
2. **Physical Efficiency Test (PET):** Based on written exam cut-off.
3. **Document Verification:** Final validation of credentials.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 22 September 2026
* **Application Last Date:** 6 October 2026
* **Correction Window:** 22 September to 11 October 2026
* **Probable Exam Date:** Starting 19 November 2026

## Salary & Fee
* **Pay Scale:** ₹19,500 – ₹62,000 (Stipend based for first 3 years).
* **Application Fee:** 
    * General: ₹700 + Portal Fee
    * SC/ST/OBC/EWS (MP Domicile): ₹350 + Portal Fee

website_content.title: NIOS Class 10 & 12 Hall Ticket 2026
website_content.summary: The National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) has released the admit cards for Secondary and Senior Secondary public examinations 2026. Eligible students can now download their hall tickets via the official SDMIS portal.
website_content.markdown_content:
## NIOS Hall Ticket 2026 Overview
The National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) has activated the download link for candidates appearing in the **Class 10 (Secondary)** and **Class 12 (Senior Secondary)** examinations. 

**Eligibility for Download:**
* Must have paid the applicable exam fee.
* Must have a valid photograph on file with NIOS.

## Step-by-Step Download Process
1. **Visit Portal:** Go to the official student portal at sdmis.nios.ac.in.
2. **Locate Link:** Navigate to the 'Hall Ticket' or 'Admit Card' section under the examination menu.
3. **Authentication:** Enter your **12-digit enrollment/registration number**.
4. **Selection:** Choose the appropriate hall ticket type (Theory or Practical).
5. **Verification:** Click 'Submit' and review your details on the screen.
6. **Save:** Download the PDF and take a clear printout.

## Critical Checklist for Students
Immediately after downloading, verify the following:
* **Personal Details:** Correct spelling of name and clear photograph.
* **Identifiers:** Accurate enrollment and roll numbers.
* **Exam Logistics:** Correct exam centre name, code, and address.
* **Schedule:** All registered subjects with correct dates and time slots.

## Troubleshooting & Support
If you encounter issues, contact your nearest **NIOS Regional Centre** immediately for:
* Missing or incorrect photographs.
* Discrepancies in name or centre details.
* Fee payment not reflecting in the system (keep your transaction receipt ready).

website_content.title: BCPL Non Executive Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: Brahmaputra Cracker and Polymer Limited (BCPL) is inviting applications for 24 Non-Executive positions including Foreman, Technician, and Operator roles. The application window closes on October 9, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## BCPL Non Executive Recruitment 2026 Overview
Brahmaputra Cracker and Polymer Limited (BCPL) has released Advertisement No. BCPL-NE/06/2026 for the recruitment of candidates for various regular and trainee positions.

### Vacancy Details
* **Regular Posts (21):**
    * Foreman (Chemical/Civil/Instrumentation)
    * Junior Superintendent (Human Resources)
    * Operator (Chemical)
    * Technician (Electrical/Instrumentation/Mechanical)
* **PwBD Trainee Posts (3):**
    * Operator (Chemical) Trainee
    * Technician (Mechanical) Trainee
    * Accounts Assistant Trainee

### Eligibility Criteria
* **Foreman (Chemical/Civil/Instr.):** Diploma in Engineering in relevant field with minimum 55% marks.
* **Junior Superintendent (HR):** Bachelor Degree with Diploma in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations (min 50% marks).
* **Operator (Chemical):** B.Sc. (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) or B.Sc. (Hons) Chemistry with min 50% marks.
* **Technician (Elec/Instr/Mech):** Matric plus ITI Tradesmanship or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in relevant trade.
* **Accounts Assistant Trainee:** B.Com with min 50% marks and typing speed of 40 w.p.m. in English.

### Age Limit (As of 09.10.2026)
* **Foreman & Junior Superintendent:** Up to 32 years
* **Operator, Technician & Trainee:** Up to 30 years

### Salary and Emoluments
* **Grade S-5 (Foreman/Jr. Supt):** ₹28,500 - 86,570
* **Grade S-3 (Operator/Technician):** ₹25,000 - 81,430
* **S-3 Trainee Posts:** Stipend of ₹21,000 during training
* **Additional Benefits:** IDA, 35% Perquisites, HRA, and North-East allowance (if applicable).

### Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 10 September 2026 (08:00 AM)
* **Application Last Date:** 09 October 2026 (05:00 PM)
* **Cut-off Date for Eligibility:** 09 October 2026

### Application Fee
* **General / EWS / OBC (NCL):** ₹200
* **SC / ST / PwBD:** Exempted

### Selection Process
Shortlisted candidates may undergo a **Skill Test, Proficiency Test, Endurance Test, or Written Test** based on the number of applicants.

website_content.title: Central Silk Board (CSB) Young Professional-Grade-3 Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The Central Silk Board is inviting applications for 14 contractual Young Professional-Grade-3 positions. Eligible CA and MBA/M.Com holders must apply via email by October 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Central Silk Board (CSB), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, is recruiting for **Young Professional-Grade-3** posts on a purely contractual basis for its Central Office and various institutes across India.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 14
* **Job Locations:** Bengaluru (Central Office), Mysuru, Berhampore, Ranchi, Pampore, Lahdoigarh, Bilaspur, Guwahati, and New Delhi.
* **Engagement Period:** Initially 2 years (extendable based on performance).

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualification & Experience
Candidates must possess one of the following:
* **Chartered Accountant (CA):** Minimum 3 years of experience in the Government sector.
* **MBA / M.Com:** Minimum 5 years of experience in the Government sector.

### Key Experience Areas
* Government accounting of autonomous bodies
* Proficiency in **Tally Prime**
* Government procurement procedures
* Scrutiny of TA/DA and medical bills
* Internal audit and statutory compliance

### Age Limit
* **Maximum Age:** 35 years (as of 01/07/2026).

## Salary & Remuneration
* **Monthly Fixed Pay:** ₹70,000 (inclusive of all taxes).
* **Performance Increments:** Annual enhancement of up to 10% based on exemplary performance.
* **Other Benefits:** TA/DA admissible as per Level-8 employees during official tours.

## Selection Process
* Selection will be conducted by a **Screening Committee** and a **Selection Committee**. 
* No written examination is mentioned; selection is based on application scrutiny and interviews.
* A waiting list will be empaneled for one year.

## Important Dates

website_content.title: UKPSC Combined State Civil/Upper Subordinate Services Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: UKPSC is recruiting for 67 Group-B positions including Deputy Collector and Police DSP. Eligible candidates must apply online by September 29, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## 📌 Recruitment Overview
The Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) has announced vacancies for the **Combined State Civil/Upper Subordinate Services Examination 2026**. This is a prestigious opportunity for Uttarakhand domicile candidates to enter Group-B administrative services.

## 💼 Post Details & Vacancies
A total of **67 vacancies** are available across 16 different positions:
* **Deputy Collector:** 10 Posts
* **Police Deputy Superintendent:** 14 Posts
* **Block Development Officer:** 5 Posts
* **Assistant Regional Transport Officer:** 5 Posts
* **Finance/Treasury Officer:** 4 Posts
* **Other posts:** Including Assistant Director, Case Worker, and State Tax Officer.

## 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
* **Educational Qualification:** 
    * **General Posts:** Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
    * **Specialized Posts:** Specific degrees required for Audit Officer (B.Com/CA), Law Officer (PG), Sanskrit Education (PG Sanskrit/B.Ed), and Factory/Boiler (B.Tech Mechanical/Electrical).
* **Age Limit:** 21 to 42 years (as of 01 July 2026). Age relaxation applies for SC/ST/OBC/PwD residents of Uttarakhand.
* **Domicile:** Reservation benefits are limited to **Uttarakhand domicile candidates** only.

## 💰 Salary Structure
* **Level-10:** ₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500 (Most Group-B posts)
* **Level-07:** ₹44,900 – ₹1,42,400 (State Tax Officer)
* **Level-06:** ₹35,400 – ₹1,12,400 (Case Worker)

## 📝 Selection Process
1. **Preliminary Examination:** Objective screening test (Paper 1: GS, Paper 2: General Mental Ability).
2. **Main Examination:** Written/Descriptive papers.
3. **Interview:** Final personality test based on post-preference.

## 📅 Important Dates
* **Notification Date:** 09/09/2026
* **Application Deadline:** 29/09/2026 (11:59:59 PM)
* **Correction Window:** 07/10/2026 to 16/10/2026

website_content.title: GSSSB Research Assistant and Statistical Assistant Syllabus 2026
website_content.summary: GSSSB has released the detailed syllabus and exam pattern for Class-3 Research Assistant and Statistical Assistant posts under Advertisement No. 457/2026-27. The recruitment will be conducted via a Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) in Gujarati and English.
website_content.markdown_content:
## GSSSB Research Assistant & Statistical Assistant Recruitment 2026

The Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB) has officially notified the syllabus for the Class-3 competitive examination. Candidates must prepare for a single competitive test consisting of two distinct parts.

### 📌 Exam Overview
* **Advertisement No:** 457/2026-27
* **Exam Mode:** MCQ-CBRT (Computer Based)
* **Medium:** Gujarati & English
* **Total Questions/Marks:** 210
* **Negative Marking:** 1/4 mark deducted for every wrong answer (pro-rata basis)

### 📊 Exam Pattern

#### Part A: Common Topics (90 Marks)
| Subject | Questions/Marks |
| :--- | :--- |
| Reasoning & Data Interpretation | 30 |
| Quantitative Aptitude | 30 |
| Constitution of India | 10 |
| Current Affairs | 10 |
| Comprehension (Gujarati & English) | 10 |
| **Total** | **90** |

#### Part B: Subject Specific (120 Marks)
| Subject | Marks |
| :--- | :--- |
| Statistics | 30 |
| Official Statistics | 30 |
| Mathematics | 30 |
| Economics | 30 |
| **Total** | **120** |

### 📚 Detailed Syllabus Highlights

**Part A:**
* **Reasoning:** Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, Venn Diagrams, Visual Reasoning, Probability, and Data Sufficiency.
* **Quant:** Number System, Profit-Loss, Time & Work, Geometry, Trigonometry, and Algebra.
* **Constitution:** Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Local Self-Government, and Indian Democracy.
* **Current Affairs:** State, National, and International importance.

**Part B:**
* **Statistics:** Probability Distributions, Sampling Theory, Hypothesis Testing, Index Numbers, and Time Series Analysis.
* **Official Statistics:** NSO, NSSO, CSO, National Accounts, and Sector-wise Statistics.
* **Mathematics:** Binary Systems, Logarithms, Matrices, Determinants, and Calculus (Limits/Derivatives).
* **Economics:** Market Structures, National Income (GDP/GNP), Public Finance, GST, and RBI Monetary Policy.

website_content.title: RRB Staff Nurse (Nursing Superintendent) Syllabus & Exam Date 2026
website_content.summary: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) is conducting the CBT for 272 Nursing Superintendent posts under CEN 03/2025. The exam is scheduled from 10 to 12 March 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## RRB Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the exam schedule and detailed syllabus for the **Nursing Superintendent (Staff Nurse)** position under CEN No. 03/2025. 

### 📅 Key Dates
* **Application Deadline:** 8 September 2025 (Closed)
* **CBT Exam Date:** 10 March 2026 to 12 March 2026
* **Admit Card:** Available 10 days before the exam

### 📝 Exam Pattern
* **Mode:** Online Computer Based Test (CBT)
* **Total Questions:** 100
* **Total Marks:** 100
* **Duration:** 90 Minutes
* **Negative Marking:** 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer

### 📊 Marks Distribution
* **Professional Ability:** 70 Marks (Highest Weightage)
* **General Awareness:** 10 Marks
* **General Arithmetic, Reasoning & Intelligence:** 10 Marks
* **General Science:** 10 Marks

### 📚 Detailed Syllabus
**1. Professional Ability (70 Marks):**
Covers core Nursing subjects: Anatomy, Physiology, Nutrition, Biochemistry, Nursing Foundations, Psychology, Microbiology, Sociology, Pharmacology, Pathology, Genetics, Medical-Surgical Nursing, Community Health, Child Health, Mental Health, Midwifery, Nursing Research & Statistics, and Nursing Management.

**2. General Awareness (10 Marks):**
Current Affairs, Indian Geography, History, Polity, Economy, Environmental Issues, and Sports.

**3. Arithmetic & Reasoning (10 Marks):**
Analogies, Coding-Decoding, Number Systems, BODMAS, Ratio & Proportion, Time & Work, Simple/Compound Interest, and Analytical Reasoning.

**4. General Science (10 Marks):**
10th-standard level Physics, Chemistry, and Life Sciences.

### 🎯 Qualifying Marks (Tentative)
* **UR:** 40%
* **OBC-NCL / SC:** 30%
* **ST:** 25%

### ⚠️ Important Instructions
* **Mandatory:** Original Aadhaar Card is required for biometric authentication at the center.
* **Strategy:** Focus heavily on the **Professional Ability** section as it constitutes 70% of the total score.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The Odisha Joint Entrance Examination Committee (OJEEC) is facilitating the counselling process for pharmacy admissions for the **2026-27 academic session**. This process allows candidates to understand their probable seat allocation based on their rank and preferences.

## Courses Covered
* **B.Pharm** (Bachelor of Pharmacy)
* **M.Pharm** (Master of Pharmacy)
* **LE Pharmacy** (Lateral Entry to B.Pharm)

## Eligibility Criteria
Candidates must have qualified in one of the following examinations to participate:
* OJEE-2026
* NEET UG 2026
* JEE (Main)-2026
* PGAT/OJEE-2026 (specifically for M.Pharm candidates)

## Important Dates
* **Official Notice Release:** 1 September 2026
* **Choice Filling & Locking Starts:** 3 September 2026 (5:00 PM)
* **Mock Seat Allotment Display:** 9 September 2026 (Expected)

## Steps to Check Mock Allotment
1. Visit the official OJEE portal.
2. Navigate to the **Counselling for B.PHARM/ LE.PHARM/ M.PHARM** login link.
3. Enter your registration number and password.
4. Complete the OTP/Captcha verification.
5. Go to the choice-filling section to save preferences.
6. Check the dashboard for the trial allotment status after the release date.

## Key Instructions
* **Tentative Schedule:** Dates are subject to change by OJEEC without prior notice.
* **Mock vs. Final:** The mock allotment is indicative only and may differ from the actual final seat allocation.
* **Choice Locking:** Once choices are locked, they generally cannot be edited for that specific round.

website_content.markdown_content:
## PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026

The Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, has released a notification for the direct recruitment of **Nursing Officers**. This is a prestigious opportunity for nursing professionals to join one of India's premier medical institutes.

### 📌 Key Highlights
* **Post Name:** Nursing Officer (Group 'B')
* **Total Vacancies:** 243
* **Salary:** Pay Level-7 (Rs. 44,900 – 142,400/-)
* **Job Location:** PGIMER, Chandigarh
* **Selection Mode:** Computer Based Test (CBT)

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 10.09.2026
* **Application Last Date:** 03.10.2026
* **Crucial Date for Eligibility:** 03.10.2026

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
**Educational Qualifications:**
* **Option A:** B.Sc. (Hons) Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing AND registration as RN or RN & RM with a State Nursing Council.
* **Option B:** GNM Diploma AND registration as RN or RN & RM with a State Nursing Council PLUS one year of experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital.

**Age Limit (as of 03.10.2026):**
* **General:** 18 to 35 years
* **SC/ST:** 5 years relaxation
* **OBC:** 3 years relaxation
* **PwBD:** 10 years relaxation

### 💰 Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** Rs. 1500/- (+ transaction charges)
* **SC/ST:** Rs. 800/- (+ transaction charges)
* **PwBD:** Exempted

### 📝 Selection Process
1. **Computer Based Test (CBT):** 100 MCQs | 100 Minutes | Negative Marking: 0.25
2. **Shortlisting:** 3x the number of vacancies
3. **Scrutiny & Document Verification:** Verification of original certificates
4. **Final Selection:** Based purely on CBT merit.

website_content.title: UPESSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 (Advt No. 04/2026)
website_content.summary: UPESSC has announced 1936 Assistant Professor vacancies across various subjects for government and government-aided degree colleges in Uttar Pradesh. Selection is based on a written examination followed by an interview.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
**UPESSC** (formerly UPHESC) is inviting applications for the post of **Assistant Professor** for various subjects. This recruitment is governed by Advertisement No. 04/2026.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 1936
* **Post Name:** Assistant Professor
* **Department:** Government and Government-aided Degree Colleges, UP

## Selection Process
Candidates must clear two primary stages:
1. **Written Examination:** Objective type (OMR-based).
2. **Interview:** For candidates who qualify the written test.

## Revised Exam Pattern (2026)
**Important:** A revised pattern was introduced around July 2026. Candidates must adhere to the following structure:

* **Total Questions:** 120
* **Total Marks:** 360
* **Duration:** 2 Hours (120 Minutes)
* **Marking Scheme:** +3 for every correct answer
* **Negative Marking:** -1 mark for every wrong answer

### Marks Distribution
* **General Studies / GK:** 30 Questions (90 Marks)
* **Concerned / Optional Subject:** 90 Questions (270 Marks)

## Syllabus Highlights
### 1. General Studies (Compulsory)
* **Current Affairs:** National and International events, sports, and scientific research.
* **Teaching & Research Aptitude:** Nature and methods of teaching, evaluation systems, and UGC's role.
* **ICT:** Computer basics and digital initiatives in education.
* **Environment:** Human-environment interaction and conservation.
* **Indian Context:** History, Geography, Polity, and Economy.

### 2. Optional Subject
* Content is set at the **Postgraduate level** and is largely aligned with the **UGC NET syllabus** for the chosen subject.

## Preparation Strategy
* **Prioritize Subject Depth:** With 75% of the marks coming from the optional subject, allocate maximum study time here.
* **Master the GS Section:** Focus heavily on Teaching and Research Aptitude.
* **Avoid Guesswork:** Due to the introduction of negative marking, avoid blind guessing in the OMR sheet.
* **Practice:** Solve previous year papers to understand the difficulty level.

website_content.title: ULB Haryana Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 195 Taxation & Sanitation Experts
website_content.summary: Directorate of Urban Local Bodies, Haryana has released a recruitment notification for 195 contractual vacancies of Taxation Experts, Taxation Associates, and Sanitation Experts. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications on or before 30 September 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## ULB Haryana Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Directorate of Urban Local Bodies (ULB), Haryana, Panchkula, invites online applications for the engagement of 195 contractual posts across municipalities in Haryana. The engagement is initially for a period of 1 year, extendable up to 3 years.

## Vacancy Details

* **Taxation Experts**: 62 Posts (Remuneration: ₹1,00,000/month)
* **Taxation Associates**: 76 Posts (Remuneration: ₹50,000/month)
* **Sanitation Experts/Associates**: 57 Posts (Remuneration: ₹50,000/month)
* **Total Vacancies**: 195 Posts

## Eligibility Criteria

### Educational Qualification
* **Taxation Experts**: Chartered Accountant (CA).
* **Taxation Associates**: MBA (Finance) / PGDM (Finance) from a recognized institute ranked among top 50 as per latest NIRF rankings.
* **Sanitation Experts/Associates**: Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Science or Environmental Science & Engineering from an institute among top 50 in NIRF rankings.

### Age Limit
* **Minimum Age**: 18 Years
* **Maximum Age**: 42 Years

## Selection Process

Selection is purely merit-based without any written test:
* **Academic Qualification Score**: 60% weightage
* **Merit/GATE/Ranking Score**: 20 Marks
* **Relevant Field Experience**: Up to 10–20 Marks
* **Govt/PSU Experience**: Up to 10 Marks

## How to Apply

* Visit the official recruitment portal.
* Complete one-time registration and login.
* Fill in personal, educational, and experience details.
* Upload scanned photograph, signature, and self-certified documents.
* Submit the application form before **30 September 2026**.

website_content.markdown_content:
## Karnataka PGCET 2026 Draft Seat Matrix

The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has officially published the **Draft Seat Matrix** for PGCET 2026. This document is essential for candidates to understand the availability of seats across various institutes and categories before the centralized counselling process begins.

**Courses Covered:**
* MBA
* MCA
* M.E. / M.Tech
* M.Arch (Processed via KEA counselling)

**Key Highlights:**
* **Release Date:** September 9, 2026
* **Purpose:** Provides a provisional list of college-wise and category-wise seats reported by participating institutes.
* **Status:** This is a **Draft Matrix**. A final seat matrix will be released after any reported discrepancies are resolved.

**Important Dates to Remember:**
* **MBA/MCA Exam:** June 14, 2026
* **MBA/MCA Results:** August 19, 2026
* **Draft Seat Matrix Release:** September 9, 2026

**Steps to Check the Seat Matrix:**
1. Visit the official KEA portal.
2. Locate the **PGCET 2026** section.
3. Search for the notification titled "Draft Seat Matrix" for your respective course.
4. Download and review the PDF to align your preferences for option entry.

**Important Instructions:**
* Only the **final seat matrix** published by KEA will be binding for the actual counselling.
* Ensure you have your rank card and login credentials ready for the upcoming registration phase.

website_content.markdown_content:
## OPSC Assistant Professor Provisional Answer Key 2026

The Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC) has officially released the provisional answer keys for the written examination held on **29 August 2026** for the recruitment of Assistant Professors in Government Engineering Colleges (Advt. No. 35 of 2023-24).

**Key Highlights:**
* **Disciplines Covered:** Mechanical Engineering and Chemical Engineering.
* **Exam Date:** 29 August 2026.
* **Answer Key Sets:** Provisional keys are available for all four series (**Set A, B, C, and D**).

**Important Dates for Objections:**
* **Mechanical Engineering:** Last date to raise objections is **18 September 2026**.
* **Chemical Engineering:** Last date to raise objections is **21 September 2026**.

**Guidelines for Raising Objections:**
* **Online Only:** Objections must be submitted exclusively through the portal `opscechayan.in`.
* **Reference Set:** All objections must refer to the **Question Number of Set 'A'**, regardless of the set the candidate actually attempted.
* **Justification:** Sufficient proof or justification must be provided for each challenged answer.
* **Finality:** Questions receiving no objections will be treated as final. Valid objections will be reviewed by a Committee of Experts to determine the Final Answer Key.

**Step-by-Step Process to Challenge:**
1. Visit the official objection portal at `opscechayan.in`.
2. Log in using registered credentials.
3. Select the appropriate discipline (Mechanical or Chemical).
4. Reference the question number from **Set 'A'** and provide justification.
5. Submit and save the confirmation screenshot.

website_content.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has outlined the syllabus and exam pattern for the post of Horticulture Officer 2026. Candidates preparing for the recruitment exam can review the detailed 3-paper structure and comprehensive topic-wise syllabus.
website_content.markdown_content:
## APPSC Horticulture Officer Recruitment 2026

The **Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)** conducts the recruitment exam for the post of **Horticulture Officer** under the Department of Horticulture. Candidates preparing for the examination must understand the paper structure, marking scheme, and topic distribution to plan their preparation effectively.

---

### Key Highlights
* **Organization:** Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)
* **Post Name:** Horticulture Officer
* **Exam Mode:** OMR-based Objective Type
* **Total Questions:** 450 Questions
* **Total Marks:** 450 Marks
* **Negative Marking:** 1/3rd mark deducted per wrong answer
* **Location:** Andhra Pradesh

---

### Selection Process
1. **Qualifying Paper:** English & Telugu (Language Proficiency)
2. **Paper-I:** General Studies & Mental Ability (Degree Standard)
3. **Paper-II:** Horticulture-I (Degree Standard)
4. **Paper-III:** Horticulture-II (Degree Standard)

---

### Exam Pattern
* **Paper-I (General Studies & Mental Ability):** 150 Questions | 150 Minutes | 150 Marks
* **Paper-II (Horticulture-I):** 150 Questions | 150 Minutes | 150 Marks
* **Paper-III (Horticulture-II):** 150 Questions | 150 Minutes | 150 Marks
* **Total Scheme:** 450 Questions | 450 Minutes | 450 Marks

---

### Syllabus Overview

#### 1. Paper-I: General Studies & Mental Ability
* Current Affairs (National and International)
* General Science and everyday applications
* History, Polity, and Economy of India with special emphasis on Andhra Pradesh
* Logical reasoning, mental ability, and data interpretation
* Sustainable development and environmental protection

#### 2. Papers-II & III: Core Horticulture Topics
* **Fundamentals of Horticulture & Plant Propagation:** Orchard layout, nursery management, and cultivation systems.
* **Pomology (Fruit Science):** Cultivation and management of Citrus, Mango, Banana, Guava, Pineapple, and Grapes.
* **Olericulture (Vegetable Science):** Production technology of Solanaceous crops, Cucurbits, Cole crops, and Root vegetables.
* **Commercial Floriculture & Landscaping:** Rose, Jasmine, Carnation, Marigold, and bio-aesthetic planning.
* **Greenhouse Management:** Protected cultivation systems, cladding materials, and micro-climate control.
* **Plant Physiology & Growth Regulators:** C3/C4 pathways, respiration, and hormone applications.
* **Spices, Plantation, Medicinal & Aromatic Crops:** Production and distillation processes of Ashwagandha, Turmeric, Coffee, Tea, Cashew, etc.
* **Plant Pathology & Entomology:** Pest/disease life cycles and Integrated Pest Management (IPM).

website_content.markdown_content:
## RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) is filling **434 vacancies** across various healthcare and paramedical roles. Selection is based on a single-stage **Computer Based Test (CBT)**.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **Exam Dates:** 10th, 11th, and 12th March 2026
* **Mode of Exam:** Online (CBT)

### 📋 Post Details
Vacancies are available for a wide range of roles, including:
* Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Dietician
* Dental Hygienist, Dialysis Technician, Extension Educator
* Health and Malaria Inspector, Lab Superintendent, Optometrist
* Perfusionist, Speech Therapist, ECG Technician, Lady Health Visitor, Lab Assistant

### ✍️ Exam Pattern
The exam consists of **100 Objective Type Questions** to be completed in **90 minutes**.

| Subject | Questions | Marks |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| General Awareness | 10 | 10 |
| Gen. Arithmetic, Intelligence & Reasoning | 10 | 10 |
| General Science | 10 | 10 |
| **Professional Ability** | **70** | **70** |
| **Total** | **100** | **100** |

**Marking Scheme:**
* Correct Answer: **+1 Mark**
* Incorrect Answer: **-0.25 Mark** (Negative Marking)

### 📚 Syllabus Highlights
1. **General Awareness:** Current Affairs, Indian History, Geography, Polity, and Sports.
2. **Arithmetic & Reasoning:** Number System, BODMAS, Percentages, Analogies, Syllogism, and Data Interpretation.
3. **General Science:** Physics, Chemistry, and Life Sciences (up to 10th CBSE).
4. **Professional Ability:** Post-specific technical subjects (carries the maximum weightage of 70%)

### 🎯 Selection Process
* **CBT Score:** Selection is determined solely based on the Computer Based Test score.
* **Indicative Qualifying Marks:** UR/EWS (40%), OBC/SC (30%), ST (25%).

website_content.summary: Complete guide to the AP Police Jail Warder recruitment 2026 conducted by APSLPRB, covering the selection process, syllabus, and physical standards.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AP Police Jail Warder Recruitment 2026

The **Andhra Pradesh State Level Police Recruitment Board (APSLPRB)** has prescribed the syllabus and exam pattern for the post of **Jail Warder**. Candidates are advised to align their preparation with the following structured selection process.

### 📋 Selection Process
Candidates must successfully clear each of the following stages:
* **Stage 1: Preliminary Written Test** (Objective MCQ)
* **Stage 2: Physical Measurement Test (PMT)** (Height, Chest, and Weight check)
* **Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)** (Running and Long Jump)
* **Stage 4: Final Written Examination** (Objective MCQ)

### ✍️ Preliminary Written Test Pattern
* **Exam Mode:** Offline
* **Question Type:** Objective (MCQ)
* **Total Questions:** 200
* **Total Marks:** 200
* **Duration:** 3 Hours (180 Minutes)
* **Standard:** Intermediate (10+2)

| Subject | Questions | Marks |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| General Studies (History, Geography, Polity, Economy) | 50 | 50 |
| Arithmetic & Test of Reasoning / Mental Ability | 50 | 50 |
| General Science & Current Events | 50 | 50 |
| English Language Skills | 50 | 50 |
| **Total** | **200** | **200** |

### 📚 Detailed Syllabus

**1. Arithmetic & Reasoning Ability**
* Number Systems, Simplification, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI.
* Ratio & Proportion, Average, Time & Work, Time & Distance.
* Data Interpretation, Analogies, Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, and Direction Sense.

**2. General Science**
* **Physics:** Motion, Work, Energy, Light, and Sound.
* **Chemistry:** Chemical reactions, Elements, and Household chemistry.
* **Biology:** Human anatomy, Plant physiology, Health, and Nutrition.

**3. History & Culture**
* Ancient, Medieval, and Modern Indian History.
* Indian Freedom Struggle.
* **Special Focus:** Socio-cultural heritage and reorganization of Andhra Pradesh.

**4. Indian Polity & Economy**
* Indian Constitution, Fundamental Rights, and Duties.
* Union/State Executive, Judiciary, and Legislature.
* Panchayati Raj and AP Government economic schemes.

**5. Geography & Environmental Issues**
* Physical, Social, and Economic geography of India and Andhra Pradesh.
* Climate, Rivers, Soil, and Natural Resources.
* Ecology and Disaster Management.

**6. Current Events**
* National and International events, Awards, Sports, and Science & Technology updates.

website_content.summary: The Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu, has released the provisional seat allotment for TNEA Supplementary Counselling 2026. Eligible candidates can now log in to the official portal to download their allotment orders.
website_content.markdown_content:
## TNEA Supplementary Counselling 2026 Overview
The **Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Tamil Nadu** has officially announced the provisional seat allotment results for the supplementary counselling round of 2026. Candidates who participated in the choice-filling process can now check their allotted college and branch.

## Key Dates to Remember
* **Registration Window:** August 17, 2026, to August 31, 2026
* **Supplementary Rank List Publication:** September 3, 2026
* **Choice Filling Period:** September 4 to 5, 2026
* **Tentative Allotment:** September 7, 2026
* **Provisional Allotment Result:** September 9, 2026

## How to Check Your Allotment Result
1. Visit the official TNEA portal or the dedicated supplementary portal.
2. Click on the **'TNEA Supplementary Counselling 2026 Provisional Seat Allotment Result'** link.
3. Log in using your **registered email ID and password**.
4. Review your allotted college, branch, and category.
5. Choose your option: **Accept the seat**, **Accept with upward movement**, or **Decline**.
6. Download and save the provisional allotment letter.

## Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Deadline Compliance:** Confirm your allotment within the stipulated deadline to avoid seat cancellation.
* **Official Portals Only:** Use only `tneaonline.org` or `suppl.tneaonline.org` to avoid fraudulent links.
* **Documentation:** Keep all original documents ready for verification during the college reporting process.
* **Refunds:** Candidates not allotted a seat or those who decline may be eligible for a deposit refund per TNEA norms.

website_content.title: IAF AFCAT 02/2026 Result & Scorecard 2026
website_content.summary: The Indian Air Force has announced the AFCAT 02/2026 results for Flying Branch and Ground Duty roles. Qualified candidates can now download their scorecards to proceed to the AFSB Interview stage.
website_content.markdown_content:
## AFCAT 02/2026 Result Overview
The **Indian Air Force (IAF)** has officially declared the results for the **Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT 02/2026)** conducted for various branches including Flying Branch and Ground Duty (Technical & Non-Technical). This recruitment cycle comprises a total of **379 vacancies**.

## Important Dates
* **Exam Date:** August 8, 2026
* **Answer Key Release:** August 11, 2026
* **Result Declaration Date:** September 9, 2026

## Selection Process: What's Next?
Candidates who have qualified the written examination will now move to the following stages:

* **AFSB Interview:** Includes the Officer Intelligence Rating Test, Psychological Tests, Group Tests, and a Personal Interview.
* **Document Verification:** Validation of educational certificates, age proof, and category certificates.
* **Medical Examination:** Final health screening for candidates who clear the AFSB interview.

## How to Check Your Result
1. Visit the official AFCAT portal.
2. Click on the **'AFCAT 02/2026 Result'** link on the homepage.
3. Log in using your **User ID** and **Password**.
4. Enter the **Captcha** code and click **Sign In**.
5. View and download your scorecard for future reference.

## Documents Required for Verification
* Educational qualification certificates & mark sheets
* Date of birth / Age proof
* Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS if applicable)
* AFCAT admit card and printed scorecard

website_content.title: UPESSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: The UPESSC Prayagraj has announced 1,936 vacancies for Assistant Professors in aided co-education and women colleges across Uttar Pradesh. Eligible candidates must apply online via the OTR system by October 7, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Recruitment Overview
The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) is conducting a massive recruitment drive for **Assistant Professors** under Advertisement Number 04/2026. This opportunity is open for both co-education and women's degree colleges.

## Vacancy Details
* **Total Posts:** 1,936
* **Co-education Colleges:** 1,564 posts
* **Women's Colleges:** 372 posts
* **Subjects:** 42 different subjects including Hindi, English, Economics, Physics, Chemistry, and Law.

## Eligibility Criteria
### Educational Qualifications
Candidates must fulfill one of the following routes:
* **Route A:** Master's degree with at least **55% marks** in the relevant subject AND a qualifying **NET/SLET/SET** certificate. (PhD holders may be exempt as per UGC regulations).
* **Route B:** PhD in the relevant subject from a foreign university ranked in the **Top 500** (QS/THE/Shanghai rankings).
* **Special Arts/Music:** Candidates may apply with a Bachelor's degree and outstanding professional achievement (A-grade artist on AIR/Doordarshan) and theoretical grounding.

### Age Limit
* **Maximum Age:** 62 Years (as of 01 July 2026).

## Selection Process
The final selection is based on a combination of:
1. **Written Examination (360 Marks):** 120 MCQs (30 GK + 90 Subject-specific). Duration: 2 Hours. (Negative marking: 1 mark deduction for wrong answers).
2. **Interview (40 Marks):** Shortlisted candidates from the written exam.

## Important Dates
* **Application Start Date:** 08 September 2026
* **Fee Payment Deadline:** 07 October 2026
* **Correction Window Ends:** 11 October 2026
* **Exam Date:** 19 & 20 November 2026

## Application Fee
* **General/OBC/EWS:** ₹2,000
* **SC/ST:** ₹1,500
* **PwD:** ₹1,000

website_content.title: CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026
website_content.summary: CBI invites applications from eligible advocates for engagement as Special Public Prosecutors (SPP) across four key trial court locations. The application deadline is October 8, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## CBI Special Public Prosecutor (SPP) Recruitment 2026

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), Policy Division, New Delhi, is inviting applications from experienced advocates for engagement as **Special Public Prosecutors (SPP)**. These prosecutors will be responsible for conducting trials of Lokpal-referred CBI cases.

### 📍 Trial Court Locations
Separate advertisements have been issued for the following locations:
* **Lucknow**
* **Jabalpur**
* **Ghaziabad**
* **Coimbatore**

### 🎓 Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible for this engagement, candidates must meet the following requirements:
* **Educational Qualification:** LLB degree.
* **Professional Enrollment:** Must possess an Enrollment Certificate as an Advocate with the Bar Council.
* **Standing at Bar:** A minimum of **10 years' standing** as an Advocate.
* **Criminal Experience:** Extensive experience handling criminal matters in Sessions Courts.
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Proven experience in conducting trials of cases under the **Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988**.
* **Location Constraint:** Candidates must be stationed at the place where the concerned Court is situated.

### 📅 Important Dates & Details
* **Application Deadline:** 08 October 2026
* **Engagement Period:** Minimum 3 years
* **Selection Mode:** Shortlisting based on application, followed by an interaction with CBI.
* **Application Mode:** Online only via the prescribed proforma.

### 📄 Required Documents
* Educational Qualification certificates.
* Bar Council Enrollment Certificate.
* Details of important criminal cases handled.
* Specific details of cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
* Unconditional willingness/consent to work under Government of India terms.

### 💰 Professional Fee
Fees are governed by **DoPT File No. 225/19/2023-AVD-II dated 08.04.2024**.

website_content.title: PSEB Class 10 & 12 Supplementary Result Rechecking & Revaluation 2026
website_content.summary: The Punjab School Education Board (PSEB) has opened applications for the rechecking and revaluation of Class 10 and 12 supplementary exam results. Students must submit their online applications by September 21, 2026.
website_content.markdown_content:
## Overview
The **Punjab School Education Board (PSEB)** has declared the supplementary (compartment) results for 2026. Students who wish to challenge their marks can apply for either rechecking or revaluation of their answer scripts.

## Important Dates
* **Class 12 Supplementary Result:** August 25, 2026
* **Class 10 Supplementary Result:** August 29, 2026
* **Application Deadline (Rechecking/Revaluation):** September 21, 2026

## Understanding the Process
* **Rechecking:** A verification process to ensure all answers were evaluated, totals are correct, and no question was missed. Marks are not re-assessed.
* **Revaluation:** A comprehensive re-examination of the answer script by a different examiner. Marks may increase, decrease, or remain unchanged.

## How to Apply
1. Visit the official PSEB portal.
2. Navigate to the **Results** or **Important Links** section.
3. Select the rechecking/revaluation link for your respective class.
4. Log in using your roll number and credentials.
5. Choose the subject(s) and the type of review requested.
6. Pay the required fee online and submit.

## Key Guidelines
* **Mode:** Only online applications are accepted; offline submissions will not be entertained.
* **Eligibility:** Generally, only theory papers are eligible for revaluation; practical marks are typically excluded.
* **Outcome:** Students should be aware that marks can change in either direction after revaluation.
* **Confirmation:** Always save or print the digital confirmation page after submission.

website_content.summary: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the city intimation slips for the Selection Post Phase-XIV CBT 2026. Candidates can now check their allotted exam city to plan travel and stay before the official admit cards are released.
website_content.markdown_content:
## SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Exam Update

The **Staff Selection Commission (SSC)** has officially released the City Intimation Slips for the Selection Post Phase-XIV Examination 2026. This slip is designed to help candidates organize their travel logistics ahead of the actual examination.

### 📅 Important Dates
* **City Intimation Slip Release:** 8 September 2026
* **Admit Card Release:** 14 September 2026 (Tentative, 2-3 days before exam)
* **Exam Dates (CBT):** 16 to 26 September 2026

### 🔍 Key Examination Details
* **Total Vacancies:** 2,919
* **Total Registered Candidates:** 29,39,401
* **Required Login:** Registration Number/Username and Password

### 🕒 Exam Day Shift Timings
* **Shift 1:** Reporting 7:45 AM | Gate Closes 8:30 AM | Exam 9:00 AM – 10:00 AM
* **Shift 2:** Reporting 10:30 AM | Gate Closes 11:15 AM | Exam 11:45 AM – 12:45 PM
* **Shift 3:** Reporting 1:15 PM | Gate Closes 2:00 PM | Exam 2:30 PM – 3:30 PM

### ⚠️ Critical Instructions for Candidates
* **Not an Admit Card:** The city intimation slip is for informational purposes only and **cannot** be used for entry into the exam centre.
* **Required Documents:** You must carry the printed **Admit Card** and a **valid original photo ID proof** on the exam day.
* **Punctuality:** Strictly adhere to the reporting and gate closing times to avoid denial of entry.
* **Verification:** Check your name and registration details on the slip; report any errors via official SSC channels immediately.
